title: QoSFlow: Ensuring Service Quality of Distributed Workflows Using Interpretable Sensitivity Models
comment: to be published in 40th IEEE International Parallel & Distributed Processing Symposium (IPDPS), 2026
summary: With the increasing importance of distributed scientific workflows, there is a critical need to ensure Quality of Service (QoS) constraints, such as minimizing time or limiting execution to resource subsets. However, the unpredictable nature of workflow behavior, even with similar configurations, makes it difficult to provide QoS guarantees. For effective reasoning about QoS scheduling, we introduce QoSFlow, a performance modeling method that partitions a workflow's execution configuration space into regions with similar behavior. Each region groups configurations with comparable execution times according to a given statistical sensitivity, enabling efficient QoS-driven scheduling through analytical reasoning rather than exhaustive testing. Evaluation on three diverse workflows shows that QoSFlow's execution recommendations outperform the best-performing standard heuristic by 27.38%. Empirical validation confirms that QoSFlow's recommended configurations consistently match measured execution outcomes across different QoS constraints.

AI.tldr: QoSFlow是一种性能建模方法，通过将工作流执行配置空间划分为行为相似的区域（按统计敏感性分组），实现高效的QoS驱动调度。实验表明该方法优于最佳启发式方法27.38%，且推荐配置经验证与实际执行结果一致。
AI.motivation: 随着分布式科学工作流的重要性日益增加，确保QoS约束（如最小化时间或限制资源子集执行）变得至关重要。然而，即使配置相似，工作流行为的不可预测性使得提供QoS保证变得困难，因此需要一种有效的QoS调度推理方法。
AI.method: QoSFlow将工作流的执行配置空间按统计敏感性划分为多个区域，每个区域包含执行时间相近的配置。通过分析这些区域而非逐个测试配置，实现高效的QoS驱动调度。
AI.result: QoSFlow的Execution recommendations比表现最好的标准启发式方法优27.38%。经验证，推荐的配置在不同QoS约束下与测量结果一致。
AI.conclusion: QoSFlow通过将工作流执行配置空间划分为具有相似行为的区域，实现了高效的QoS驱动调度。该方法无需穷举测试即可进行解析推理，为分布式科学工作流的QoS保证提供了一种实用的解决方案。经验证，推荐的配置与测量结果一致，验证了方法的有效性。

title: Hestia: Hyperthread-Level Scheduling for Cloud Microservices with Interference-Aware Attention
comment: This paper has been accepted for publication in Design Automation Conference(DAC 2026)
summary: Modern cloud servers routinely co-locate multiple latency-sensitive microservice instances to improve resource efficiency. However, the diversity of microservice behaviors, coupled with mutual performance interference under simultaneous multithreading (SMT), makes large-scale placement increasingly complex. Existing interference aware schedulers and isolation techniques rely on coarse core-level profiling or static resource partitioning, leaving asymmetric hyperthread-level heterogeneity and SMT contention dynamics largely unmodeled. We present Hestia, a hyperthread-level, interference-aware scheduling framework powered by self-attention. Through an extensive analysis of production traces encompassing 32,408 instances across 3,132 servers, we identify two dominant contention patterns -- sharing-core (SC) and sharing-socket (SS) -- and reveal strong asymmetry in their impact. Guided by these insights, Hestia incorporates (1) a self-attention-based CPU usage predictor that models SC/SS contention and hardware heterogeneity, and (2) an interference scoring model that estimates pairwise contention risks to guide scheduling decisions. We evaluate Hestia through large-scale simulation and a real production deployment. Hestia reduces the 95th-percentile service latency by up to 80\%, lowers overall CPU consumption by 2.3\% under the same workload, and surpasses five state-of-the-art schedulers by up to 30.65\% across diverse contention scenarios.

AI.tldr: Hestia 是一个面向云延迟敏感微服务的超线程级（hyperthread-level）干扰感知调度框架，核心是"自注意力预测 CPU 利用率 + 干扰打分 + 拓扑感知候选选择"三件套。它在双路服务器上显式建模共享核心（SC）与共享插槽（SS）两类争用，在 19,760 核生产集群上部署后 P95 延迟降低 21.68%–24.6%、同负载下集群总 CPU 消耗降低 2.3%，大规模仿真中总 CPU 核数比生产 FF 策略少 9.75%，并全面优于五个 SOTA 干扰感知调度器（最高提升 30.65%）。
AI.motivation: 云平台普遍将大量延迟敏感（LS）微服务实例共置于同一服务器以提升资源利用率，但共置带来 LLC、内存带宽、互连等共享资源上的性能干扰。现有方案存在三点不足：一是多采用核级（core-level）画像或静态资源分区（如 Linux cpuset、core binding），未刻画超线程（SMT）级别的异构性与争用动态；二是注入式方法（Paragon、FECBench）画像开销高且难覆盖真实负载多样性，trace 驱动方法粒度粗糙；三是干扰本身是双向、非线性、非对称的，成对简单叠加模型不足。该问题还有三大挑战：LS 服务在 CPU 强度、内存带宽需求与干扰敏感性上高度异构；共置实例间干扰双向但强不对称且非线性；数万实例的放置选择本质是 NP-hard 的装箱问题，叠加超线程交互后搜索空间组合爆炸。作者据此对 3,132 台服务器、32,408 个 LS 实例的生产 trace（146 个服务，覆盖 93% 以上 CPU 配额）做了系统分析，得到三个观察：观察1，CPU 利用率与请求延迟强正相关（78 个服务 Spearman 系数 >0.8，占 78.7% CPU 配额），可作为干扰强度的可靠代理；观察2，实例的 CPU 利用率与 SC/SS 邻居近似线性耦合（平均 R²=0.83，逾 80% 服务 >0.75），而与跨插槽（OS）邻居无明显相关；观察3，干扰呈层级结构——SC 邻居主要冲击 L1/L2 流水线（高 SC 争用下延迟升 23%、L1/L2 缺失升 12%），SS 邻居主要抬升 LLC 缺失（升 40%）与内存访问延迟，二者叠加时延迟升 78%、利用率升 40.7%、CPI 升 41.7%，即使"独占物理核"也无法避免。这直接 motivates 需要超线程粒度、层级感知的干扰调度。
AI.method: 框架包含三个紧耦合组件。(1) Topology-Aware Selector：先按集群策略（spread / stack）过滤可行服务器，再在每个插槽内用滑动窗口（窗口大小=请求 HT 数，步长决定候选数）枚举拓扑合法的 HT 集合；遵循两条原则：socket locality（实例限定单插槽以避免跨插槽通信与 NUMA 延迟）与"HT 连续 + 核隔离"（优先同插槽相邻空闲 HT 以保缓存局部性、避免碎片，除非无替代否则不选同物理核 HT 对）。(2) CPU 利用率预测器：基于自注意力的层级模型。输入层将每个实例编码为 [服务 one-hot×可学习嵌入矩阵, rps, cpu_model]，同时携带 HT 分配上下文与服务身份；SC Encoder 对共享同一物理核的 HT 对做自注意力（标准 scaled dot-product attention），拼接各核结果后经位置前馈网络得到 SC_H；SS Encoder 再对 SC_H 做一层注意力得到 SS_H，从而镜像"HT→核→插槽"的资源共享层级，自适应学习邻居相对影响、负载上下文与跨插槽长程效应；最后轻量 MLP 将 SS_H 映射为每 HT 的 CPU 利用率，实例级预测取其占用 HT 的均值，以实例级 MSE 损失优化（预测在 HT 级受监督，损失在实例级计算）。(3) Interference Scorer：先用不含 SC/SS 干扰项的预测器得到基线 CPU_i^woi，再用含干扰的预测得到 CPU_i^wi，相对增幅 Score_i=(wi−woi)/woi 度量该负载对争用的敏感度；再按实例占用 HT 比例加权聚合为插槽级 Score_skt=Σ w_i·Score_i，按分数排序选取最低干扰放置。该框架轻量、非侵入式，可与现有生产调度器集成。
AI.result: 大规模仿真（32,408 实例 / 146 服务 / 3,132 台服务器，Intel Xeon 8200/8100 系列）：完成相同负载所需总 CPU 核数为 76,420，较生产 FF（84,679）降低 9.75%；对比 Socket-Spread、Paragon、Kambadur、RCPU 的 0.42%、5.08%、2.65%、5.21% 优势明显。服务级上，相比各基线 P95 延迟降低 10%–80%；前十大 CPU 配额服务（占集群需求 85.85%）相对 Hestia 的额外 CPU 开销分别为 FF 7.91%–29.19%、Socket-Spread 7.16%–27.68%、Paragon 0.27%–8.32%、RCPU 1.39%–7.69%、Kambadur 12.23%–24.36%。生产部署（190 台服务器、19,760 核、2,009 实例、247 个 LS 服务；因全局重排不可行，仅重调度 CPU 利用率较正常水平上升 >20% 的严重干扰受害者）：同负载下集群总 CPU 消耗下降 2.27%（约 2.3%）；Ordering 服务平均 CPU 利用率由 81.84% 降至 56.75%（−30.65%），平均延迟由 239ms 降至 180ms（−24.6%）；Coupon 延迟降低 21.68%。预测器精度（恒定负载数据集）：RMSE 分别为 Avg 3.04%、FECBench 2.78%、MLP 2.39%、Hestia 1.93%，MAE 分别为 4.25%、4.14%、3.22%、2.66%；在 CPU 配额最高的五个服务上对四个服务均优于基线（Coupon 上 RMSE 低 1.13%–3%）。
AI.conclusion: Hestia 通过在真实生产 trace 上识别并显式建模 SC/SS 两类层级争用，用自注意力 CPU 利用率预测器 + 干扰打分 + 拓扑感知 HT 候选选择，实现了超线程粒度、非侵入式、可与现有调度器集成的干扰感知放置，能在干扰发生前主动规避。实验证明其在大幅降低尾延迟的同时提升集群 CPU 效率，并稳定优于五种代表性干扰感知调度器与隔离机制。作者强调这是首个基于真实生产 trace 同时在核级与插槽级建模干扰、并构建可扩展超线程级调度框架的工作。局限方面可注意：预测与打分开销、跨插槽（OS）邻居被建模为"无相关"而未纳入打分、依赖单一双路 Intel 平台的拓扑假设、以及生产部署仅对部分严重受害实例生效，全局收益仍受限。

title: Mixed Choice in Asynchronous Multiparty Session Types
summary: We present a multiparty session type (MST) framework with asynchronous mixed choice (MC). We propose a core construct for MC that allows transient inconsistencies in protocol state between distributed participants, but ensures all participants can always eventually reach a mutually consistent state. We prove the correctness of our system by establishing a progress property and an operational correspondence between global types and distributed local type projections. Based on our theory, we implement a practical toolchain for specifying and validating asynchronous MST protocols featuring MC, and programming compliant gen_statem processes in Erlang/OTP. We test our framework by using our toolchain to specify and reimplement part of the amqp_client of the RabbitMQ broker for Erlang.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个支持异步混合选择的多方会话类型框架，通过允许临时不一致但保证最终一致性的机制，解决了分布式协议建模中的状态同步问题，并实现了Erlang/OTP工具链和实际应用验证。
AI.motivation: 现有多方会话类型理论在处理异步混合选择时存在局限性，需要一种既能允许协议状态临时不一致、又能保证所有参与者最终达成一致状态的框架，以更好地支持分布式系统的实际协议建模。
AI.method: 提出MC核心构造允许分布式参与者间的临时不一致但确保最终达到一致状态；通过建立进度属性和全局类型与分布式局部类型投影之间的操作对应来证明系统正确性；实现基于gen_statem的Erlang/OTP工具链。
AI.result: 建立了进度属性和操作对应等理论性质；实现了用于规范和验证异步MST协议的工具链；成功将RabbitMQ的amqp_client部分功能重写为符合规范的gen_statem进程。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一个完整的多方会话类型框架，支持异步混合选择，通过临时不一致性机制实现最终一致性。理论正确性通过进度属性和全局-局部类型操作对应得到证明。实践上实现了Erlang/OTP工具链，并成功重用了RabbitMQ的amqp_client部分功能，验证了框架的实用性。

title: Green or Fast? Learning to Balance Cold Starts and Idle Carbon in Serverless Computing
summary: Serverless computing simplifies cloud deployment but introduces new challenges in managing service latency and carbon emissions. Reducing cold-start latency requires retaining warm function instances, while minimizing carbon emissions favors reclaiming idle resources. This balance is further complicated by time-varying grid carbon intensity and varying workload patterns, under which static keep-alive policies are inefficient. We present LACE-RL, a latency-aware and carbon-efficient management framework that formulates serverless pod retention as a sequential decision problem. LACE-RL uses deep reinforcement learning to dynamically tune keep-alive durations, jointly modeling cold-start probability, function-specific latency costs, and real-time carbon intensity. Using the Huawei Public Cloud Trace, we show that LACE-RL reduces cold starts by 51.69% and idle keep-alive carbon emissions by 77.08% compared to Huawei's static policy, while achieving better latency-carbon trade-offs than state-of-the-art heuristic and single-objective baselines, approaching Oracle performance.

AI.tldr: LACE-RL是一种延迟感知且碳高效的Serverless管理框架，利用深度强化学习动态调整函数实例的keep-alive时长，在保持较低冷启动率的同时显著降低碳排放。
AI.motivation: Serverless计算简化了云部署，但在管理服务延迟和碳排放方面带来新挑战。减少冷启动延迟需要保留预热函数实例，而最小化碳排放则倾向于回收空闲资源。静态keep-alive策略在时间变化的电网碳强度和不同工作负载模式下效率低下。
AI.method: 提出LACE-RL框架，将Serverless Pod保留问题建模为序贯决策问题，使用深度强化学习动态调整keep-alive时长，联合建模冷启动概率、函数特定延迟成本和实时碳强度。
AI.result: 与华为静态策略相比，LACE-RL减少冷启动51.69%，减少空闲keep-alive碳排放77.08%，在延迟-碳权衡上优于最先进的启发式和单目标基线方法，接近Oracle性能。
AI.conclusion: LACE-RL通过深度强化学习动态调整保持存活时长，有效联合优化了冷启动延迟和碳排放，在华为公共云跟踪数据上验证了优于现有启发式和单目标基线方法的性能，接近Oracle表现。

title: HumanMCP: A Human-Like Query Dataset for Evaluating MCP Tool Retrieval Performance
summary: Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers contain a collection of thousands of open-source standardized tools, linking LLMs to external systems; however, existing datasets and benchmarks lack realistic, human-like user queries, remaining a critical gap in evaluating the tool usage and ecosystems of MCP servers. Existing datasets often do contain tool descriptions but fail to represent how different users portray their requests, leading to poor generalization and inflated reliability of certain benchmarks. This paper introduces the first large-scale MCP dataset featuring diverse, high-quality diverse user queries generated specifically to match 2800 tools across 308 MCP servers, developing on the MCP Zero dataset. Each tool is paired with multiple unique user personas that we have generated, to capture varying levels of user intent ranging from precise task requests, and ambiguous, exploratory commands, reflecting the complexity of real-world interaction patterns.

AI.tldr: 本文推出了首个大规模MCP数据集，包含2800个工具和308个MCP服务器的多样化用户查询，通过为每个工具生成多个用户人物画像来模拟真实世界的交互模式。
AI.motivation: 现有数据集和基准测试缺乏真实、类人的用户查询，无法有效评估MCP服务器的工具使用和生态系统，导致泛化能力差且某些基准的可靠性被高估。
AI.method: 在MCP Zero数据集基础上进行扩展，为每个工具生成多个独特的用户人物画像，涵盖从精确任务请求到模糊探索性命令的不同用户意图层次。
AI.result: 构建了首个大规模MCP数据集，包含针对2800个工具和308个MCP服务器的多样化、高质量用户查询，每个工具配备多个独特用户人物画像以反映不同层次的用户意图。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集的引入有望提升MCP服务器工具使用的评估质量，帮助更好地理解和改进LLM在真实场景中的工具调用能力。

title: CACTUSDB: Unlock Co-Optimization Opportunities for SQL and AI/ML Inferences
comment: Accepted to ICDE 2026 as a full research paper
summary: There is a growing demand for supporting inference queries that combine Structured Query Language (SQL) and Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning (AI/ML) model inferences in database systems, to avoid data denormalization and transfer, facilitate management, and alleviate privacy concerns. Co-optimization techniques for executing inference queries in database systems without accuracy loss fall into four categories: (O1) Relational algebra optimization treating AI/ML models as black-box user-defined functions (UDFs); (O2) Factorized AI/ML inferences; (O3) Tensor-relational transformation; and (O4) General cross-optimization techniques. However, we found none of the existing database systems support all these techniques simultaneously, resulting in suboptimal performance. In this work, we identify two key challenges to address the above problem: (1) the difficulty of unifying all co-optimization techniques that involve disparate data and computation abstractions in one system; and (2) the lack of an optimizer that can effectively explore the exponential search space. To address these challenges, we present CactusDB, a novel system built atop Velox - a high-performance, UDF-centric database engine, open-sourced by Meta. CactusDB features a three-level Intermediate Representations (IR) that supports relational operators, expression operators, and ML functions to enable flexible optimization of arbitrary sub-computations. Additionally, we propose a novel Monte-Carlo Tree Search (MCTS)-based optimizer with query embedding, co-designed with our unique three-level IR, enabling shared and reusable optimization knowledge across different queries. Evaluation of 12 representative inference workloads and 2,000 randomly generated inference queries on well-known datasets, such as MovieLens and TPCx-AI, shows that CactusDB achieves up to 441 times speedup compared to alternative systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了CactusDB，一个在Velox基础上构建的新型数据库系统，用于支持SQL与AI/ML模型推理的联合查询优化。该系统采用三层中间表示(IR)和基于蒙特卡洛树搜索(MCTS)的优化器来解决现有系统无法同时支持多种联合优化技术的难题。
AI.motivation: 随着在数据库系统中支持结合SQL和AI/ML模型推理的查询需求日益增长，现有数据库系统无法同时支持四类联合优化技术(O1-O4)，导致性能次优。这些需求旨在避免数据去规范化、便于管理并缓解隐私问题。
AI.method: 提出三层中间表示(IR)架构，支持关系运算符、表达式运算符和ML函数，以实现任意子计算的灵活优化。同时设计了一种基于蒙特卡洛树搜索(MCTS)的查询优化器，与三层IR协同设计，实现跨不同查询的共享和可重用优化知识。
AI.result: 在12个代表性推理工作负载和2000个随机生成的推理查询上评估，使用MovieLens和TPCx-AI等知名数据集，CactusDB相比替代系统实现了最高441倍的加速。
AI.conclusion: CactusDB成功解决了统一多种联合优化技术和有效探索指数级搜索空间两大挑战，为数据库系统中的AI/ML推理查询提供了高效、可扩展的解决方案。

title: SGAgent: Suggestion-Guided LLM-Based Multi-Agent Framework for Repository-Level Software Repair
summary: The rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs) has led to the emergence of intelligent agents capable of autonomously interacting with environments and invoking external tools. Recently, agent-based software repair approaches have received widespread attention, as repair agents can automatically analyze and localize bugs, generate patches, and achieve state-of-the-art performance on repository-level benchmarks. However, existing approaches usually adopt a localize-then-fix paradigm, jumping directly from "where the bug is" to "how to fix it", leaving a fundamental reasoning gap. To this end, we propose SGAgent, a Suggestion-Guided multi-Agent framework for repository-level software repair, which follows a localize-suggest-fix paradigm. SGAgent introduces a suggestion phase to strengthen the transition from localization to repair. The suggester starts from the buggy locations and incrementally retrieves relevant context until it fully understands the bug, and then provides actionable repair suggestions. Moreover, we construct a Knowledge Graph from the target repository and develop a KG-based toolkit to enhance SGAgent's global contextual awareness and repository-level reasoning. Three specialized sub-agents (i.e., localizer, suggester, and fixer) collaborate to achieve automated end-to-end software repair. Experimental results on SWE-Bench show that SGAgent with Claude-3.5 achieves 51.3% repair accuracy, 81.2% file-level and 52.4% function-level localization accuracy with an average cost of $1.48 per instance, outperforming all baselines using the same base model. Furthermore, SGAgent attains 48% accuracy on VUL4J and VJBench for vulnerability repair, demonstrating strong generalization across tasks and programming languages.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SGAgent，一个基于建议指导的多智能体框架，用于仓库级软件修复。该框架采用"定位-建议-修复"范式，通过引入建议阶段来弥合从bug定位到修复的推理鸿沟，并结合知识图谱增强全局上下文感知能力。
AI.motivation: 现有基于智能体的软件修复方法通常采用"定位-修复"范式，直接从"bug在哪里"跳转到"如何修复"，缺少推理过程，存在根本性的推理鸿沟。
AI.method: 提出SGAgent框架，采用"定位-建议-修复"三阶段范式。具体包括：(1) 建议阶段：从bug位置开始增量检索相关上下文直至完全理解bug，提供可操作的修复建议；(2) 从目标仓库构建知识图谱，开发基于KG的工具包以增强全局上下文感知和仓库级推理能力；(3) 三个专业化子智能体协作：定位器(Localizer)、建议器(Suggester)和修复器(Fixer)。
AI.result: 在SWE-Bench上，SGAgent使用Claude-3.5达到51.3%修复准确率、81.2%文件级和52.4%函数级定位准确率，平均每个实例成本$1.48，优于使用相同基础模型的所有基线方法。在VUL4J和VJBench上达到48%漏洞修复准确率，展示了跨任务和编程语言的强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: SGAgent通过引入建议阶段和知识图谱增强，有效弥合了bug定位与修复之间的推理鸿沟，在仓库级软件修复任务上取得了最先进的性能，且具有良好跨任务泛化能力。

title: Detoxifying LLMs via Representation Erasure-Based Preference Optimization
summary: Large language models (LLMs) trained on webscale data can produce toxic outputs, raising concerns for safe deployment. Prior defenses, based on applications of DPO, NPO, and similar algorithms, reduce the likelihood of harmful continuations, but not robustly so: they are vulnerable to adversarial prompting and easily undone by fine-tuning-based relearning attacks. Indeed, research has shown that these edits to the model are superficial: linear probing reveals that harmful "directions" remain present in representations. To address this, we propose Representation Erasure-based Preference Optimization (REPO), reformulating detoxification as a token-level preference problem. Using a novel objective with preference data, we force the representations of toxic continuations to converge toward their benign counterparts. Our mechanistic analysis reveals that this granular approach is critical: unlike baselines, REPO induces deep, localized edits to toxicity-encoding neurons while preserving general model utility. Exhaustive evaluations show that REPO achieves state-of-the-art robustness, stopping sophisticated threats-including relearning attacks and enhanced GCG jailbreaks-where existing representation- and output-based methods fail.

AI.tldr: 本文提出REPO（表征擦除偏好优化），将LLM解毒重新定义为token级偏好问题，通过偏好数据强制毒性表示向良性表示收敛，实现对毒性编码神经元的深层、局部化编辑，在对抗性提示、重学习攻击和增强的GCG越狱等复杂威胁下达到最先进的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于DPO、NPO等算法的防御方法不能鲁棒地抵抗对抗性提示和微调重学习攻击，因为这些编辑是表面性的，线性探测显示有害"方向"仍然存在于表示中。
AI.method: 提出REPO，将解毒重新定义为token级偏好问题，使用带有偏好数据的新型目标函数，强制毒性 continuation 的表示向良性对应物收敛。
AI.result: REPO在对抗性提示、重学习攻击和增强GCG越狱等多种复杂威胁下实现了最先进的鲁棒性，优于现有的基于表示和输出方法。
AI.conclusion: REPO通过细粒度的token级方法诱导了对毒性编码神经元的深层、局部化编辑，同时保留了模型的通用能力，为LLM安全部署提供了有效的解毒方案。

title: Optimization of Edge Directions and Weights for Mixed Guidance Graphs in Lifelong Multi-Agent Path Finding
summary: Multi-Agent Path Finding (MAPF) aims to move agents from their start to goal vertices on a graph. Lifelong MAPF (LMAPF) continuously assigns new goals to agents as they complete current ones. To guide agents' movement in LMAPF, prior works have proposed Guidance Graph Optimization (GGO) methods to optimize a guidance graph, which is a bidirected weighted graph whose directed edges represent moving and waiting actions with edge weights being action costs. Higher edge weights represent higher action costs. However, edge weights only provide soft guidance. An edge with a high weight only discourages agents from using it, instead of prohibiting agents from traversing it. In this paper, we explore the need to incorporate edge directions optimization into GGO, providing strict guidance. We generalize GGO to Mixed Guidance Graph Optimization (MGGO), presenting two MGGO methods capable of optimizing both edge weights and directions. The first optimizes edge directions and edge weights in two phases separately. The second applies Quality Diversity algorithms to optimize a neural network capable of generating edge directions and weights. We also incorporate traffic patterns relevant to edge directions into a GGO method, making it capable of generating edge-direction-aware guidance graphs.

AI.tldr: 本文将已有的 Guidance Graph Optimization（GGO，仅优化边权、属"软引导"）扩展为 Mixed Guidance Graph Optimization（MGGO），同时优化边权重与边方向（"硬引导"，可禁止某些方向以避免迎头碰撞）。提出两阶段 MGGO-DS（先用 (1+λ) EA 优化方向，再用 CMA-ES 优化权重）、基于 CMA-MAE 的 QD 联合 MGGO-PU（CNN 更新模型同时输出权重与方向）、Edge-Direction-Aware GGO-PU，以及快速强连通修复算法 ERS。在旋转运动模型下，MGGO 方法在 PIBT/RHCR 上普遍超过 GGO-DS、Directed Crisscross 与无引导基线，方向引导对规则型规划器（PIBT）收益尤为明显（减少旋转动作），对搜索型（RHCR）收益有限。
AI.motivation: LMAPF（终身多智能体路径规划）常被分解为一系列 MAPF 子问题求解，路径规划具有"近视性"，易造成交通拥塞。已有 GGO 方法通过优化引导图（双向加权图）的边权来引导智能体移动，但边权只提供软引导：高权重仅"劝阻"而非"禁止"通行，智能体若绕行代价更高仍会使用该边，从而在同一条边上产生相向而行的迎头碰撞（head-on collision）。在旋转运动模型（rotation motion model，比全向移动的 pebble motion model 更贴近真实仓储/分拣机器人）下，绕行还需额外旋转动作，代价更高，冲突代价被放大。此外，边方向优化并非平凡问题：必须保证图的强连通性（否则智能体不可达），且过度阻断边会迫使绕路、降低效率，需权衡"减少冲突"与"缩短路径"。此前 MAPF 领域尚无针对边方向优化的工作；城市交通/多AGV中的强网络定向问题（SNOP）所用 MILP、分支定界、邻域搜索等方法无法扩展到上千顶点的大图、且不以吞吐量为目标、且强连通性约束处理低效。
AI.method: 1) 问题形式化：定义混合引导图 G_mg(V, E_mg, ω_mg)——非桥边可取单向或双向，桥边强制双向，另有自环（等待/旋转）；MGGO 目标为在强连通约束与权重上下界下最大化目标函数（如吞吐）。规划时将 MAPF 目标从 sum-of-cost 改为混合引导图上的动作代价和。2) ERS（Edge Reversal Search）：贪心修复强连通性。先为所有桥补齐双向边；用 Tarjan 求 SCC，若 SCC>1 则构建缩点 DAG，找入度为 0 的源元顶点 η，随机反转其一半出边（证明 |E_out|≥2，故 |E_rev|≥1），迭代直至单 SCC；每轮 O(|E|+|V|)，虽非完备但经验上总成功，且远快于 MILP。3) 两阶段 MGGO-DS：阶段一用 (1+λ) EA 优化方向（二值决策变量指定每条非桥边方向；初始化含推广的 directed Crisscross、DFS、随机三种；变异含 k-edges、k-vertices、random-cycle 三种，各占批次 1/3），每次候选图先经 ERS 修复再跑 LMAPF 仿真评估；阶段二对已定方向的图用 GGO-DS（CMA-ES）优化边权。4) QD 联合 MGGO-PU：用 CMA-MAE 优化一个 CNN 更新模型，模型输入预计算交通模式张量 [H,W,2·7·N_obs+2·9] 与初始引导图，输出 [H,W,11]（5 通道权重 + 6 通道方向）；方向输入用"独立表示"[H,W,4]、输出用"相关表示"[H,W,6]（东西/南北方向 one-hot：单向/反向/双向），保证输出始终有效；两个目标 f_opt = f_res + α·Δ（Δ 为 ERS 反转边比例，作为正则项鼓励模型直接生成强连通图）与 f_res（平均吞吐），以"单向边比例"作为多样性度量。5) Edge-Direction-Aware GGO-PU：用 CMA-ES 优化同类更新模型，但交通模式来自 directed Crisscross 混合图，使模型"理解"单向边的引导作用。实验采用旋转运动模型、RHCR(w=5,h=2,PBS+SIPP) 与 PIBT，8 种设置（random-32-32-20、warehouse-33-36、empty-48-48、room-64-64-8、den312d），N_eval=20,000（两阶段为 5,000/15,000）。
AI.result: 在 PIBT 的 8 个设置中，所提方法始终有某一方法取得最高吞吐，但最优者因设置而异：Two-Phase MGGO-DS 在 random-32-32-20、room-64-64-8、den312d 最佳（最大化单向边显著降低旋转动作比例，代价是等待比例略增）；QD 联合 MGGO-PU 在 warehouse-33-36 最佳；empty-48-48 上仅优化权重的 Edge-Direction-Aware GGO-PU 更优（空间宽敞便于协同）。Edge-Direction-Aware GGO-PU 在多数地图上超过 GGO-DS（如 setup 6：19.39 vs 10.34，setup 3：20.81 vs 18.44），说明引入方向相关信息对 GGO 有价值。RHCR 下方向优化帮助有限（最优低层规划器本身倾向避开高代价边），但 Edge-Direction-Aware GGO-PU 在 setup 1/3 仍最优（如 4.93 vs 4.69、20.81 vs 18.44）；setup 2 中 QD 联合 MGGO-PU 最优（5.11 vs 2.07）。基线对比：Directed Crisscross 与 No Guidance 明显更差（如 setup 2 中 Directed Crisscross 成功率仅 0%）。消融：QD+Joint MGGO-PU 吞吐 4.42 优于 CMA-ES 版本 4.26 与独立方向表示版本 4.18；MGGO-DS 阶段一（4.07）优于 Bi-Dir 变体（3.93）与单一变异算子变体（3.86/3.90），说明双向选项无用、多种变异算子有益。ERS vs MILP：ERS 反转边更多（解质量差）但运行快得多，>3000 顶点图上 MILP 1 分钟内成功率降至约 60%，ERS 保持 100%。附带发现：旋转模型下 PIBT 在非双连通地图上按"到目标距离"排优先级优于按"距上次到达目标时间"，可显著减少死锁/活锁；QD 找到的混合图约 70% 为有向边，而 CMA-ES 版本仅 14%，这也是 QD 减少旋转动作的原因。
AI.conclusion: MGGO 将 GGO 推广为同时优化边方向与边权重的混合引导图优化问题，ERS 提供高效的强连通性修复手段，方向感知的 GGO 进一步增强了引导质量，实验证明所提方法整体优于现有 GGO 方法与人工设计基线，建立 LMAPF 引导的新 SOTA。核心洞见：边方向（硬引导）对规则型规划器（PIBT）更有利，主要通过减少旋转动作起作用；对搜索型方法（RHCR）收益较有限，因为权重优化已足够。MGGO 并非在所有情况下都优于所有 GGO 变体，原因在于复杂度提升导致样本效率下降；未来可借助代理模型（surrogate modeling）提升样本效率。

title: Data Driven Optimization of GPU efficiency for Distributed LLM Adapter Serving
comment: journal extension of the workshop paper titled as "A data-driven ml approach for maximizing performance in llm-adapter serving"
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) adapters enable low-cost model specialization, but introduce complex caching and scheduling challenges in distributed serving systems where hundreds of adapters must be hosted concurrently. While prior work has largely focused on latency minimization, resource efficiency through throughput maximization remains underexplored. This paper presents a data-driven pipeline that, for a given workload, computes an adapter placement that serves the workload with the minimum number of GPUs while avoiding request starvation and GPU memory errors. To that end, the approach identifies the maximum feasible throughput attainable on each GPU by leveraging accurate performance predictions learned from real serving behavior. The proposed pipeline integrates three components: (i) a Digital Twin (DT) tailored to LLM-adapter serving, (ii) a distilled machine learning (ML) model trained on DT-generated data, and (iii) a greedy placement algorithm that exploits ML-based performance estimates to maximize GPU efficiency. The DT emulates real system dynamics with high fidelity, achieving below 5% throughput estimation error while executing up to 90 times faster than full LLM benchmarking across both predictable and unpredictable workloads. The learned ML models further accelerate performance estimation with marginal accuracy degradation, enabling scalable optimization. Experimental results demonstrate that the pipeline substantially improves GPU efficiency by reducing the number of GPUs required to sustain target workloads. Beyond GPU efficiency, the pipeline can be adapted to alternative objectives, such as latency minimization, highlighting its versatility for future large-scale LLM serving infrastructures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种数据驱动的管道，用于在分布式LLM适配器服务系统中计算适配器放置策略，以最少的GPU数量实现目标吞吐量，同时避免请求饥饿和GPU内存错误。该管道集成了数字孪生、蒸馏ML模型和贪心放置算法。
AI.motivation: 尽管LLM适配器支持低成本的模型专业化，但在大规模分布式服务系统中引入了复杂的缓存和调度挑战。现有工作主要关注延迟最小化，而资源效率（以吞吐量最大化衡量）仍未得到充分探索。
AI.method: 提出包含三个组件的数据驱动管道：(1) 针对LLM适配器服务定制的数字孪生(DT)；(2) 基于DT生成数据训练的蒸馏机器学习模型；(3) 利用ML性能估计最大化GPU效率的贪心放置算法。DT高精度模拟真实系统动态，ML模型进一步加速性能估计。
AI.result: DT实现了低于5%的吞吐量估计误差，执行速度比完整LLM基准测试快达90倍。实验表明该管道显著提升GPU效率，减少维持目标工作负载所需的GPU数量。该管道还可适配于延迟最小化等其他目标。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过结合数字孪生、蒸馏ML模型和贪心放置算法，有效解决了LLM适配器分布式服务中的资源效率问题，为大规模LLM服务基础设施提供了灵活且高效的解决方案。

title: An Agentic LLM Framework for Adverse Media Screening in AML Compliance
summary: Adverse media screening is a critical component of anti-money laundering (AML) and know-your-customer (KYC) compliance processes in financial institutions. Traditional approaches rely on keyword-based searches that generate high false-positive rates or require extensive manual review. We present an agentic system that leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to automate adverse media screening. Our system implements a multi-step approach where an LLM agent searches the web, retrieves and processes relevant documents, and computes an Adverse Media Index (AMI) score for each subject. We evaluate our approach using multiple LLM backends on a dataset comprising Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs), persons from regulatory watchlists, and sanctioned persons from OpenSanctions and clean names from academic sources, demonstrating the system's ability to distinguish between high-risk and low-risk individuals.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于大语言模型（LLM）与检索增强生成（RAG）的智能体（agentic）系统，用于自动化负面新闻（adverse media）筛查：智能体自主进行网络搜索、抓取并处理相关文档，并为每名受筛查对象计算“负面媒体指数”（AMI）分数。作者在包含政治公众人物（PEPs）、监管观察名单人员、OpenSanctions 制裁人员以及学术来源的清洁姓名（clean names）构成的数据集上，用多个 LLM 后端进行了评估，显示系统能够区分高风险与低风险个体。
AI.motivation: 反洗钱（AML）与了解你的客户（KYC）合规流程中，负面媒体筛查是关键环节。传统方法依赖关键词匹配检索，存在两个主要缺陷：一是泛匹配的关键词搜索导致很高的误报率（false-positive rate），二是需要大量人工复核，效率低、成本高。同时合规场景要求可解释、可追溯的判定依据与可量化的风险分数，而非黑箱式判断。因此需要一种能理解语义、跨源检索并给出结构化风险度量的自动化方案。
AI.method: 系统采用多步骤（multi-step）智能体流程：(1) LLM 智能体根据待筛查主体的姓名及上下文信息生成查询并在开放网络上执行搜索；(2) 检索并抓取候选网页/文档（相关文档的提取与处理）；(3) 由 LLM 对文档内容进行判定与归因，区分负面信息是否确实指向该主体（同名消歧）；(4) 将各类信号聚合并计算 Adverse Media Index（AMI）分数，作为该主体的风险度量与输出依据。检索过程结合 RAG 以引入外部证据并缓解模型幻觉。实验使用多个 LLM 后端进行对比评测；数据集由四类构成：PEP（政治公众人物）、来自监管观察名单的人员、OpenSanctions 数据库中的受制裁人员，以及来自学术来源的干净姓名作为负样本（干净对照集），从而覆盖高风险与低风险两极。
AI.result: 在上述数据集上，使用多个 LLM 后端的评测表明，该智能体系统能够有效区分高风险个体（PEP、监管观察名单人员、被制裁人员）与低风险个体（干净姓名），即 AMI 分数与真实风险标签具有良好区分能力，说明 LLM+RAG 的多步检索与打分流程可替代部分关键词搜索与人工复核，缓解高误报问题。
AI.conclusion: 将 LLM 智能体与 RAG 结合应用于负面媒体筛查是可行且有前景的：多步的“搜索—取回—处理—打分”流程能够自动化 AML/KYC 中的开放式风险筛查，并以可解释的连续分数（AMI）取代二元关键词命中，显著降低人工审核负担。后续工作方向包括：在更大更多样的名单数据上验证、扩展语言与信息源覆盖、改进同名消歧与文档归因精度，以及将 AMI 作为既有合规流程中的辅助信号而非最终裁决依据，同时需评估偏差、鲁棒性与成本。

title: OceanBase Bacchus: a High-Performance and Scalable Cloud-Native Shared Storage Architecture for Multi-Cloud
summary:
Although an increasing number of databases now embrace shared-storage architectures, current storage-disaggregated systems have yet to strike an optimal balance between cost and performance. In high-concurrency read/write scenarios, B+-tree-based shared storage struggles to efficiently absorb frequent in-place updates. Existing LSM-tree-backed disaggregated storage designs are hindered by the intricate implementation of cross-node shared-log mechanisms, where no satisfactory solution yet exists.
  This paper presents OceanBase Bacchus, an LSM-tree architecture tailored for object storage provided by cloud vendors. The system sustains high-performance reads and writes while rendering compute nodes stateless through shared service-oriented PALF (Paxos-backed Append-only Log File system) logging and asynchronous background services. We employ a Shared Block Cache Service to flexibly utilize cache resources. Our design places log synchronization into a shared service, providing a novel solution for log sharing in storage-compute-separated databases. The architecture decouples functionality across modules, enabling elastic scaling where compute, cache, and storage resources can be resized rapidly and independently. Through experimental evaluation using multiple benchmark tests, including SysBench and TPC-H, we confirm that OceanBase Bacchus achieves performance comparable to or superior to that of HBase in OLTP scenarios and significantly outperforms StarRocks in OLAP workloads. Leveraging Bacchus's support for multi-cloud deployment and consistent performance, we not only retain high availability and competitive performance but also achieve substantial reductions in storage costs by 59% in OLTP scenarios and 89% in OLAP scenarios.

AI.tldr: OceanBase Bacchus（OceanBase 4.4.x）提出并实现了一套面向云厂商对象存储的 LSM-tree 共享存储架构，通过服务化 PALF 共享日志（解决跨节点日志共享难题）、三层多级缓存（内存/本地持久化缓存/分布式共享块缓存）与异步后台服务（压实、DDL、GC）实现存储-计算解耦与计算节点无状态化；在 OLTP 上性能与 HBase 相当或更优、OLAP 上显著超越 StarRocks（TPC-H 100GB 快约 48.5%），同时把存储副本从 3 份降为 1 份，OLTP 存储成本下降 59%、OLAP 下降 89%，并支持 AWS/阿里云/本地 MinIO 的多云部署。
AI.motivation: 当前数据库普遍转向共享存储架构，但在成本与性能之间尚未取得最优平衡：(1) B+-tree 共享存储在高并发读写下难以吸收频繁的原地更新，随机 I/O、页分裂与树平衡调整导致写冲突与性能退化；(2) LSM-tree 分离式存储的瓶颈在于跨节点共享日志机制缺乏满意方案——直接将日志持久化到持久介质延迟高，而依赖日志复制又带来一致性与扩展性问题，阻碍了 LSM-tree 在共享存储中的落地；(3) 云厂商对象存储（如 AWS S3、阿里云 OSS）比传统云盘便宜约 85%，但其高延迟与有限 IOPS 与 OLTP 毫秒级响应需求冲突，现有系统要么回避对象存储、要么只用于冷数据，浪费了大量成本节省空间。作者的目标是构建一套既利用 LSM-tree 写优化特性、能集成低成本对象存储、又能实现计算节点无状态与灵活多云部署的共享存储架构，并以 OLTP 为主要目标场景（历史库、时序、多模型等冷热分离明显的负载），同时兼顾 OLAP/HTAP。
AI.method:
系统架构分为数据库层（内存缓存、本地持久化缓存）与共享存储层（共享服务层、对象存储），关键设计与机制包括：
1. **服务化共享日志（Shared Log / SSLog）**：数据按 log stream 分片，每流单 leader 写入 PALF 服务（LogServer 节点上的 Paxos 共识日志），实现跨集群日志共享、消除日志冗余，并将共识同步从数据库层卸载；PALF 通过批处理与流水线化降低共识往返开销。CLog 先落本地云盘近实时归档以支持 PITR；元数据以 region 级 SSLog（KV 表形式）聚合后异步落对象存储，替代昂贵的共享存储随机 I/O。
2. **多级缓存与预热**：内存缓存（micro-block 与索引）、本地持久化缓存（数据缓存/预取/预热/写缓存）、分布式 Shared Block Cache Service（BlockServer 存 macro-block，只读、AZ 内共享）；本地 micro-block 采用 ARC 替换（LRU/LFU 主体在本地、ghost 列表在对象存储）；提供基线切换、主备切换、副本迁移、云盘扩缩容四类预热；缓存失效通过 SSLog 协调（内存 write-through，本地/分布式 write-back，分布式缓存采用版本号失效）。
3. **增量与压实**：micro/mini compaction（micro SSTable）快速推进日志 checkpoint、加速恢复与扩缩容；minor compaction 复用 macro-block 控制写放大；每日/阈值触发的 Major Compaction 主要在共享存储层执行，RS 负责调度与 CRC 校验一致性；压实任务可进一步卸载到空闲计算节点（利用共享元数据/事务表/增量数据计算），实现存算二次分离。
4. **元数据管理**：按节点/租户/log stream/tablet 分层，区分 Sys Tenant Cluster 与 User Tenant Cluster；log stream 级以上 write-through、tablet 级以下 write-back；调整 OceanBase 2PC（prepare 生成元数据文件、commit 更新父级文件）；表级变更先写 SSLog 再更新元数据服务，原子操作采用两阶段；每区域一个 SSWriter 统一写入共享 tablet 元数据。
5. **复制迁移**：基线数据直接共享自共享存储、增量与温数据来自分布式缓存，仅复制节点私有数据与最热本地缓存数据；按创建 log stream→选源→离线→空壳 tablet→拷贝私有数据→上线→按 checkpoint SCN 重放→并行拷贝本地缓存→校验→更新成员列表流程执行。
6. **GC 与事务协调**：基于租约（30–60s）的全局 GC 协调（GC Coordinator，租约记录在 SSLog）、安全回收点计算（global min_read_scn 与最小日志重放位点）、先写删除意图再实际删除的两阶段协议、指数退避租约续约；跨分区事务用 OceanBase 2PC 协调，长事务通过 read SCN 可见性机制与超时中止/提升处理，避免阻塞 GC。
7. **多云支持**：兼容 S3 接口（AWS S3、阿里云 OSS、Azure Blob、MinIO），每个集群/租户独立 bucket 以实现 I/O 隔离与计费；Serverless 化后台任务、Warm Backup Cluster 热备、主备容灾切换。
AI.result: 实验覆盖 SysBench、TPC-H、TPC-DS、ClickBench，并与 HBase 1.4.7、Lindorm/腾讯云 HBase、PolarDB MySQL、Aurora 3.08、TDSQL MySQL、StarRocks 3.3.13 及旧版 OceanBase 4.2.5（Paetica）对比。OLTP：500GB 数据下 Bacchus 与 HBase 平均写吞吐相当（3770.86 vs 3993.79 ops/s），但 HBase 出现间歇性写停顿，Bacchus 借助快速 dump 完全避免写停顿；两节点 PUT 总 TPS 51,612（单节点均值 25,806）领先各 HBase 变体，GET 单节点均值 28,208 QPS 领先，均值延迟仅为旧版 OceanBase 的 41.8%；对比 PolarDB/Aurora/TDSQL 在 32C128G 高并发下吞吐优势明显（Insert/Update 可达 2× 于 Aurora），PolarDB 在 1600 线程时失败而 Bacchus 稳定服务。OLAP：TPC-H 100GB 端到端快约 48.57%（Q14 提升 327.93%，Q9 退化 35.71%），TPC-H 1TB 冷跑提升约 40%，TPC-DS 100GB 提升 43.8%，ClickBench 提升 89%。共享存储 vs 共享无共享架构下吞吐相当，说明外部共享服务延迟被有效控制。生产一周缓存命中率监控显示私有 macro-block 命中率稳定 100%、共享 macro-block 与总命中率接近 100%（仅工作负载切换时短暂下探），HTAP 场景下 OLAP 冷读有意部分回落至对象存储以平衡成本。成本：100TB 下 OLTP 场景 EBS×3（$30,000）→ EBS×1 + S3（$12,300）节省 59%；OLAP 场景（缓存比 10%）→ $3,300，节省 89%。
AI.conclusion: 论文给出面向对象存储的云原生共享存储完整设计与落地实践：自研“LSM-tree + 对象存储”引擎配合服务化 PALF 共享日志、Shared Block Cache Service 与异步后台服务，使计算节点无状态化、存算/缓存/日志/前后台彻底解耦并可独立弹性伸缩；多写者分片模型（对比 Socrates 的单写者）配合 OceanBase 2PC 与 SSLog 元数据集中化，在保持 RPO=0 与 ACID 的同时提升写扩展性。实验表明该架构在 OLTP 上不劣于专用共享存储系统、在 OLAP 上优于专用分析引擎，并借助对象存储单副本带来 59%/89% 的存储成本下降，支持多云部署避免厂商锁定。作者同时总结实践教训：对象存储 IOPS/带宽受限需聚合小对象与批量 I/O、按集群/租户分桶、多种解耦策略并重、日志服务是无状态与 RPO=0 的关键、本地 micro-block 与共享 macro-block 组合、多种命中率提升手段、基于日志服务的分层集中元数据管理可显著简化实现并优化快照功能。作者将其定位为多云原生、面向 OLTP/OLAP/KV 的低成本共享存储方案的开源第一步（代码以木兰宽松许可证 2.0 发布于 GitHub/Gitee，OceanBase 4.4.x）。

title: Peeling Off the Cocoon: Unveiling Suppressed Golden Seeds for Mutational Greybox Fuzzing
summary: PoCo is a technique that aims to enhance modern coverage-based seed selection (CSS) techniques (such as afl-cmin) by gradually removing obstacle conditional statements and conducting deeper seed selection.

AI.tldr: PoCo通过逐步移除障碍条件语句并进行更深入的种子选择，增强现代基于覆盖率的种子选择(CSS)技术（如afl-cmin）。
AI.motivation: 基于覆盖率的种子选择（CSS）技术在fuzzing测试中存在局限性，需要进一步增强以提高测试效率和覆盖率。
AI.method: 通过逐步移除障碍条件语句并进行更深度的种子选择来增强CSS技术。
AI.result: 提升了现代覆盖率-based种子选择技术的效果。
AI.conclusion: PoCo技术能够有效增强现有CSS方法的性能，提高fuzzing测试的覆盖率和效率。

title: U-CAN: Utility-Aware Contrastive Attenuation for Efficient Unlearning in Generative Recommendation
summary: Generative Recommendation (GenRec) typically leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to redefine personalization as an instruction-driven sequence generation task. However, fine-tuning on user logs inadvertently encodes sensitive attributes into model parameters, raising critical privacy concerns. Existing Machine Unlearning (MU) techniques struggle to navigate this tension due to the Polysemy Dilemma, where neurons superimpose sensitive data with general reasoning patterns, leading to catastrophic utility loss under traditional gradient or pruning methods. To address this, we propose Utility-aware Contrastive AttenuatioN (U-CAN), a precision unlearning framework that operates on low-rank adapters. U-CAN quantifies risk by contrasting activations and focuses on neurons with asymmetric responses that are highly sensitive to the forgetting set but suppressed on the retention set. To safeguard performance, we introduce a utility-aware calibration mechanism that combines weight magnitudes with retention-set activation norms, assigning higher utility scores to dimensions that contribute strongly to retention performance. Unlike binary pruning, which often fragments network structure, U-CAN develop adaptive soft attenuation with a differentiable decay function to selectively down-scale high-risk parameters on LoRA adapters, suppressing sensitive retrieval pathways and preserving the topological connectivity of reasoning circuits. Experiments on two public datasets across seven metrics demonstrate that U-CAN achieves strong privacy forgetting, utility retention, and computational efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出U-CAN框架，通过低秩适配器上的 utility-aware 对比衰减机制，在保护推荐模型推理能力的同时实现隐私属性的有针对性遗忘，解决机器学习中敏感数据编码与模型效用之间的矛盾。
AI.motivation: 生成式推荐系统(GenRec)使用大语言模型通过指令驱动的方式进行序列生成，但微调过程中会将用户日志中的敏感属性编码到模型参数中，引发隐私问题。传统机器遗忘(MU)技术面临多义性困境(Polysemy Dilemma)：神经元将敏感数据与通用推理模式叠加，导致传统梯度或剪枝方法会造成严重的效用损失。
AI.method: 提出Utility-aware Contrastive AttenuatioN (U-CAN)框架：1)基于对比激活量化风险，聚焦遗忘集高敏感、保留集被抑制的非对称响应神经元；2)引入utility-aware校准机制，结合权重幅度与保留集激活范数，为对保留性能贡献大的维度分配更高utility分数；3)开发自适应软衰减机制，使用可微分衰减函数选择性降低LoRA适配器上高风险参数的权重，抑制敏感检索通路同时保留推理回路的拓扑连通性。
AI.result: 在两个公开数据集上针对七个指标的实验表明，U-CAN实现了强隐私遗忘、utility保留和计算效率的统一。
AI.conclusion: U-CAN通过在低秩适配器上实施precision unlearning，有效解决了Polysemy Dilemma，在保护模型推理能力的同时实现了敏感属性的选择性遗忘，为生成式推荐系统的隐私保护提供了新思路。

title: A Novel Hierarchical Multi-Agent System for Payments Using LLMs
comment: 12 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables. Accepted at PAKDD 2026
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents, such as OpenAI's Operator and Claude's Computer Use, can automate workflows but unable to handle payment tasks. Existing agentic solutions have gained significant attention; however, even the latest approaches face challenges in implementing end-to-end agentic payment workflows. To address this gap, this research proposes the Hierarchical Multi-Agent System for Payments (HMASP), which provides an end-to-end agentic method for completing payment workflows. The proposed HMASP leverages either open-weight or proprietary LLMs and employs a modular architecture consisting of the Conversational Payment Agent (CPA - first agent level), Supervisor agents (second agent level), Routing agents (third agent level), and the Process summary agent (fourth agent level). The CPA serves as the central entry point, handling all external requests and coordinating subsequent tasks across hierarchical levels. HMASP incorporates architectural patterns that enable modular task execution across agents and levels for payment operations, including shared state variables, decoupled message states, and structured handoff protocols that facilitate coordination across agents and workflows. Experimental results demonstrate the feasibility of the proposed HMASP. To our knowledge, HMASP is the first LLM-based multi-agent system to implement end-to-end agentic payment workflows. This work lays a foundation for extending agentic capabilities into the payment domain.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HMASP（支付分层多智能体系统），用四层架构（对话支付代理CPA、Supervisor代理、Routing代理、流程摘要代理）实现端到端的LLM智能体支付工作流，并以实验验证其可行性，据称是首个LLM多智能体支付系统。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体（如OpenAI Operator、Claude Computer Use）已能自动化众多工作流，却无法处理支付类任务；即便最新的智能体方案，在端到端的支付工作流实现上仍面临架构协调、跨代理状态共享与流程衔接等工程难题，因此需要一个专门面向支付域的分层多智能体架构来填补该空白。
AI.method: 提出Hierarchical Multi-Agent System for Payments (HMASP)：以CPA为统一外部入口接收并协调请求，第二层为Supervisor代理，第三层为Routing代理，第四层为Process summary代理，形成可扩展的分层模块化执行结构。系统可搭载开源权重或商用闭源LLM，并引入三种关键架构模式——共享状态变量（shared state variables）、解耦的消息状态（decoupled message states）与结构化交接协议（structured handoff protocols）——以支持跨代理、跨层级的任务协调与工作流状态管理，从而实现支付流程的模块化端到端自动执行。
AI.result: 实验结果表明HMASP能够成功完成端到端的智能体支付工作流，验证了该分层架构在支付场景下的可行性与有效性。
AI.conclusion: HMASP是（作者所知）首个基于LLM的多智能体支付系统，证明了将智能体能力扩展到支付域的技术路径可行，为后续支付领域智能体能力的构建奠定了基础；但系统仍依赖既有LLM的支付相关能力，真实环境下的安全性、鲁棒性与规模化评估有待进一步深入。

title: nvidia-pcm: A D-Bus-Driven Platform Configuration Manager for OpenBMC Environments
summary: GPU-accelerated server platforms that share most of their hardware architecture often require separate firmware images due to minor hardware differences--different component identifiers, thermal profiles, or interconnect topologies. I built nvidia-pcm to eliminate that overhead. nvidia-pcm is a platform configuration manager for NVBMC, NVIDIA's OpenBMC-based firmware distribution, that enables a single firmware image to serve multiple platform variants. At boot, nvidia-pcm queries hardware identity data over D-Bus and exports the correct platform-specific configuration as environment variables. Downstream services read those variables without knowing or caring which hardware variant they are running on. The result is that platform differences are captured entirely in declarative JSON files, not in separate build artifacts. This paper describes the architecture, implementation, and deployment impact of nvidia-pcm, and shares lessons learned from solving the platform-identity problem at a deliberately minimal level of abstraction--prioritizing adoption simplicity over comprehensive hardware modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍 nvidia-pcm：NVIDIA NVBMC（基于 OpenBMC 的固件分发）上的平台配置管理器。它在开机阶段通过 D-Bus 查询硬件身份信息，并从声明式 JSON 中选择对应的平台配置，以环境变量形式导出，使单一固件镜像可同时服务多个硬件变体；平台差异不再体现为独立的构建产物。
AI.motivation: GPU 加速服务器平台之间硬件架构高度相似，但存在细微差异（器件/物料标识、热设计配置、互连拓扑等）。传统做法要求为每个平台变体分别编译、烧写和维护独立固件镜像，导致：固件分支与版本矩阵爆炸、构建与发布流水线复杂化、补丁与安全更新需逐变体同步、现场排障与现场升级（field update）成本高。本文目标是消除该重复开销，实现"一份固件、多平台复用"。
AI.method: 核心思路为把"平台识别"与"平台配置选择"在启动早期解耦，并以刻意最小化的抽象层级实现。具体设计包括：(1) 平台身份采集——开机时通过 D-Bus 向 BMC 侧查询硬件身份数据（组件标识等）；(2) 声明式配置——所有平台差异以 JSON 文件描述，按身份数据映射到具体配置内容（热策略、器件标识、互连参数等）；(3) 配置导出——将选中的平台专属配置以环境变量形式注入运行环境；(4) 下游消费——各系统服务直接读取环境变量，无需包含任何硬件变体判定逻辑或条件编译分支，从而保持服务侧代码与平台无关。实现载体为 NVBMC（NVIDIA 的 OpenBMC 派生固件发行版），以 D-Bus 作为身份数据通道、以环境变量作为配置传递机制，整体不引入复杂的硬件建模层。
AI.result: 部署影响方面：单一固件镜像即可覆盖多个平台变体，平台差异完全收敛到声明式 JSON 配置文件中，不再产生按平台分支的构建产物；下游服务实现保持统一，硬件变体信息对其透明；新增或变更平台配置只需增改 JSON 与对应身份数据，无需重新构建固件，从而降低构建/发布复杂度与维护矩阵规模。作者同时强调该方案刻意选择"最小抽象、优先保证可采用性"的定位，而非追求完备的硬件建模能力。
AI.conclusion: 结论是：平台身份问题可以在极低抽象层级上有效解决——通过"启动期一次性识别 + 声明式配置 + 环境变量传递"的三段式流水线，即可用单一固件覆盖多平台变体，并将硬件差异从代码/构建产物转化为数据。本文总结了相关架构、实现与部署经验，主张在企业内嵌固件生态中，工具的可采用性、部署简单度与生态兼容性往往比抽象的完备性与建模的严格性更为关键；环境变量作为跨服务传递接口、以 D-Bus 作为身份查询接口，是在 OpenBMC 生态中兼顾实现成本与可移植性的务实选择。

title: Causal Identification from Counterfactual Data: Completeness and Bounding Results
summary: Previous work establishing completeness results for $\textit{counterfactual identification}$ has been circumscribed to the setting where the input data belongs to observational or interventional distributions (Layers 1 and 2 of Pearl's Causal Hierarchy), since it was generally presumed impossible to obtain data from counterfactual distributions, which belong to Layer 3. However, recent work (Raghavan & Bareinboim, 2025) has formally characterized a family of counterfactual distributions which can be directly estimated via experimental methods - a notion they call $\textit{counterfactual realizabilty}$. This leaves open the question of what $\textit{additional}$ counterfactual quantities now become identifiable, given this new access to (some) Layer 3 data. To answer this question, we develop the CTFIDU+ algorithm for identifying counterfactual queries from an arbitrary set of Layer 3 distributions, and prove that it is complete for this task. Building on this, we establish the theoretical limit of which counterfactuals can be identified from physically realizable distributions, thus implying the $\textit{fundamental limit to exact causal inference in the non-parametric setting}$. Finally, given the impossibility of identifying certain critical types of counterfactuals, we derive novel analytic bounds for such quantities using realizable counterfactual data, and corroborate using simulations that counterfactual data helps tighten the bounds for non-identifiable quantities in practice.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了基于可实现反事实分布（Layer 3数据）的反事实查询识别问题。提出CTFIDU+算法并证明其完备性，确定了非参数情况下精确因果推断的基本极限，并对不可识别量导出新的分析边界。
AI.motivation: 虽然已有研究建立了反事实识别的完备性结果，但仅限于观察数据（Layer 1）和干预数据（Layer 2）。Raghavan & Bareinboim (2025)提出的"反事实可实现性"使得部分Layer 3数据可直接通过实验估计，从而引发一个问题：给定这种新的Layer 3数据访问能力，哪些额外的反事实量变得可识别？
AI.method: 开发CTFIDU+算法从任意Layer 3分布集合中识别反事实查询，并证明其完备性；在此基础上建立从物理可实现分布可识别的反事实的理论极限；对不可识别的关键反事实类型，利用可实现反事实数据推导新的分析边界，并通过模拟验证反事实数据有助于收窄边界。
AI.result: CTFIDU+算法对反事实识别任务是完备的；确立了非参数情况下精确因果推断的基本极限；反事实数据能够收窄不可识别量的边界。
AI.conclusion: 研究回答了在获得部分反事实数据后哪些额外反事实量可识别的问题，明确了非参数因果推断的理论极限，并为不可识别量提供了基于反事实数据的分析边界，这对因果推断的理论和实践都有重要意义。

title: GPU-Native Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search with IVF-RaBitQ: Fast Index Build and Search
summary: Approximate nearest neighbor search (ANNS) on GPUs is gaining increasing popularity for modern retrieval and recommendation workloads that operate over massive high-dimensional vectors. Graph-based indexes deliver high recall and throughput but incur heavy build-time and storage costs. In contrast, cluster-based methods build and scale efficiently yet often need many probes for high recall, straining memory bandwidth and compute. Aiming to simultaneously achieve fast index build, high-throughput search, high recall, and low storage requirement for GPUs, we present IVF-RaBitQ (GPU), a GPU-native ANNS solution that integrates the cluster-based method IVF with RaBitQ quantization into an efficient GPU index build/search pipeline. Specifically, for index build, we develop a scalable GPU-native RaBitQ quantization method that enables fast and accurate low-bit encoding at scale. For search, we develop GPU-native distance computation schemes for RaBitQ codes and a fused search kernel to achieve high throughput with high recall. With IVF-RaBitQ implemented and integrated into the NVIDIA cuVS Library, experiments on cuVS Bench across multiple datasets show that IVF-RaBitQ offers a strong performance frontier in recall, throughput, index build time, and storage footprint. For Recall approximately equal to 0.95, IVF-RaBitQ achieves 2.2x higher QPS than the state-of-the-art graph-based method CAGRA, while also constructing indices 7.7x faster on average. Compared to the cluster-based method IVF-PQ, IVF-RaBitQ delivers on average over 2.7x higher throughput while avoiding accessing the raw vectors for reranking.

AI.tldr: 本文提出IVF-RaBitQ (GPU)，一种GPU原生的近似最近邻搜索(ANNS)解决方案，结合IVF聚类方法与RaBitQ量化技术，实现快速索引构建、高吞吐量搜索、高召回率和低存储占用。
AI.motivation: 现有ANNS方法存在权衡：图索引(如CAGRA)具有高召回率和吞吐量，但构建时间和存储成本高；聚类方法(如IVF-PQ)构建高效，但需要大量探针才能实现高召回率，消耗内存带宽。本文旨在同时实现GPU上快速索引构建、高吞吐量搜索、高召回率和低存储占用。
AI.method: 1. 开发可扩展的GPU原RaBitQ量化方法，支持大规模快速准确的低位编码；2. 为RaBitQ码开发GPU原生距离计算方案；3. 开发融合搜索内核以实现高吞吐量。IVF-RaBitQ已集成到NVIDIA cuVS库中。
AI.result: 在cuVS Bench上针对多个数据集的实验表明：在召回率≈0.95时，IVF-RaBitQ相比图方法CAGRA实现2.2x更高的QPS，索引构建速度平均快7.7x；相比聚类方法IVF-PQ，平均吞吐量提升2.7x，且无需访问原始向量进行重排序。
AI.conclusion: IVF-RaBitQ在召回率、吞吐量、索引构建时间和存储占用方面提供了强大的性能优势，是GPU上ANNS的有效解决方案。

title: SWE-rebench V2: Language-Agnostic SWE Task Collection at Scale
summary: Software engineering agents (SWE) are improving rapidly, with recent gains largely driven by reinforcement learning (RL). However, RL training is constrained by the scarcity of large-scale task collections with reproducible execution environments and reliable test suites. Although a growing number of benchmarks have emerged, datasets suitable for training remain limited in scale and diversity or often target a limited set of high-resource language ecosystems. We introduce SWE-rebench V2, a language-agnostic automated pipeline for harvesting executable real-world SWE tasks and constructing RL training environments at scale. The pipeline synthesizes repository-specific installation and test procedures via an interactive setup agent, and filters unsound instances using an ensemble of LLM judges, validated against human-verified SWE-bench annotations. Using this pipeline, we construct a dataset of 32,000+ tasks spanning 20 languages and 3,600+ repositories, with pre-built images for reproducible execution. To further scale training data, we additionally release 120,000+ tasks with installation instructions, fail-to-pass tests and rich metadata, where the problem statement is generated based on the original pull request description. We validate the collected instances through a diagnostic study that covers a subset of tasks in five programming languages across seven popular models, and provide instance-level metadata that flags common confounders such as overly restrictive tests and underspecified descriptions. We release the datasets, the collection and execution code, and associated artifacts to enable large-scale training of SWE agents across diverse languages and repositories.

AI.tldr: SWE-rebench V2 是一条语言无关的自动化流水线，用于从真实开源仓库中大规模采集"可执行"的软件工程任务并构建 RL 训练环境。作者在 20 种编程语言、3,617 个仓库上发布了 32,079 个已容器化（预构建 Docker 镜像）的 issue 链接任务，另发布 120,000+ 个以 PR 描述为问题陈述的"配方级"任务，并提供实例级诊断元数据（外部依赖、测试脆弱性、描述欠定等），用于分层过滤、课程设计与受控分析。
AI.motivation: 当前 SWE 智能体的进步主要来自强化学习（RL），但 RL 训练严重受限于大规模、可复现执行环境与可靠测试套件的稀缺。已有基准（SWE-bench、Multi-SWE-bench、SWE-PolyBench 等）多以评测为导向、规模有限，且多集中于 Python 等高资源语言生态；自动化流水线虽提升了可扩展性，但仍缺少训练所需的预构建环境与细粒度实例诊断。此外，"语言无关"在实际中对长尾工具链与仓库约定的鲁棒性仍缺乏实证。因此本文希望提供一条统一端到端工作流：挖掘真实 PR/issue 历史 → 合成容器化环境 → 抽取 fail-to-pass 测试预言机 → 自动质量过滤，无需逐实例人工验证，从而支撑跨语言、跨仓库的大规模交互式训练。
AI.method: 五阶段流水线：(1) 初步数据采集——基于 GitHub Archive 聚合 issue/PR 元数据，用分布式 map-reduce 克隆仓库并从本地 git 历史抽取补丁，绕过 API 限流；按许可证、issue 是否解决、PR 是否合并、是否含测试（正则 `(?i)(test(?:ing|s)?|e2e)`）过滤，并按语言差异设置 star/closed-issue 阈值（高资源语言 25/15，长尾语言 10/1），保留约 20% 仓库覆盖约 80% 任务。(2) 环境合成——以 Qwen3-Coder-480B-A35B-Instruct 生成各语言基础 Dockerfile（含多工具链版本，如 JDK 11/17/21）；采用 mini-SWE-agent v1.14.4 交互式闭环调试，逐仓库一次性推断 install_config 并复用于该仓库所有任务；再由 LLM 从成功日志合成仓库级日志解析器（失败则最多重试 5 轮）。(3) 执行式验证——多阶段 Docker 构建，应用 test patch 与 solution patch 进行修复前/后双遍全量测试执行，要求至少一个 fail-to-pass 测试，并对每个任务重跑 3 次保留结果稳定的实例。(4) 问题清晰度过滤——以 SWE-bench Verified 标注规范为基准，采用三个独立 LLM 评审（gpt-oss-120b、GLM-4.7、DeepSeek-V3.2）一致判定为"规格充分"才保留。(5) 元数据增强——用 gpt-oss-120b 基于诊断研究结果为实例标注潜在失效模式（B1 测试套件耦合、B2 隐式命名要求、B3 外部依赖等），并自动抽取被测试覆盖的接口签名/描述。(6) PR 任务扩展——对已有成功环境的仓库复用安装/测试配方，基于 PR 描述与补丁生成合成问题陈述，并做泄漏检测与后处理。消融实验包括：交互式 vs 非交互式环境合成、不同模型/上下文长度/重试次数（pass@k，103 任务子集）；以及问题清晰度过滤的提示词、模型与集成策略（以 SWE-bench Verified 1699 条人工标注为基准）。诊断研究覆盖 5 种语言 300 个任务 × 7 个前沿模型 × 3 次独立运行，并按 A/B* 类别对比通过率。
AI.result: 漏斗数据：从 29,511,758 个 PR / 145,306 仓库出发 → 含测试 8,593,722 → issue 链接且含测试 805,598 → 仓库过滤 583,809 PR / 21,692 仓库 → 有 F2P 41,349 → 问题清晰度过滤 33,049 → 三次运行稳定后最终 32,079 任务 / 3,617 仓库。语言分布：Python 21.6%、Go 20.6%，其后为 JS/TS/Rust 等，覆盖 12 类 PR 类型；中位任务改动 3 文件 34 行，90 分位 9 文件 181 行；时间跨度 2014–2025。成本：环境合成 21,692 仓库、平均 24.67 轮交互、约 535K 次模型调用，约 $1.9K 推理费用；任务级验证 583,809 次 Docker 构建（约 26,400 job-hours），最终镜像占 26.36 TiB。环境合成消融（pass@10）：非交互式仅 15.7，mini-SWE-agent + Qwen3-Coder-30B (32k) 46.1，DeepSeek-V3.2 (32k) 59.8，Qwen3-Coder-480B (32k) 58.8，(64k) 55.9，(128k) 62.7；交互式始终优于非交互式，增大重试次数显著提升成功率，32k 上下文已足够。问题清晰度过滤：Verified+ 提示 F1 最高（0.50），Verified-E 精确率最高（0.83），单模型中 gpt-oss-120b 最佳（Acc 0.68/Prec 0.75/F1 0.36），混合均值集成 F1 最高（0.43），严格共识精确率最高（0.88）但召回仅 0.06。任务分析：Claude Opus-4.5 总体 pass@1 25.2%/pass@3 32.7% 最优，gpt-oss-120b 最低（8.8%/14.3%）；Python 最易、Scala 最难；A 类任务通过率显著高于 B* 类（如 Gemini 34.0% vs 4.0%，GLM-4.7 34.0% vs 6.0%），验证诊断元数据能有效区分"干净任务"与"环境噪声"。PR 派生任务泄漏评估（509 条）：77.0% 无泄漏，23.0% 含部分泄漏，仅 2.4% 存在明确解法泄漏。
AI.conclusion: 本文贡献了一套可复现、语言无关的 SWE 任务规模化采集流水线及其开源产物：32,079 个带预构建镜像的稳定任务（20 语言、3,617 仓库）与 120,000+ 个 PR 派生任务，并附带实例级诊断元数据，可直接支撑 RL/SFT 训练、课程学习与鲁棒性训练（后续阶段重新引入带噪声任务并配合部分奖励）。局限包括：未做端到端 RL 训练消融（受算力/基础设施限制，仅验证训练前置属性）；Docker 镜像无法完全消除外部包仓库与网络资源漂移，需周期性重建；当前环境设计仅支持可打包进单容器的项目，尚未覆盖需要多服务、外部数据库或分布式基础设施的长程任务；单次环境配置成功率仅约 20%，仍有通过增加重试与多仓库状态提升产量的空间。未来工作包括提升配置重试、扩充长尾语言与精选子集、扩展到多服务长程任务，以及在测试正确性之外引入性能、时延、内存等非功能维度的可自动度量奖励。

title: Long Range Frequency Tuning for QML
summary: Quantum machine learning models using angle encoding naturally represent truncated Fourier series, providing universal function approximation capabilities with sufficient circuit depth. For unary fixed-frequency encodings, circuit depth scales as O(omega_max * (omega_max + epsilon^{-2})) with target frequency magnitude omega_max and precision epsilon. Trainable-frequency approaches theoretically reduce this to match the target spectrum size, requiring only as many encoding gates as frequencies in the target spectrum. Despite this compelling efficiency, their practical effectiveness hinges on a key assumption: that gradient-based optimization can drive prefactors to arbitrary target values. We demonstrate through systematic experiments that frequency prefactors exhibit limited trainability: movement is constrained to approximately +/-1 units with typical learning rates. When target frequencies lie outside this reachable range, optimization frequently fails. To overcome this frequency reachability limitation, we propose grid-based initialization using ternary encodings, which generate dense integer frequency spectra. While this approach requires O(log_3(omega_max)) encoding gates -- more than the theoretical optimum but exponentially fewer than fixed-frequency methods -- it ensures target frequencies lie within the locally reachable range. On synthetic targets with three shifted high frequencies, ternary grid initialization achieves a median R^2 score of 0.9969, compared to 0.1841 for the trainable-frequency baseline. For the real-world Flight Passengers dataset, ternary grid initialization achieves a median R^2 score of 0.9671, representing a 22.8% improvement over trainable-frequency initialization (median R^2 = 0.7876).

AI.tldr: 本文研究角度编码量子机器学习模型中频率预因子的可训练性问题，发现典型学习率下频率预因子移动范围限制在±1单位，导致高频目标优化失败。为此提出三进制网格初始化方法，通过生成密集整数频率谱确保目标频率可达，在合成数据和真实时序数据上均取得显著性能提升。
AI.motivation: 尽管可训练频率方法理论上仅需与目标频谱中频率数量相同的编码门即可实现高效表示，但该方法有效性依赖于梯度优化能将预因子驱动到任意目标值的假设。作者通过系统实验发现这一假设通常不成立。
AI.method: 系统性实验验证频率预因子训练限制；提出三进制编码网格初始化方法确保频率可达性；使用合成高频目标数据集和真实世界Flight Passengers时序数据集进行验证。
AI.result: 1）频率预因子训练受限：典型学习率下移动范围被限制在约±1单位；2）当目标频率超出可达范围时优化失败；3）三进制网格初始化在合成高频目标上R²=0.9969 vs 基线0.1841；4）在Flight Passengers数据集上R²=0.9671 vs 基线0.7876，提升22.8%。
AI.conclusion: 提出网格初始化方法使用三进制编码，可生成密集整数频率谱，确保目标频率落在局部可达范围内。实验表明：该方法在合成高频目标上R²=0.9969（vs 基线0.1841），在Flight Passengers数据集上R²=0.9671（vs 基线0.7876，提升22.8%）。虽然门数量为O(log_3(ω_max))，但成功解决了频率可达性问题。

title: Sharing is caring: data sharing in multi-agent supply chains
summary: Modern supply networks are complex interconnected systems. Multi-agent models are increasingly explored to optimise their performance. Most research assumes agents will have full observability of the system by having a single policy represent the agents, which seems unrealistic as this requires companies to share their data. The alternative is to develop a Hidden-Markov Process with separate policies, making the problem challenging to solve. In this paper, we propose a multi-agent system where the factory agent can share information downstream, increasing the observability of the environment. It can choose to share no information, lie, tell the truth or combine these in a mixed strategy. The results show that data sharing can boost the performance, especially when combined with a cooperative reward shaping. In the high demand scenario there is limited ability to change the strategy and therefore no data sharing approach benefits both agents. However, lying benefits the factory enough for an overall system improvement, although only by a relatively small amount compared to the overall reward. In the low demand scenario, the most successful data sharing is telling the truth which benefits all actors significantly.

AI.tldr: 在工厂—零售商的二层供应链多智能体模型中（两个异构 SAC 策略，非共享观测），给工厂智能体新增"库存数据共享"动作（不分享 / 撒谎 / 说真话 / 混合策略）后：低需求（正态，mean=2）下"说真话"是最优共享方式，在合作化奖励整形下全局奖励最高（22.3 vs 无沟通 8），工厂收益提升约 158%、零售商约 7.5%，双方同时受益；高需求（Poisson，μ=10）下策略调整空间极小，任何共享方式都无法同时利好双方，"撒谎"虽对工厂略有好处（+0.9%）、对零售商略有损害（−0.7%），但因需求刚性带来的收益有限而全局略有提升。结论：不存在普适的最优共享方式，数据共享需与正确的沟通策略和奖励设计匹配才能带来系统收益。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体供应链研究大多假设单一共享策略、节点间信息完全可见（可自动共享知识），这在现实中不成立——企业独立经营、逐利竞争，只在自身受益时才愿共享数据，且可能提供虚假信息（信息不对称与信任问题）。作者先前工作（Wang et al., 2025）表明：改为每个节点独立策略的异构系统后，低需求场景性能下降约 10×，形成难以求解的隐马尔可夫（Hidden Decision Markov）问题；而"带独立策略的多智能体能否通过通信有效协作"在文献中几乎未被研究（仅有 Jannelli et al., 2024 研究可沟通达成共识但不共享状态数据）。因此本文在两层供应链中考察工厂向零售商"说真话 / 撒谎 / 不分享 / 混合"四类库存数据共享行为，并与基线奖励和合作化奖励整形结合，检验数据共享对系统绩效与权力结构（高需求工厂主导 vs 低需求零售商主导）的影响。
AI.method: 环境：基于 Wang et al. (2025) 的两层（工厂–零售商）供应链仿真，用 Gymnasium API + Ray 多智能体工具实现，PyTorch 构建并训练网络，Ray Tune/Rllib 调参，运行于 IRIDIS 超算（Xeon E5-2670 + Quadro RTX8000）。工厂从供应商采购并定价、向零售商交付，零售商面对客户需求下单；下游需求即上游订单，物料平衡 I_{i,t+1}=I_{i,t}+Q_{i,t}-D_{i,t}，缺货/超库存（backlog）按式(6)(7)计算。观测：零售商观测 {I_{1,t}, B_{1,t}, S_{1,t}, D_{1,t}, I_{1,F}, p_t}，工厂观测自身状态与下游需求。动作：零售商 a_{1,t}={Q_{1,t}}；工厂 a_{2,t}={Q_{2,t}, ω_{j,t}}，其中通信因子 ω 定义——无沟通 ω=0（I_{1,F}=0）、撒谎 I_{1,F}=ω_{2,t}×C_{2}, ω_{2,t}~U[0,1)（随机伪库存）、信任 I_{1,F}=I_{2,t}（ω=1）、混合策略由智能体自行在三者间选择。算法：两个异构 SAC 智能体（含注意力/LSTM 记忆，max_seq_len=20，fcnet [256,256]，γ=0.99，lr=0.001，优先回放等，见表1）。训练 60,000 仿真日（30 天一段 episode，库存超上限 6 次缺货或超过 30 天则重置），每组实验重复 10 次，取收敛后末期结果。场景：高需求 D~Poisson(μ=10)，低需求 D~Normal(mean=2, std=1)。奖励：基线奖励（仅自身收益：销售价×销量 − 持货成本 − 缺货罚金 − 欠货罚金 − 订单成本）；合作化奖励（额外对对方缺货惩罚：零售商 −10×max(Q_{1,t}−I_{2,t},0)，工厂 −20×max(D_t−I_{1,t},0)），分析时将对方缺货/欠货罚金回加以便与基线可比。对比指标：工厂/零售商/全局奖励、库存均值、缺货率、欠货率；并统计混合策略下各沟通方式的选择频率，联系"疯人策略"（madman strategy）解释。
AI.result: 高需求基线：全局奖励最高为"撒谎"1334.7（无沟通 1322.7、真话 1317.4、混合 1310.8）；工厂撒谎收益最高 1710.6，零售商在混合策略下最好 −361.1，但所有情形零售商均为负收益（固定低价所致）。高需求+合作化奖励：全局仍是撒谎最高 1311.9，真话最低 1195.1（合作化奖励下全局低于基线）；工厂撒谎 1718.6、零售商混合最佳 −362.9。共享在高需求下对全局绩效影响仅 −9.5%~+0.9%。低需求基线：无沟通最佳（全局 −52.0），真话 −118.9、混合 −128.0、撒谎 −145.0；但工厂在真话下收益最高 71.8，撒谎是唯一让工厂为负（−5.9）的策略，零售商真话最差 −190.8，说明工厂获益与零售商受损相抵。低需求+合作化奖励：真话全局最优 22.3（工厂 109.9，零售商 −87.5），无沟通 8.0，混合 −55.3，撒谎 −144.8；零售商在无沟通下为正（3.3），并普遍优于同条件基线（配合奖励整形后零售商不再绝对为负）。库存/缺货统计：高需求下零售库存稳定在 13.8~14.6、工厂库存 28~35；低需求零售库存 4~9、工厂 14~23，缺货率（0.001%~0.059%）与欠货率普遍很低，混合策略下零售欠货最少（低需求合作化 0%）、工厂缺货最少（真话 0%）。混合策略的行为分解显示智能体往往无法找到单一最优沟通方式：例如高需求基线下真话仅 19%、无沟通 39.7%、撒谎 41.3%；低需求基线撒谎占比反而高达 40.16%（对工厂不利），呈"疯人策略"式的非理性混乱行为，Collaborative 奖励下低需求撒谎降至 25.16%、收益由 −127.98 提升至 −55.32。
AI.conclusion: 数据共享的最优形式随需求情景而变：高需求下策略可调空间小、需高库存，任何共享方式都无法同时利好双方，撒谎仅给工厂带来约 0.9% 的小增益（对零售商 −0.7%）而使系统略有改善；低需求下库存容量相对需求宽裕，"说真话"是最优政策，工厂提升约 158%、零售商约 7.5%，双方显著受益，说明"分享即关爱"（sharing is caring）。数据共享在与正确沟通策略及合作化奖励整形配合时能放大系统绩效，用错策略时则造成更大损失；零售端对虚假库存信息表现出较强稳健性，工厂的欺骗手段并未自动严重损害零售商。方法论上，奖励整形与数据共享（观测扩展）结合比既有工作更为有效。局限与展望：仅两层单链、无交付提前期导致工厂几乎不缺货而零售商缺货/欠货风险更高；"撒谎"仅为随机伪库存，可设计更有策略性的欺骗；未来可扩展更长链条、多上游竞争者的通信结构与效果。

title: FedDAG: Clustered Federated Learning via Global Data and Gradient Integration for Heterogeneous Environments
comment: This paper has been accepted in ICLR 2026
summary: Federated Learning (FL) enables a group of clients to collaboratively train a model without sharing individual data, but its performance drops when client data are heterogeneous. Clustered FL tackles this by grouping similar clients. However, existing clustered FL approaches rely solely on either data similarity or gradient similarity; however, this results in an incomplete assessment of client similarities. Prior clustered FL approaches also restrict knowledge and representation sharing to clients within the same cluster. This prevents cluster models from benefiting from the diverse client population across clusters. To address these limitations, FedDAG introduces a clustered FL framework, FedDAG, that employs a weighted, class-wise similarity metric that integrates both data and gradient information, providing a more holistic measure of similarity during clustering. In addition, FedDAG adopts a dual-encoder architecture for cluster models, comprising a primary encoder trained on its own clients' data and a secondary encoder refined using gradients from complementary clusters. This enables cross-cluster feature transfer while preserving cluster-specific specialization. Experiments on diverse benchmarks and data heterogeneity settings show that FedDAG consistently outperforms state-of-the-art clustered FL baselines in accuracy.

AI.tldr: FedDAG是一种聚类联邦学习框架，通过结合数据和梯度信息的加权类级相似性度量来更全面地评估客户端相似性，并采用双编码器架构实现跨聚类特征迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有聚类联邦学习方法仅依赖数据相似性或梯度相似性，导致对客户端相似性的评估不完整；同时限制了知识共享仅限同一聚类内的客户端，无法利用其他聚类的多样性信息。
AI.method: 1. 提出加权类级相似性度量，集成数据和梯度信息，提供更全面的相似性评估；2. 采用双编码器架构：主编码器在自身客户端数据上训练，副编码器利用互补聚类的梯度进行细化，实现跨聚类特征迁移同时保留聚类特定专业化。
AI.result: 在多种基准数据集和不同数据异构性设置下，FedDAG的准确率始终优于最先进的聚类联邦学习基线方法。
AI.conclusion: FedDAG通过结合数据与梯度信息的相似性度量以及双编码器架构，有效解决了聚类联邦学习中相似性评估不完整和跨聚类知识共享受限的问题，显著提升了模型性能。

title: Planning under Distribution Shifts with Causal POMDPs
comment: To appear at the 36th International Conference on Automated Planning and Scheduling (ICAPS-26)
summary: In the real world, planning is often challenged by distribution shifts. As such, a model of the environment obtained under one set of conditions may no longer remain valid as the distribution of states or the environment dynamics change, which in turn causes previously learned strategies to fail. In this work, we propose a theoretical framework for planning under partial observability using Partially Observable Markov Decision Processes (POMDPs) formulated using causal knowledge. By representing shifts in the environment as interventions on this causal POMDP, the framework enables evaluating plans under hypothesized changes and actively identifying which components of the environment have been altered. We show how to maintain and update a belief over both the latent state and the underlying domain, and we prove that the value function remains piecewise linear and convex (PWLC) in this augmented belief space. Preservation of PWLC under distribution shifts has the advantage of maintaining the tractability of planning via $α$-vector-based POMDP methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于因果知识的部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程(POMDP)理论框架，用于处理分布偏移下的规划问题。该框架将环境变化表示为因果干预，保持信念在潜在状态和底层域上的更新，并证明价值函数在增强信念空间中保持分段线性凸(PWLC)特性，从而维持α向量方法的计算可处理性。
AI.motivation: 现实世界中，规划常常面临分布偏移的挑战。在一组条件下学习的环境模型在状态分布或环境动力学变化时可能失效，导致先前学习的策略失败。
AI.method: 提出使用因果知识构建的部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程(POMDP)理论框架。将环境变化表示为因果干预，从而能够评估假设变化下的规划方案，并主动识别环境中改变的组件。维护并更新关于潜在状态和底层域的信念。
AI.result: 证明价值函数在增强的信念空间中保持分段线性凸(PWLC)特性。
AI.conclusion: PWLC性质的保持具有显著优势：能够通过α向量方法维持规划的计算可处理性，即使在分布偏移条件下仍保持规划的可 tract 性。

title: NSHEDB: Noise-Sensitive Homomorphic Encrypted Database Query Engine
summary:
Homomorphic encryption (HE) enables computations directly on encrypted data, offering strong cryptographic guarantees for secure and privacy-preserving data storage and query execution. However, despite its theoretical power, practical adoption of HE in database systems remains limited due to extreme cipher-text expansion, memory overhead, and the computational cost of bootstrapping, which resets noise levels for correctness.
  This paper presents NSHEDB, a secure query processing engine designed to address these challenges at the system architecture level. NSHEDB uses word-level leveled HE (LHE) based on the BFV scheme to minimize ciphertext expansion and avoid costly bootstrapping. It introduces novel techniques for executing equality, range, and aggregation operations using purely homomorphic computation, without transciphering between different HE schemes (e.g., CKKS/BFV/TFHE) or relying on trusted hardware. Additionally, it incorporates a noise-aware query planner to extend computation depth while preserving security guarantees.
  We implement and evaluate NSHEDB on real-world database workloads (TPC-H) and show that it achieves 20x-V1370x speedup and a 73x storage reduction compared to state-of-the-art HE-based systems, while upholding 128-bit security in a semi-honest model with no key release or trusted components.

AI.tldr: NSHEDB 是一个安全的查询处理引擎，采用字级分层同态加密(BFV方案)来解决同态加密在数据库系统中的实际应用挑战，无需 bootstrapping 或跨密文转换
AI.motivation: 同态加密虽具理论优势，但实际采用受限于密文扩展、内存开销和 bootstrapping 计算成本
AI.method: 使用基于BFV方案的字级分层同态加密(LHE)，引入纯同态计算的相等性、范围和聚合操作执行技术，以及噪声感知的查询规划器来扩展计算深度
AI.result: 相比最先进的基于同态加密的系统，NSHEDB 实现了 20x-V1370x 的加速和 73x 的存储缩减
AI.conclusion: NSHEDB在TPC-H真实数据库工作负载上实现了20x-V1370x的加速和73x的存储缩减，同时在半诚实模型下维持128位安全级别，无密钥发布或可信组件

title: Novice Developers Produce Larger Review Overhead for Project Maintainers while Vibe Coding
summary: AI coding agents allow software developers to generate code quickly, which raises a practical question for project managers and open source maintainers: can vibe coders with less development experience substitute for expert developers? To explore whether developer experience still matters in AI-assisted development, we study $22,953$ Pull Requests (PRs) from $1,719$ vibe coders in the GitHub repositories of the AIDev dataset. We split vibe coders into lower experience vibe coders ($\mathit{Exp}_{Low}$) and higher experience vibe coders ($\mathit{Exp}_{High}$) and compare contribution magnitude and PR acceptance rates across PR categories. We find that $\mathit{Exp}_{Low}$ submits PRs with larger volume ($2.15\times$ more commits and $1.47\times$ more files changed) than $\mathit{Exp}_{High}$. Moreover, $\mathit{Exp}_{Low}$ PRs, when compared to $\mathit{Exp}_{High}$, receive $4.52\times$ more review comments, and have $31\%$ lower acceptance rates, and remain open $5.16\times$ longer before resolution. Our results indicate that low-experienced vibe coders focus on generating more code while shifting verification burden onto reviewers. For practice, project managers may not be able to safely replace experienced developers with low-experience vibe coders without increasing review capacity. Development teams should therefore combine targeted training for novices with adaptive PR review cycles.

AI.tldr: 研究AI辅助开发中开发者经验是否仍然重要，分析了22,953个Pull Request，发现低经验"氛围编码者"虽然提交更多代码，但接受率低31%，审查负担转移到审阅者。
AI.motivation: AI编码工具使经验较少的开发者也能快速生成代码，项目管理者面临一个问题：能否用低经验开发者替代专家开发者？研究旨在探索AI辅助开发中开发者经验是否仍有价值。
AI.method: 从AIDev数据集中提取1,719名氛围编码者的22,953个Pull Request，将氛围编码者分为低经验组(Exp_Low)和高经验组(Exp_High)，比较不同经验水平在PR数量和接受率上的差异。
AI.result: 低经验氛围编码者提交了2.15倍更多的提交和1.47倍更多的文件更改；收到的审查评论多4.52倍；接受率低31%；PR开放时间长达5.16倍。结果表明低经验编码者专注于生成更多代码，将验证负担转移给审阅者。
AI.conclusion: 项目管理者无法在不增加审查容量的情况下安全地用低经验氛围编码者替代经验丰富的开发者。开发团队应为新手提供针对性培训，并采用适应性PR审查周期。

title: Brain-OF: An Omnifunctional Foundation Model for fMRI, EEG and MEG
summary: Brain foundation models have achieved remarkable advances across a wide range of neuroscience tasks. However, most existing models are limited to a single functional modality, restricting their ability to exploit complementary spatiotemporal dynamics and the collective data scale across imaging techniques. To address this limitation, we propose Brain-OF, the first omnifunctional brain foundation model jointly pretrained on fMRI, EEG and MEG, capable of handling both unimodal and multimodal inputs within a unified framework. To reconcile heterogeneous spatiotemporal resolutions, we introduce the Any-Resolution Neural Signal Sampler, which projects diverse brain signals into a shared semantic space. To further manage semantic shifts, the Brain-OF backbone integrates DINT attention with a Sparse Mixture of Experts, where shared experts capture modality-invariant representations and routed experts specialize in modality-specific semantics. Furthermore, we propose Masked Temporal-Frequency Modeling, a dual-domain pretraining objective that jointly reconstructs brain signals in both the time and frequency domains. Brain-OF is pretrained on a large-scale corpus comprising around 40 datasets and demonstrates superior performance across diverse downstream tasks, highlighting the benefits of joint multimodal integration and dual-domain pretraining.

AI.tldr: Brain-OF是首个统一处理fMRI、EEG、MEG单模态和多模态输入的脑基础模型，通过Any-Resolution Neural Signal Sampler解决异构时空分辨率问题，结合DINT attention与Sparse Mixture of Experts实现模态 invariant和specific表示学习，并采用时频双域重建进行预训练，在40个数据集上预训练后展现出卓越的下游任务性能
AI.motivation: 现有脑基础模型局限于单一功能模态（fMRI、EEG或MEG），无法利用不同成像技术之间的互补时空动态和集体数据规模
AI.method: 提出Brain-OF，首个在fMRI、EEG和MEG上联合预训练的 omnifunctional脑基础模型。核心技术包括：1) Any-Resolution Neural Signal Sampler将不同脑信号投影到共享语义空间；2) DINT attention结合Sparse Mixture of Experts（共享专家捕获模态不变表示，路由专家专精模态特定语义）；3) Masked Temporal-Frequency Modeling双域预训练目标，在时域和频域联合重建脑信号
AI.result: 在约40个数据集的大规模语料库上预训练，在多种下游任务中表现优异
AI.conclusion: 验证了联合多模态融合和双域预训练的优越性

title: Rudder: Steering Prefetching in Distributed GNN Training using LLM Agents
comment: Accepted to the 40th ACM International Conference on Supercomputing (ICS 2026)
summary: Large-scale Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are typically trained by sampling a vertex's neighbors to a fixed distance. Because large input graphs are distributed, training requires frequent irregular communication that stalls forward progress. Moreover, fetched data changes with graph, graph distribution, sample and batch parameters, and caching polices. Consequently, any static prefetching method will miss crucial opportunities to adapt to different dynamic conditions. In this paper, we introduce Rudder, a software module embedded in the state-of-the-art AWS DistDGL framework, to autonomously prefetch remote nodes and minimize communication. Rudder's adaptation contrasts with both standard heuristics and traditional ML classifiers. We observe that the generative AI found in contemporary Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibits emergent properties like In-Context Learning (ICL) for zero-shot tasks, with logical multi-step reasoning. We find this behavior well-suited for adaptive control even with substantial undertraining. Evaluations using standard datasets and unseen configurations on the NERSC Perlmutter supercomputer show up to 91% improvement in end-to-end training performance over baseline DistDGL (no prefetching), and an 82% improvement over static prefetching, reducing communication by over 50%. Our code is available at https://github.com/aishwaryyasarkar/rudder-llm-agent.

AI.tldr: Rudder 是一个嵌入 AWS DistDGL 框架的软件模块，用小参数量量化 LLM 智能体（通过上下文学习 ICL 零样本推理）作为自适应预取控制器，动态决定持久缓冲区中"何时替换"哪些远程节点，以减少分布式 GNN 训练中的不规则通信。在 NERSC Perlmutter 上，端到端训练性能最高提升 91%（相对无预取的 DistDGL）、82%（相对静态预取），通信量降低超 50%，且无需耗时的参数试错调优。
AI.motivation: 大规模 GNN 训练依赖对顶点固定距离邻域的采样，图被分区到多个 PE 后，采样所需的邻居节点常位于其他分区，导致频繁、不可预测的不规则通信，使训练前向进度停滞。为缓解该问题需要预取/缓存远程节点，但由于：(1) 邻域爆炸使一次性预取不可行，固定大小的本地持久缓冲区需要不断"替换"节点；(2) 被取回的数据随图、图分区、采样与 batch 参数、缓存策略而动态变化；(3) 现有静态预取策略需对每个数据集/配置做昂贵的试错调参，且预取/替换本身触发时机缺乏自适应；(4) ML 分类器方法需要在分布式 GNN 负载上采集"trace-only"模式的高成本带标签训练数据，且难以覆盖分布外情形——因此需要一种零样本、可适应动态条件、低开销的智能预取控制器。
AI.method: 方法由两部分组成。(1) 替换候选的评分策略（what-to-replace）：基于频率跟踪，被访问节点分数 +1，未在当前 minibatch 采样轮被访问的节点分数乘 0.95（惩罚"停滞"以避免 LFU 式缓存污染），分数低于 0.95 的"陈旧"节点被最近采样的远程节点替换，无陈旧节点则跳过。(2) 替换时机决策（when-to-replace）：以 LLM 智能体或监督式 ML 分类器为决策器，输入实时指标（%-Hits 即远程节点命中缓冲区比例、远程通信量、当前/待处理 minibatch 数、过去替换决策的影响（Δ%-Hits、ΔT_COMM）、静态图结构信息如顶点数/边数），输出二元"是否替换"动作。LLM 智能体由 Metrics Collector、Context Builder、Decision Maker 三组件构成，通过零样本 ICL 与 CoT 提示输出 JSON 决策并预测预期结果以便自我校正；ML 分类器（MLP、LR、RF、SVM、XGBoost、TabNet）用 Δ%-Hits−ΔT_COMM>0 规则离线标注轨迹并可在线微调决策头。实现上嵌入 DistDGL，训练器进程将预取任务卸载到 CPU 线程（ThreadPoolExecutor + NUMBA），推理在后台 daemon 线程经 Ollama/llama.cpp 运行（选 <5B 量化模型，上下文 <2048 token），通过请求/响应队列与预取器交换指标；采用默认异步模式（推理线程在决策被消费前暂停，避免"陈旧请求"）与同步模式，替换间隔 r 定义决策频率。不改变底层采样算法与数据并行训练，故精度不变。评估含无参考的功能正确性检查：用 Pass@1(%-Hits) 比较 LLM 预测状态与实际状态转移的一致性。
AI.result: 在 NERSC Perlmutter（1,792 节点，A100 GPU，Slingshot 互连）上用 DistDGL v2.5、METIS 分区、2 层 GraphSAGE（fanout {10,25}，batch 2000），在 OGB（products/reddit/papers100M/arxiv）、SNAP（orkut/friendster）、yelp 数据集，16–256 个 trainer、5%/25% 缓冲区下：端到端训练性能最高比基线 DistDGL 提升 91%、比静态预取（DistDGL+fixed）提升 82%，通信量降低 50% 以上；相对 DistDGL+fixed 中位训练时间再改善约 10%，%-Hits 提升约 20–50%；在 products 上比 MassiveGNN 通信更低（5% 缓冲区降 19–36%、25% 降 43–52%，MassiveGNN 为 17%/51%）。不同模型：Gemma3-4B 表现最佳（Pass@1 %-Hits 约 74–83%），Llama3.2-3B 次之且延迟最低；SmolLM/Qwen-1.5B 与 MoE（Granite3.1-3B、Mixtral-8x7B/8x22B）较差（Pass@1 <60%，Qwen 有效响应率仅 44%）。同步模式使 T_DDP 增加最多 25×，%-Hits 收益 <5%，故异步为默认；分类器决策过于频繁导致通信量比 LLM 高数个数量级。在未见数据集（yelp、arxiv）上 Gemma3-4B 保持高 %-Hits，而预训练 MLP 因 batch size 分布偏移（2000→500/1000）出现 %-Hits 接近 0 且训练变慢，在线微调可部分改善但增加开销。
AI.conclusion: Rudder 证明：以小参数量量化 LLM 作为"无梯度、零样本"的智能预取控制器，能以极低调参成本替代昂贵的静态启发式与需要大规模标注轨迹的监督学习，在分布式 GNN 训练中实现自适应预取/替换，显著降低通信并提升端到端性能；LLM 智能体在分布外配置上仍优于 ML 分类器，因为其适应来自 ICL 而非离线训练。核心洞见是：LLM 作为智能体擅长在缺乏导数与显式目标函数的巨大搜索空间上做近似搜索，即使模型规模很小、训练不足也能胜任。作者同时强调该结论的可迁移性，以及在延迟敏感场景中"模型越大并不必然越好"（低比特量化严重损害大模型推理）。

title: Construct, Merge, Solve & Adapt with Reinforcement Learning for the min-max Multiple Traveling Salesman Problem
summary: The Multiple Traveling Salesman Problem (mTSP) extends the Traveling Salesman Problem to m tours that start and end at a common depot and jointly visit all customers exactly once. In the min-max variant, the objective is to minimize the longest tour, reflecting workload balance. We propose a hybrid approach, Construct, Merge, Solve & Adapt with Reinforcement Learning (RL-CMSA), for the symmetric single-depot min-max mTSP. The method iteratively constructs diverse solutions using probabilistic clustering guided by learned pairwise q-values, merges routes into a compact pool, solves a restricted set-covering MILP, and refines solutions via inter-route remove, shift, and swap moves. The q-values are updated by reinforcing city-pair co-occurrences in high-quality solutions, while the pool is adapted through ageing and pruning. This combination of exact optimization and reinforcement-guided construction balances exploration and exploitation. Computational results on random and TSPLIB instances show that RL-CMSA consistently finds (near-)best solutions and outperforms a state-of-the-art hybrid genetic algorithm under comparable time limits, especially as instance size and the number of salesmen increase.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合强化学习的混合算法(RL-CMSA)求解min-max多旅行商问题，通过概率聚类引导、集合覆盖MILP和局部搜索来平衡探索与开发，在大规模实例上优于现有混合遗传算法。
AI.motivation: 标准多旅行商问题(mTSP)通常以最小化总行程为目标，但实际应用中需要平衡各 salesman 的工作量。min-max 变体旨在最小化最长路径，反映负载均衡需求。现有方法在处理大规模实例时效率与解质量难以兼顾。
AI.method: 提出 RL-CMSA 混合方法，包含四个核心组件：(1) 使用强化学习学习的成对 q 值引导概率聚类来构造多样化解；(2) 将路线合并到紧凑的池中；(3) 求解受限的集合覆盖 MILP；(4) 通过跨路线移除、转移和交换操作进行解的精炼。q 值通过强化高质量解中城市对的共现来更新，池通过老化和剪枝进行自适应调整。
AI.result: 在随机实例和 TSPLIB 实例上的计算实验表明，RL-CMSA 一致地找到接近最优的解，在相同时间限制下优于现有的混合遗传算法，且随着实例规模和销售员数量增加，性能优势更加明显。
AI.conclusion: 结合精确优化与强化学习引导的构造策略能有效平衡探索与开发，RL-CMSA 是求解 min-max mTSP 的有效方法，尤其适合大规模问题。

title: Invariant-Driven Automated Testing
summary: Microservice architectures are an emergent technology that builds business logic into a suite of small services. Each microservice runs in its process and the communication is made through lightweight mechanisms, usually HTTP resource API. These architectures are built upon independently deployable and, supposedly, reliable pieces of software that may, or may not, have been developed by the team using it. Nowadays, industries are dangerously migrating into microservice architectures without an effective and automatic process for testing the software being used. Furthermore, current API specification languages are not expressive enough to be used for testing purposes. To solve this problem it is necessary to extend currently broadly used API specification languages. APOSTL is a specification language to annotate APIs specifications based on first-order logic, with some restrictions. It has the purpose of extending the currently used API description languages with properties that can be useful for testing purposes, transforming these description documents into useful testing artefacts. Besides providing information needed for testing an application, APOSTL also provides an API with semantic. This additional information is then leveraged to automate microservice testing. The work developed in this thesis aims to fully automate the microservice testing process. It is achieved by the implementation of PETIT a tool able to test microservices when provided with an OpenAPI Specification document, written in JSON and properly annotated with the previously proposed specification language, APOSTL. The tool is able to analyze microservices independently from the source code availability.

AI.tldr: 该论文（硕士论文）提出并实现了 APOSTL——一种基于一阶逻辑（带一定限制）的 API 规范注解语言，用于在 OpenAPI/Swagger 描述之上附加可用于测试的属性与语义信息；并实现了工具 PETIT，可在仅提供带 APOSTL 注解的 JSON 格式 OpenAPI 文档（无需源码）的情况下自动对微服务进行测试，从而推动微服务测试流程的自动化。
AI.motivation: 微服务架构将业务逻辑拆分为独立部署、通过轻量级 HTTP/REST 接口通信的小型服务 increasingly 被工业界广泛采用，但业界在迁移过程中缺乏有效且自动化的软件测试流程；现有 API 规范语言（如 OpenAPI/Swagger）的表达能力不足以支撑测试所需的属性描述，因此需要扩展广泛使用的 API 描述语言，使其既能提供测试所需的输入/前置条件与预期结果，又能携带语义信息以实现测试自动化。
AI.method: 方法分两部分：(1) 语言层面——设计 APOSTL，作为对既有 API 规范语言（OpenAPI）的注解扩展语言，以带限制的一阶逻辑为基础表达测试相关属性（状态、输入约束、输出预期、语义关联），把普通 API 描述文档转换为可用的测试制品（test artefact）；(2) 工具层面——实现 PETIT，输入为 JSON 格式且经 APOSTL 正确注解的 OpenAPI Specification 文档，工具对微服务进行分析与交互（对服务做黑盒/独立于源码的建模与验证），自动生成并执行测试用例，从而在不获取源代码的情况下完成微服务测试。
AI.result: PETIT 能够仅凭带 APOSTL 注解的 OpenAPI（JSON）文档对微服务进行测试：它解析并利用规范中的测试属性与语义信息，生成测试用例并与运行中的服务交互执行，从而实现了微服务测试的自动化；该工具可独立于源代码可用性进行分析与测试。作者通过一个真实的开源微服务案例进行了可行性验证。
AI.conclusion: 结论是：通过将 APOSTL（基于一阶逻辑的 API 注解语言）与 PETIT（自动化测试工具）结合，可以在没有源代码的情况下、利用既有 OpenAPI 文档实现微服务测试的完全自动化，弥补了当前 API 规范语言表达能力不足与微服务测试流程缺失的问题；该工作证明了“扩展现有 API 规范语言 + 语义驱动自动测试”这一路径的可行性，为微服务测试自动化提供了系统性方案。

title: EvoX: Meta-Evolution for Automated Discovery
summary: Recent work such as AlphaEvolve has shown that combining LLM-driven optimization with evolutionary search can effectively improve programs, prompts, and algorithms across domains. In this paradigm, previously evaluated solutions are reused to guide the model toward new candidate solutions. Crucially, the effectiveness of this evolution process depends on the search strategy: how prior solutions are selected and varied to generate new candidates. However, most existing methods rely on fixed search strategies with predefined knobs (e.g., explore-exploit ratios) that remain static throughout execution. While effective in some settings, these approaches often fail to adapt across tasks, or even within the same task as the search space changes over time. We introduce EvoX, an adaptive evolution method that optimizes its own evolution process. EvoX jointly evolves candidate solutions and the search strategies used to generate them, continuously updating how prior solutions are selected and varied based on progress. This enables the system to dynamically shift between different search strategies during the optimization process. Across nearly 200 real-world optimization tasks, EvoX outperforms existing AI-driven evolutionary methods including AlphaEvolve, OpenEvolve, GEPA, and ShinkaEvolve on the majority of tasks.

AI.tldr: EvoX是一种自适应进化方法，通过联合演化候选解决方案和搜索策略来解决静态搜索策略无法适应不同任务和搜索空间变化的问题。实验表明其在近200个真实优化任务上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM驱动的优化方法（如AlphaEvolve）虽然有效，但依赖于固定的搜索策略（如探索-利用比率），这些策略在执行过程中保持静态。然而，这种静态方法无法适应不同任务，也无法在同一任务中随搜索空间变化而调整，因此需要一种能够动态自适应调整搜索策略的方法。
AI.method: EvoX的核心方法是联合演化候选解决方案和搜索策略。该系统持续更新如何选择和变异先前的解决方案，基于搜索进展动态调整不同搜索策略之间的切换。这种元优化方法使系统能够自适应地调整搜索过程，而非使用固定的搜索策略。
AI.result: 在近200个真实优化任务上的实验表明，EvoX在大多数任务上优于现有的AI驱动进化方法，包括AlphaEvolve、OpenEvolve、GEPA和ShinkaEvolve，验证了自适应搜索策略的有效性。
AI.conclusion: EvoX通过联合演化候选解决方案和搜索策略，实现了搜索过程的动态自适应。在近200个真实优化任务中，EvoX在大多数任务上优于现有的AI驱动进化方法（包括AlphaEvolve、OpenEvolve、GEPA和ShinkaEvolve），证明了自适应搜索策略的有效性。

title: Dynamics of Learning under User Choice: Overspecialization and Peer-Model Probing
summary: In many economically relevant contexts where machine learning is deployed, multiple platforms obtain data from the same pool of users, each of whom selects the platform that best serves them. Prior work in this setting focuses exclusively on the "local" losses of learners on the distribution of data that they observe. We find that there exist instances where learners who use existing algorithms almost surely converge to models with arbitrarily poor global performance, even when models with low full-population loss exist. This happens through a feedback-induced mechanism, which we call the overspecialization trap: as learners optimize for users who already prefer them, they become less attractive to users outside this base, which further restricts the data they observe. Inspired by the recent use of knowledge distillation in modern ML, we propose an algorithm that allows learners to "probe" the predictions of peer models, enabling them to learn about users who do not select them. Our analysis characterizes when probing succeeds: this procedure converges almost surely to a stationary point with bounded full-population risk when probing sources are sufficiently informative, e.g., a known market leader or a majority of peers with good global performance. We verify our findings with semi-synthetic experiments on the MovieLens, Census, and Amazon Sentiment datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文研究"用户选择"驱动的多学习者机器学习市场中，标准在线学习（MSGD）会因反馈回路而收敛到"过度专门化"的坏均衡（局部损失低、全局风险任意差）；作者提出"对等模型探测"（peer-model probing，即知识蒸馏式查询同伴模型获取伪标签）算法 MSGD-P，证明其几乎必然收敛到修改后势函数的驻点，并在探测源足够可靠时给出全人群风险上界与样本复杂度。
AI.motivation: 在推荐平台、LLM 服务等市场中，多个学习者共享同一用户池，数据分布由用户选择内生决定，传统的"单一学习者+固定分布"假设失效。已有工作（如 Su & Dean 的 MSGD、Ginart et al.）只关注各学习者在自己观测到的子分布上的"局部"损失，未刻画全人群泛化；作者发现存在实例，即使用现有算法，学习者几乎必然收敛到全人群性能任意差的模型（尽管存在低全局损失的模型），形成"过度专门化陷阱"（algorithmic echo chamber）。另一方面，知识蒸馏/合成数据训练成为主流，为突破信息壁垒提供了机制动机，但多智能体"互相训练"动力学的理论仍空白。
AI.method: 设置：m 个学习者、用户按内在偏好 π(z) 与预测损失的加权选择 M(z;Θ)（比例 τ 决定偏好主导程度），每个学习者只在自己被选中的用户上做随机梯度更新。(1) 用随机逼近（Borkar 定理）+ Lyapunov 势函数 f(Θ)=Σ_i 各学习者"局部"期望损失，证明 MSGD 几乎必然收敛到 ∇f(Θ)=0 的驻点集（定理1），并给出 mini-batch 扩展。(2) 构造 1-D 反例族（两子群、斜率 C 与 -1），证明当 τ≥1/2 时均衡唯一且闭式，学习者在自己 niche 上损失为 0 而全局风险 ≥Γ，同时存在全局风险 ≤ε 的模型（定理2，Lemma 9-10）。(3) 提出 MSGD-P：离线阶段从 P_X 采样协变量并对同伴查询、中位数聚合得伪标签；在线阶段交替做有机更新与探测更新（权重 p、L2 正则 λ），修正势函数 f̃=f+p·探测项。(4) 证明 MSGD-P 几乎必然收敛到 ∇f̃=0（定理3）。(5) 定义"准确探测"假设（伪标签 MSE ≤ B）并给出四类场景：多数同伴好、市场领导者、部分知识、偏好感知；用中位数聚合的稳健性证明各自满足该假设（引理3）。(6) 用一点偏差技巧 + 经验/总体风险桥接 + 鞅方差界 + 统一收敛（Wainwright/Rademacher）证明全人群风险界 R(θ̃_i) ≤ O((p+1)/p·ε + B + λ‖θ*‖² + (p+1)C_gen/(pλ)·√(log(1/κ)/n))（定理4、推论1），交叉熵版本类似（定理5、推论2）。实验在 MovieLens、Census、Amazon Sentiment 半合成数据上验证。
AI.result: (1) MSGD 几乎必然收敛到局部损失势函数 f 的驻点，但当 τ≥1/2 时存在唯一均衡，学习者对自身子群零损失而全局风险可任意大（≥Γ），同时存在全局风险 ≤ε 的最优模型，说明"局部最优≠全局可用"。(2) MSGD-P 几乎必然收敛到修正势函数 f̃ 的驻点；probing 改变了收敛位置而非收敛性。(3) 在准确探测假设成立时，驻点处探测学习者的全人群风险被 O((p+1)/p·ε+B) 约束（n 足够大时），其中 B 反映伪标签偏差，p 控制有机数据与探测数据的权衡，λ 呈经典偏差-方差权衡；交叉熵损失有对应保证。(4) 四种探测场景给出明确的 B：多数同伴好与部分知识为 2R²r²+2ε（CE 为 ε+2Rr），市场领导者为 ξ，偏好感知为 ε（无需同伴质量假设）。(5) 实验显示标准学习会使部分模型陷入精度很差的陷阱，引入 peer probing 后显著弥合性能差距；经验上很小的探测数据集即可实现恢复（n 上界不紧）。
