AI.conclusion: 结论与展望：用户选择造成的信息屏障使标准多学习者在线学习必然陷入过度专门化均衡，peer-model probing（知识蒸馏式伪标签）可在一定信息条件下打破该屏障，把全人群风险限制在可接受范围；探测的收益随伪标签质量（探测源可信度或用户偏好知识）优雅退化。局限与未来方向：分析限于凸损失与线性模型（深度网络/MLP 仅实验性验证）；仅考虑离线探测，在线探测会带来共适应动力学与可能的模型坍塌；用户偏好仅用 K-means 模拟，可引入显式偏好数据或异质系数的多项 logit 等更丰富的选择模型。

title: MPU: Towards Secure and Privacy-Preserving Knowledge Unlearning for Large Language Models
summary: Machine unlearning for large language models often faces a privacy dilemma in which strict constraints prohibit sharing either the server's parameters or the client's forget set. To address this dual non-disclosure constraint, we propose MPU, an algorithm-agnostic privacy-preserving Multiple Perturbed Copies Unlearning framework that primarily introduces two server-side modules: Pre-Process for randomized copy generation and Post-Process for update aggregation. In Pre-Process, the server distributes multiple perturbed and reparameterized model instances, allowing the client to execute unlearning locally on its private forget set without accessing the server's exact original parameters. After local unlearning, the server performs Post-Process by inverting the reparameterization and aggregating updates with a harmonic denoising procedure to alleviate the impact of perturbation. Experiments with seven unlearning algorithms show that MPU achieves comparable unlearning performance to noise-free baselines, with most algorithms' average degradation well below 1% under 10% noise, and can even outperform the noise-free baseline for some algorithms under 1% noise. Code is available at https://github.com/Tristan-SHU/MPU.

AI.tldr: 针对大语言模型机器遗忘学习中服务器参数和客户端遗忘集均需保密的双重隐私约束问题，提出MPU框架，通过预处理生成扰动重参数化模型副本供客户端本地执行遗忘，后处理进行逆重参数化和调和去噪聚合更新。实验表明该方法在10%噪声下性能下降低于1%，低噪声下可超越无噪声基线。
AI.motivation: 机器遗忘学习面临隐私困境：严格的约束禁止共享服务器参数和客户端遗忘集，形成双重不披露约束的问题。
AI.method: 提出MPU（Multiple Perturbed Copies Unlearning）框架，包含两个核心模块：1）Pre-Process（预处理）：服务器生成分布式的扰动重参数化模型实例，使客户端可在不访问原始参数的情况下在本地私有遗忘集上执行遗忘；2）Post-Process（后处理）：服务器通过逆重参数化和调和去噪程序聚合更新以减轻扰动影响。
AI.result: 在七种遗忘算法上的实验表明，MPU能达到与无噪声基线相当的遗忘性能，在10%噪声下大多数算法平均性能下降低于1%，且在1%噪声下某些算法甚至可超越无噪声基线。
AI.conclusion: MPU框架通过引入Pre-Process和Post-Process两个服务器端模块，有效解决了大语言模型机器学习中双重不披露约束的隐私困境。该方法具有算法无关性，能够在保护双方隐私的前提下实现有效的遗忘学习，且在低噪声条件下甚至可超越无噪声基线。)

title: SleepLM: Natural-Language Intelligence for Human Sleep
summary: We present SleepLM, a family of sleep-language foundation models that enable human sleep alignment, interpretation, and interaction with natural language. Despite the critical role of sleep, learning-based sleep analysis systems operate in closed label spaces (e.g., predefined stages or events) and fail to describe, query, or generalize to novel sleep phenomena. SleepLM bridges natural language and multimodal polysomnography, enabling language-grounded representations of sleep physiology. To support this alignment, we introduce a multilevel sleep caption generation pipeline that enables the curation of the first large-scale sleep-text dataset, comprising over 100K hours of data from more than 10,000 individuals. Furthermore, we present a unified pretraining objective that combines contrastive alignment, caption generation, and signal reconstruction to better capture physiological fidelity and cross-modal interactions. Extensive experiments on real-world sleep understanding tasks verify that SleepLM outperforms state-of-the-art in zero-shot and few-shot learning, cross-modal retrieval, and sleep captioning. Importantly, SleepLM also exhibits intriguing capabilities including language-guided event localization, targeted insight generation, and zero-shot generalization to unseen tasks. All code and data will be open-sourced.

AI.tldr: SleepLM是一系列睡眠语言基础模型，通过多层次字幕生成管道构建首个大规模睡眠文本数据集（100K+小时，10K+个体），并采用对比对齐、字幕生成和信号重建的统一预训练目标，实现自然语言与多模态睡眠数据的对齐。该模型在多项任务上超越现有最佳方法，并具备零样本泛化和语言引导交互等新能力。
AI.motivation: 尽管睡眠对人体至关重要，但当前基于学习的睡眠分析系统只在封闭标签空间（如预定义的睡眠阶段或事件）中运作，无法描述、查询或泛化到新颖的睡眠现象。现有方法缺乏将睡眠生理数据与自然语言结合的能力，限制了人们对睡眠的深入理解和交互。
AI.method: 1) 构建多层次睡眠字幕生成管道，生成大规模睡眠文本数据集；2) 提出统一的预训练目标，结合对比对齐、字幕生成和信号重建三个任务，以捕捉生理保真度和跨模态交互；3) 支持零样本和少样本学习场景。
AI.result: 1) 成功构建了包含超过10万小时数据、来自1万多名个体的大规模睡眠文本数据集；2) 在零样本和少样本学习、跨模态检索和睡眠字幕生成等任务上优于现有最先进方法；3) 展现了语言引导的事件定位、针对性洞察生成和零样本泛化到未见任务等有趣能力。
AI.conclusion: SleepLM通过将睡眠生理信号与自然语言对齐，开创了睡眠分析的新范式。该模型在零样本/少样本学习、跨模态检索和睡眠字幕生成等任务上超越了现有最佳方法，并展现出语言引导的事件定位、针对性洞察生成和零样本泛化到未见任务的能力。团队承诺将开源所有代码和数据，这将进一步推动该领域的发展。

title: The Vocabulary of Flaky Tests in the Context of SAP HANA
summary: Background. Automated test execution is an important activity to gather information about the quality of a software project. So-called flaky tests, however, negatively affect this process. Such tests fail seemingly at random without changes to the code and thus do not provide a clear signal. Previous work proposed to identify flaky tests based on the source code identifiers in the test code. So far, these approaches have not been evaluated in a large-scale industrial setting. Aims. We evaluate approaches to identify flaky tests and their root causes based on source code identifiers in the test code in a large-scale industrial project. Method. First, we replicate previous work by Pinto et al. in the context of SAP HANA. Second, we assess different feature extraction techniques, namely TF-IDF and TF-IDFC-RF. Third, we evaluate CodeBERT and XGBoost as classification models. For a sound comparison, we utilize both the data set from previous work and two data sets from SAP HANA. Results. Our replication shows similar results on the original data set and on one of the SAP HANA data sets. While the original approach yielded an F1-Score of 0.94 on the original data set and 0.92 on the SAP HANA data set, our extensions achieve F1-Scores of 0.96 and 0.99, respectively. The reliance on external data sources is a common root cause for test flakiness in the context of SAP HANA. Conclusions. The vocabulary of a large industrial project seems to be slightly different with respect to the exact terms, but the categories for the terms, such as remote dependencies, are similar to previous empirical findings. However, even with rather large F1-Scores, both finding source code identifiers for flakiness and a black box prediction have limited use in practice as the results are not actionable for developers.

AI.tldr: 本文在 SAP HANA 大型工业项目中复现并扩展了基于源代码标识符识别 flaky 测试的方法。研究发现扩展方法可达到 F1=0.96-0.99 的准确率，外部依赖是主要 flaky 根因，但即使高准确率下该方法的实际可操作性仍有限。
AI.motivation: flaky tests（不稳定测试）会随机失败而代码无变化，影响软件质量评估过程的可靠性。现有基于源代码标识符识别 flaky 测试的方法未在大型工业环境中评估过。
AI.method: 1) 复现 Pinto 等人的工作；2) 评估 TF-IDF 和 TF-IDFC-RF 两种特征提取技术；3) 使用 CodeBERT 和 XGBoost 作为分类模型；4) 在原始数据集和两个 SAP HANA 数据集上进行比较实验。
AI.result: 复现实验在原始数据集和 SAP HANA 数据集上获得与原研究相似的结果（F1 分别为 0.94 和 0.92）。扩展方法将 F1 分数分别提升至 0.96 和 0.99。外部数据源依赖是 SAP HANA 项目中测试 flaky 的主要根因。
AI.conclusion: 在大型工业项目中，基于源代码标识符识别 flaky 测试的方法虽然能达到较高的 F1 分数（0.96 和 0.99），但实际应用价值有限，因为结果对开发人员不具有可操作性。词汇表与之前的研究存在细微差异，但标识符类别（如远程依赖）相似。外部数据源依赖是 SAP HANA 中测试 flaky 的主要根因。

title: Human Supervision as an Information Bottleneck: A Unified Theory of Error Floors in Human-Guided Learning
comment: Proceedings from IEEE CAI 2026, Conference on Artificial Intelligence, 8-10 May, Granada, Spain. 8 Pages, 3 Figures, 7 Tables
summary: Large language models are trained primarily on human-generated data and feedback, yet they exhibit persistent errors arising from annotation noise, subjective preferences, and the limited expressive bandwidth of natural language. We argue that these limitations reflect structural properties of the supervision channel rather than model scale or optimization. We develop a unified theory showing that whenever the human supervision channel is not sufficient for a latent evaluation target, it acts as an information-reducing channel that induces a strictly positive excess-risk floor for any learner dominated by it. We formalize this Human-Bounded Intelligence limit and show that across six complementary frameworks (operator theory, PAC-Bayes, information theory, causal inference, category theory, and game-theoretic analyses of reinforcement learning from human feedback), non-sufficiency yields strictly positive lower bounds arising from the same structural decomposition into annotation noise, preference distortion, and semantic compression. The theory explains why scaling alone cannot eliminate persistent human-aligned errors and characterizes conditions under which auxiliary non-human signals (e.g., retrieval, program execution, tools) increase effective supervision capacity and collapse the floor by restoring information about the latent target. Experiments on real preference data, synthetic known-target tasks, and externally verifiable benchmarks confirm the predicted structural signatures: human-only supervision exhibits a persistent floor, while sufficiently informative auxiliary channels strictly reduce or eliminate excess error.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"人类有限智能"(Human-Bounded Intelligence)理论,统一解释了为什么基于人类监督训练的大语言模型存在固有的误差下界。该理论基于六个互补框架(算子理论、PAC-Bayes、信息论、因果推理、范畴论、RLHF博弈分析)证明:当人类监督通道对潜在评估目标不足时,它会作为信息压缩通道,产生严格正的过量风险下界,无法通过 scaling 消除。辅助非人类信号(检索、程序执行、工具)可增加监督容量,消除该误差下界。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型主要基于人类生成的数据和反馈进行训练,但存在由注释噪声、主观偏好和自然语言表达带宽有限导致的持续性错误。作者认为这些限制反映了监督通道的结构性特性,而非模型规模或优化问题。
AI.method: 开发了统一理论框架,运用六个互补的分析方法:算子理论、PAC-Bayes理论、信息论、因果推理、范畴论、以及强化学习从人类反馈(RLHF)的博弈论分析。
AI.result: 证明了人类监督通道不足时产生严格正的过量风险下界(excess-risk floor),该下界源于注释噪声、偏好扭曲和语义压缩的相同结构分解。实验验证:纯人类监督存在持久误差下界,而充分信息的辅助通道可严格降低或消除过量误差。
AI.conclusion: Scaling alone cannot eliminate persistent human-aligned errors。辅助非人类信号(如检索、程序执行、工具)可通过恢复对潜在目标的信息来增加有效监督容量,从而消除误差下界。这为理解AI系统的根本性限制和突破路径提供了理论基础。

title: MMKG-RDS: Reasoning Data Synthesis via Deep Mining of Multimodal Knowledge Graphs
summary: Synthesizing high-quality training data is crucial for enhancing domain models' reasoning abilities. Existing methods face limitations in long-tail knowledge coverage, effectiveness verification, and interpretability. Knowledge-graph-based approaches still fall short in functionality, granularity, customizability, and evaluation. To address these issues, we propose MMKG-RDS, a flexible framework for reasoning data synthesis that leverages multimodal knowledge graphs. It supports fine-grained knowledge extraction, customizable path sampling, and multidimensional data quality scoring. We validate MMKG-RDS with the MMKG-RDS-Bench dataset, covering five domains, 17 task types, and 14,950 samples. Experimental results show fine-tuning Qwen3 models (0.6B/8B/32B) on a small number of synthesized samples improves reasoning accuracy by 9.2%. The framework also generates distinct data, challenging existing models on tasks involving tables and formulas, useful for complex benchmark construction. The dataset and code are available at https://github.com/360AILAB-NLP/MMKG-RDS

AI.tldr: 本文提出MMKG-RDS框架，利用多模态知识图谱合成高质量推理训练数据，解决现有方法在长尾知识覆盖、效果验证和可解释性方面的局限性。实验表明，在仅使用少量合成数据微调Qwen3模型后，推理准确率提升9.2%。
AI.motivation: 现有推理数据合成方法存在三大局限：1) 长尾知识覆盖不足；2) 效果验证困难；3) 可解释性差。现有基于知识图谱的方法在功能粒度、可定制性和评估方面仍不完善。
AI.method: 提出MMKG-RDS框架，包含：1) 细粒度知识提取；2) 可定制路径采样；3) 多维度数据质量评分。使用MMKG-RDS-Bench数据集进行验证，涵盖5个领域、17种任务类型、14,950个样本。
AI.result: 在MMKG-RDS-Bench数据集上，使用少量合成样本微调Qwen3模型(0.6B/8B/32B)后，推理准确率提升9.2%。框架生成的数据具有独特性，能够挑战现有模型在表格和公式任务上的能力，适用于复杂基准测试构建。
AI.conclusion: MMKG-RDS框架能够有效合成高质量推理训练数据，显著提升模型推理能力，且生成的数据对复杂基准测试构建具有重要价值。数据和代码已开源。

title: Context-Aware Functional Test Generation via Business Logic Extraction and Adaptation
summary: Functional testing is essential for verifying that the business logic of mobile applications aligns with user requirements, serving as the primary methodology for quality assurance in software development. Despite its importance, functional testing remains heavily dependent on manual effort due to two core challenges. First, acquiring and reusing complex business logic from unstructured requirements remains difficult, which hinders the understanding of specific functionalities. Second, a significant semantic gap exists when adapting business logic to the diverse GUI environments, which hinders the generation of test cases for specific mobile applications. To address the preceding challenges, we propose LogiDroid, a two-stage approach that generates individual functional test cases by extracting business logic and adapting it to target applications. First, in the Knowledge Retrieval and Fusion stage, we construct a dataset to retrieve relevant cases and extract business logic for the target functionality. Second, in the Context-Aware Test Generation stage, LogiDroid jointly analyzes the extracted business logic and the real-time GUI environment to generate functional test cases. This design allows LogiDroid to accurately understand application semantics and use domain expertise to generate complete test cases with verification assertions. We assess the effectiveness of LogiDroid using two widely-used datasets that cover 28 real-world applications and 190 functional requirements. Experimental results show that LogiDroid successfully tested 40% of functional requirements on the FrUITeR dataset (an improvement of over 48% compared to the state-of-the-art approaches) and 65% on the Lin dataset (an improvement of over 55% compared to the state-of-the-art approaches). These results demonstrate the significant effectiveness of LogiDroid in functional test generation.

AI.tldr: LogiDroid是一种用于Android移动应用功能测试自动生成的两阶段框架，通过知识检索与融合阶段提取业务逻辑，结合上下文感知测试生成阶段适配GUI环境，生成带有验证断言的完整测试用例。
AI.motivation: 功能测试是验证移动应用业务逻辑与用户需求一致性的关键方法，是软件质量保证的主要方法。尽管重要，功能测试仍严重依赖人工，面临两个核心挑战：1) 从非结构化需求中获取和复用复杂业务逻辑困难，阻碍了对特定功能的理解；2) 将业务逻辑适配到多样化GUI环境时存在显著语义障碍，阻碍了针对特定移动应用的测试用例生成。
AI.method: 提出LogiDroid，一种两阶段方法：1) 知识检索与融合阶段（Knowledge Retrieval and Fusion）：构建数据集检索相关案例并提取目标功能的业务逻辑；2) 上下文感知测试生成阶段（Context-Aware Test Generation）：联合分析提取的业务逻辑和实时GUI环境以生成功能测试用例。
AI.result: 在覆盖28个真实应用和190个功能需求的两个广泛使用的数据集上评估LogiDroid的有效性。结果显示：FrUITeR数据集上成功测试了40%的功能需求（比最先进方法提升48%以上）；Lin数据集上成功测试了65%的功能需求（比最先进方法提升55%以上）。
AI.conclusion: LogiDroid通过两阶段方法成功生成了针对移动应用的功能测试用例，在FrUITeR数据集上测试了40%的功能需求（比最先进方法提升48%以上），在Lin数据集上测试了65%的功能需求（比最先进方法提升55%以上），证明了其在功能测试生成方面的显著有效性。

title: Global Interpretability via Automated Preprocessing: A Framework Inspired by Psychiatric Questionnaires
summary: Psychiatric questionnaires are highly context sensitive and often only weakly predict subsequent symptom severity, which makes the prognostic relationship difficult to learn. Although flexible nonlinear models can improve predictive accuracy, their limited interpretability can erode clinical trust. In fields such as imaging and omics, investigators commonly address visit- and instrument-specific artifacts by extracting stable signal through preprocessing and then fitting an interpretable linear model. We adopt the same strategy for questionnaire data by decoupling preprocessing from prediction: we restrict nonlinear capacity to a baseline preprocessing module that estimates stable item values, and then learn a linear mapping from these stabilized baseline items to future severity. We refer to this two-stage method as REFINE (Redundancy-Exploiting Follow-up-Informed Nonlinear Enhancement), which concentrates nonlinearity in preprocessing while keeping the prognostic relationship transparently linear and therefore globally interpretable through a coefficient matrix, rather than through post hoc local attributions. In experiments, REFINE outperforms other interpretable approaches while preserving clear global attribution of prognostic factors across psychiatric and non-psychiatric longitudinal prediction tasks.

AI.tldr: REFINE是一种用于精神科纵向预测的两阶段方法，通过将非线性能力限制在预处理阶段来估计稳定的基线项目值，然后学习从这些稳定化的基线项目到未来严重程度的线性映射，从而在保持全局可解释性的同时提高预测准确性。
AI.motivation: 精神科问卷对上下文敏感，且对后续症状严重程度的预测能力较弱，导致预后关系难以学习。虽然灵活的非线性模型可以提高预测准确性，但其有限的解释性可能削弱临床信任度。
AI.method: 采用两阶段策略：1) 非线性预处理模块：估计稳定的项目值，处理访问和仪器特异性伪影；2) 线性预测模块：从稳定化的基线项目学习到未来严重程度的线性映射，使预后关系透明且全局可解释。
AI.result: REFINE在精神和非精神纵向预测任务中优于其他可解释方法，同时保持了预后因素的清晰全局归因。
AI.conclusion: 通过将非线性集中在预处理阶段并保持线性预测层，REFINE成功实现了高预测准确性和全局可解释性的平衡，为精神科纵向预测任务提供了有效解决方案。

title: AI Must Embrace Specialization via Superhuman Adaptable Intelligence
summary: Everyone from AI executives and researchers to doomsayers, politicians, and activists is talking about Artificial General Intelligence (AGI). Yet, they often don't seem to agree on its exact definition. One common definition of AGI is an AI that can do everything a human can do, but are humans truly general? In this paper, we address what's wrong with our conception of AGI, and why, even in its most coherent formulation, it is a flawed concept to describe the future of AI. We explore whether the most widely accepted definitions are plausible, useful, and truly general. We argue that AI must embrace specialization, rather than strive for generality, and in its specialization strive for superhuman performance, and introduce Superhuman Adaptable Intelligence (SAI). SAI is defined as intelligence that can learn to exceed humans at anything important that we can do, and that can fill in the skill gaps where humans are incapable. We then lay out how SAI can help hone a discussion around AI that was blurred by an overloaded definition of AGI, and extrapolate the implications of using it as a guide for the future.

AI.tldr: 本文批判了AGI(通用人工智能)概念的模糊性与内在缺陷,认为即使在其最连贯的表述中,AGI也是一个有问题的未来AI描述框架。作者提出用"超级适应性智能"(SAI)替代AGI——即能够学会在人类擅长的一切重要事务上超越人类,并填补人类能力缺口的智能。文章探讨了SAI如何帮助澄清被AGI模糊化的AI讨论,并展望了其对未来AI发展的指导意义。
AI.motivation: 当前关于AGI的讨论众说纷纭,各方对其定义缺乏共识。AGI最常见的定义是"能完成人类所能做的一切的AI",但这一概念存在根本性问题:人类本身是否真的"通用"?作者认为需要重新审视AGI这一概念本身的合理性。
AI.method: 通过哲学分析探讨最广泛接受的AGI定义是否合理、有用且真正"通用";提出SAI作为替代概念并阐述其定义与特征。
AI.result: 认为AGI即使在其最连贯的形式下也是一个有缺陷的概念;AI应该拥抱专业化而非追求通用性,应追求超越人类的表现;提出SAI作为更合理的未来AI发展指导框架。
AI.conclusion: AI发展应放弃对通用性的追求,转而专注于在特定领域达到超越人类的表现,并具备填补人类能力缺口的适应性。SAI概念可替代AGI,为未来AI讨论提供更清晰的指导方向。

title: From Flat Logs to Causal Graphs: Hierarchical Failure Attribution for LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems
summary: LLM-powered Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in complex domains but suffer from inherent fragility and opaque failure mechanisms. Existing failure attribution methods, whether relying on direct prompting, costly replays, or supervised fine-tuning, typically treat execution logs as flat sequences. This linear perspective fails to disentangle the intricate causal links inherent to MAS, leading to weak observability and ambiguous responsibility boundaries. To address these challenges, we propose CHIEF, a novel framework that transforms chaotic trajectories into a structured hierarchical causal graph. It then employs hierarchical oracle-guided backtracking to efficiently prune the search space via sybthesized virtual oracles. Finally, it implements counterfactual attribution via a progressive causal screening strategy to rigorously distinguish true root causes from propagated symptoms. Experiments on Who&When benchmark show that CHIEF outperforms eight strong and state-of-the-art baselines on both agent- and step-level accuracy. Ablation studies further confirm the critical role of each proposed module.

AI.tldr: CHIEF是一个用于LLM多智能体系统(MAS)故障溯源的新型框架，通过将混沌轨迹转化为分层因果图，结合分层oracle引导的回溯和反事实归因来准确定位真正的根本原因。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM-powered MAS故障归因方法存在脆弱性和故障机制不透明的问题。现有方法（直接提示、成本高昂的重放或监督微调）将执行日志视为扁平序列，这种线性视角无法解构MAS中固有的复杂因果联系，导致观测性弱和责任边界模糊。
AI.method: 提出CHIEF框架，包含三个核心模块：1）将混沌轨迹转化为结构化分层因果图；2）利用分层oracle引导的回溯，通过合成虚拟oracle高效剪枝搜索空间；3）通过渐进式因果筛选策略实施反事实归因，严格区分真正根本原因与传播症状。
AI.result: 在Who&When基准测试上，CHIEF在智能体级和步骤级准确率方面均优于8个强基线和最先进方法。消融研究进一步证实了每个提出模块的关键作用。
AI.conclusion: CHIEF通过层次化因果建模和oracle引导的搜索策略，有效解决了MAS故障归因中因果链解构和责任边界模糊的核心挑战，为复杂多智能体系统的可观测性和可解释性提供了新思路。

title: Uncertainty-aware Language Guidance for Concept Bottleneck Models
summary: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) provide inherent interpretability by first mapping input samples to high-level semantic concepts, followed by a combination of these concepts for the final classification. However, the annotation of human-understandable concepts requires extensive expert knowledge and labor, constraining the broad adoption of CBMs. On the other hand, there are a few works that leverage the knowledge of large language models (LLMs) to construct concept bottlenecks. Nevertheless, they face two essential limitations: First, they overlook the uncertainty associated with the concepts annotated by LLMs and lack a valid mechanism to quantify uncertainty about the annotated concepts, increasing the risk of errors due to hallucinations from LLMs. Additionally, they fail to incorporate the uncertainty associated with these annotations into the learning process for concept bottleneck models. To address these limitations, we propose a novel uncertainty-aware CBM method, which not only rigorously quantifies the uncertainty of LLM-annotated concept labels with valid and distribution-free guarantees, but also incorporates quantified concept uncertainty into the CBM training procedure to account for varying levels of reliability across LLM-annotated concepts. We also provide the theoretical analysis for our proposed method. Extensive experiments on the real-world datasets validate the desired properties of our proposed methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种不确定性感知的概念瓶颈模型(CBM)方法，解决大语言模型(LLM)标注概念时的不确定性问题。该方法对LLM标注的概念标签进行严格的不确定性量化，并将其融入CBM训练过程，以应对不同LLM标注概念的可靠性差异。
AI.motivation: 概念瓶颈模型虽具有可解释性，但需专家知识进行概念标注，成本高昂。尽管已有工作利用LLM构建概念瓶颈，但存在两个关键局限：(1)忽视LLM标注概念的不确定性，缺乏有效的不确定性量化机制，增加了LLM幻觉导致错误的风险；(2)未将标注不确定性纳入CBM学习过程。
AI.method: 提出一种新型不确定性感知CBM方法：(1)对LLM标注的概念标签进行严格的不确定性量化，提供有效且分布无关的保证；(2)将量化后的概念不确定性融入CBM训练过程，以处理不同LLM标注概念间的可靠性差异。
AI.result: 在真实数据集上进行了广泛实验，验证了所提方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能够有效量化LLM标注概念的不确定性，并将其融入训练过程，提高模型的可靠性。理论分析支撑了所提方法的有效性。

title: PseudoAct: Leveraging Pseudocode Synthesis for Flexible Planning and Action Control in Large Language Model Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents typically rely on reactive decision-making paradigms such as ReAct, selecting actions conditioned on growing execution histories. While effective for short tasks, these approaches often lead to redundant tool usage, unstable reasoning, and high token consumption in complex long-horizon tasks involving branching, iteration, or multi-tool coordination. To address these limitations, this paper introduces PseudoAct, a novel framework for flexible planning and action control in LLM agents through pseudocode synthesis. Leveraging the ability of LLMs to express task-solving strategies as code, PseudoAct synthesizes a structured pseudocode plan that decomposes a task into subtasks and explicitly encodes control flow, including sequencing, conditionals, loops, parallel composition, and combinations of these logic primitives. Actions are then executed by following this global plan, making the decision logic explicit and temporally coherent. This design reduces redundant actions, prevents infinite loops, and avoids uninformative alternative exploration, enabling consistent and efficient long-horizon decision-making. Experiments on benchmark datasets show that our method significantly outperforms existing reactive agent approaches, achieving a 20.93% absolute gain in success rate on FEVER and setting a new state-of-the-art on HotpotQA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PseudoAct框架，通过伪代码合成实现LLM智能体的灵活规划和动作控制。该方法将任务求解策略表达为结构化伪代码，明确编码控制流（顺序、条件、循环、并行组合），使决策逻辑显式且时间连贯，有效解决长程任务中的冗余动作、不稳定推理和高token消耗问题。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体主要依赖ReAct等反应式决策范式，仅基于不断增长的执行历史选择动作。这种方法在复杂长程任务中（涉及分支、迭代或多工具协调）存在三大缺陷：1) 冗余工具使用；2) 不稳定推理；3) 高token消耗。需要一种能够进行前瞻性规划而非仅反应式决策的框架。
AI.method: PseudoAct利用LLM能够将任务求解策略表达为代码的能力，合成结构化伪代码计划。具体包括：1) 将任务分解为子任务；2) 显式编码控制流（顺序、条件判断、循环、并行组合及混合逻辑原语）；3) 智能体按照该全局计划执行动作，使决策逻辑显式且时间连贯。
AI.result: 实验在基准数据集上表明，该方法显著优于现有反应式智能体方法：在FEVER上实现20.93%的绝对成功率提升；在HotpotQA上创下新的最先进水平。
AI.conclusion: PseudoAct通过伪代码合成实现了LLM智能体的前瞻性规划能力，有效减少了冗余动作、防止无限循环、避免无信息量的备选探索，为复杂长程任务提供了一致且高效的决策解决方案。

title: ODAR: Principled Adaptive Routing for LLM Reasoning via Active Inference
summary: The paradigm of large language model (LLM) reasoning is shifting from parameter scaling to test-time compute scaling, yet many existing approaches still rely on uniform brute-force sampling (for example, fixed best-of-N or self-consistency) that is costly, hard to attribute, and can trigger overthinking with diminishing returns. We propose ODAR-Expert, an adaptive routing framework that optimizes the accuracy-efficiency trade-off via principled resource allocation. ODAR uses a difficulty estimator grounded in amortized active inference to dynamically route queries between a heuristic Fast Agent and a deliberative Slow Agent. We further introduce a free-energy-principled, risk-sensitive fusion mechanism that selects answers by minimizing a variational free energy objective, balancing log-likelihood with epistemic uncertainty (varentropy) as a principled alternative to ad hoc voting over heterogeneous candidates. Extensive evaluation across 23 benchmarks shows strong and consistent gains, including 98.2% accuracy on MATH and 54.8% on Humanity's Last Exam (HLE), while improving the compute-accuracy frontier under compute-matched settings. We also validate reproducibility on a fully open-source stack (Llama 4 + DeepSeek), where ODAR surpasses homogeneous sampling strategies while reducing computational costs by 82%. Overall, our results suggest that thinking-optimal scaling requires adaptive resource allocation with free-energy-based decision-making rather than simply increasing test-time compute.

AI.tldr: ODAR（Open-Domain Adaptive Reasoner）把 LLM 测试时计算扩展从"均匀暴力采样"改造成"难度感知的自适应资源分配"：用基于摊销主动推断（Active Inference）的轻量难度估计器把查询路由到 Simple/Medium/Hard 三条路径（分别 1/2/6 次模型调用），再用自由能原理（FEP）驱动的风险敏感融合模块（字符级能量密度 + varentropy 罚项 + 模型级 Z-score 对齐）从异构候选中选答案。23 个基准上平均准确率 89.6%（较 Self-Consistency +6.0%），MATH 98.2%、HLE 54.8%、IMO2025 +20.2%，计算匹配下成本降 1.78×；全开源栈 Open-ODAR（Llama 4 + DeepSeek V3.2）达 84.4%，成本降 82%。
AI.motivation: LLM 推理正从参数扩展转向测试时计算扩展（CoT、Self-Consistency、Best-of-N、验证器选择），但这些方法采用统一的暴力采样：(1) 计算的边际收益高度依赖查询难度——简单题过度推理会"overthinking"并退化，难题则受益于深度搜索；(2) 成本高且难以归因，现有路由/编排方法多为固定策略或依赖启发式融合（投票），缺乏端到端、既成本感知又有理论依据的方案。论文目标是让推理推理过程成为一个"资源分配"问题：用摊销的主动推断预测难度并分配算力，用自由能最小化替代 ad-hoc 投票，从而在准确率-成本帕累托前沿上取得支配。
AI.method: 四个核心组件：(1) Difficulty Estimator（DE）：24 维手工特征（8 词法 + 6 结构 + 10 语义，含 TF-IDF 领域词表、难度标记密度、DistilBERT 8 类领域分类概率）+ 线性投影 σ(Wφ(x)+b)，以 MSE+L2 训练；标签为"经验期望自由能" d* = α·归一化人类解题时间 T_human（认知负荷代理）+ (1-α)·(1-Acc_fast)（语用风险），α=0.5，训练集 2000 条校准样本（Adam, lr 1e-3, 50 epoch）。(2) 双智能体：Fast Agent = GPT-5.1（T=0.2, 512 token, 提示限 ≤3 步、禁自纠错）；Slow Agent = Claude-4.5 Sonnet（T=0.3, 1024 token；Medium 走 Restate→Validate→Judge→Correct 验证协议，Hard 走 Analyze→Strategize→Execute→Verify 独立求解）。(3) 路由：阈值 τ1=0.3, τ2=0.7（按 Accuracy/AvgCost 网格搜索标定）分三路径——Simple: 1 次 Fast（41% 查询）；Medium: Fast+Slow 验证，2 次（35%）；Hard: 1 Fast + 5 Slow 独立样本，6 次（24%，覆盖 93% 的 HLE 题）；加权平均 2.55 次调用，约为 SC(n=5) 的 1/1.96。Fast/Slow 分工受 Theta-Gamma 相位-幅度耦合（阈值门控条件计算）的功能性类比启发。(4) FEP 融合：变分自由能 F(y|x)=D_KL[q(s|y)||p(s|x)]−E[log p(y|s,x)]；因潜变量项不可计算，改用风险敏感控制：熵风险测度（指数效用）二阶泰勒展开得到均值-方差目标 F ≈ −(1/|y|)Σ log p(y_t|y_<t,x) + λ·Var_t[−log p(y_t|·)]（varentropy，λ=0.1）；再经字符级能量密度归一化（类似 bits-per-character，消除分词粒度偏差）与按模型校准的 Z-score 对齐（F̃=(F_raw−μ_m)/σ_m）实现跨模型可比比较，Medium 用 Boltzmann 权重、Hard 取 argmin；并剔除 BOS/EOS/填充与格式模板 token 以避免稀释认知不确定性信号。另有规则化 ER/MR/SS 编排层（模态/关键词/题型优先级），不参与训练。
AI.result: 主结果（3 seeds，>5000 样本数据集用 K=5 分层折）：23 基准 8 大类平均 89.6%，最强基线 Self-Consistency 83.6%（+6.0），22/23 数据集 SOTA；MATH 98.2%、GSM8K 99.1%、IFEval 98.1%、MMLU-Pro 94.2%、BBH 95.4%、GPQA 78.5%、ARC-AGI-2 41.5%、SWE-bench 74.2%、IMO2025 68.7%（+20.2）、HLE 54.8%（+12.0）。计算匹配协议下成本 0.42 vs SC 0.75（1.78× 更低）；效率分 2.8（TOPS 1.2、Best-of-N 0.7）；帕累托分析显示以 2.1× 成本达 95.0%（SC 需 >5×），并以更低 token 消耗超过 o3-mini。Open-ODAR（Llama 4 Scout + DeepSeek V3.2，vLLM FP8）：8 数据集平均 84.4% vs DeepSeek SC 82.0%，成本 4.5× vs 25×（−82%）。消融：去 DE → 成本 2.55×→6.0× 而准确率变化 <0.5%；去 Slow Agent/FEP → HLE −12.0%；关 ER/MR 仅 −1.2%（说明 DE 是主要增益来源）；同预算随机路由 −8.3%（说明"算力花在哪"与"算力多少"同等重要）；FEP 融合优于 max-confidence/投票/平均对数概率 +1.2%（TruthfulQA +1.5%）；训练无关的 FEP 与 800k 样本监督 PRM 在 MATH 相当（−0.4%）、HLE 更好（+1.5%）。其他分析：DE 与数据集中序列难度相关 r=0.73，类别难度与 Hard 路径占比 r=0.84；Oracle 最优性 94.1%，"安全税"+0.60×；延迟中位 9.9s、均值 26.6s，41% 查询 <3s、24% >60s（5 路 Slow 并行后 32s→12.4s）；对抗测试中复杂度注入仅 −0.2% 准确率但成本 +154%，简单性伪装 −6.4%；100 例错误人工分析中 66% 源于模型固有局限（知识缺口 27%、推理逻辑 39%），系统级错误 34%（难度估计 8%、验证误接受 12%、FEP 漏选 9%）。统计显著性用配对分层 bootstrap（10,000 次）与 McNemar 检验 + BH 校正，Δ 的 95% CI 全为正。
AI.conclusion: 结论：单纯堆测试时算力的"暴力扩展"范式应让位于"自适应资源分配 + 自由能式决策"，即 thinking-optimal scaling 需要按问题难度比例分配算力并用统一的风险敏感准则从异构候选中选答。论文明确列出三点局限：Hard Path 尾延迟 >60s 限制实时部署；66% 残余错误来自基座模型知识/推理能力上限，收益递减；FEP 依赖 token 级 log-probabilities，限制在无透明推理接口环境中的可移植性，未来将探索轻量、无 logit 的不确定性估计。评价：方法论上把"路由+选择"统一到同一套变分自由能/主动推断语言下，字符级+模型级归一化解决异构模型可比性、工程实现（Docker、FP8、预计算校准统计、提示模板与算法伪码完整）较完整；但"理论"部分更多是事后形式化包装——摊销主动推断实为以人类解题时间与 Fast Agent 正确率为标签的有监督回归（需昂贵标注），EFE 的 KL 项从未真正计算，风险敏感二阶展开与弱遍历性假设均为近似；正文强调"结构先验优于语义嵌入"却与其自身特征消融（语义特征占 56% 重要性，且含 DistilBERT 分类器）矛盾；若干内部数值不一致（HLE 54.8% vs 47.3%、开源栈成本 4.5× vs 25× 的计费口径）、基座模型在 MATH/HLE 上的极高绝对分数与文献惯例差异较大，可复现性与外部效度仍需第三方验证。

title: CIRCLE: A Framework for Evaluating AI from a Real-World Lens
summary: This paper proposes CIRCLE, a six-stage, lifecycle-based framework to bridge the reality gap between model-centric performance metrics and AI's materialized outcomes in deployment. While existing frameworks like MLOps focus on system stability and benchmarks measure abstract capabilities, decision-makers outside the AI stack lack systematic evidence about the behavior of AI technologies under real-world user variability and constraints. CIRCLE operationalizes the Validation phase of TEVV (Test, Evaluation, Verification, and Validation) by formalizing the translation of stakeholder concerns outside the stack into measurable signals. Unlike participatory design, which often remains localized, or algorithmic audits, which are often retrospective, CIRCLE provides a structured, prospective protocol for linking context-sensitive qualitative insights to scalable quantitative metrics. By integrating methods such as field testing, red teaming, and longitudinal studies into a coordinated pipeline, CIRCLE produces systematic knowledge: evidence that is comparable across sites yet sensitive to local context. This can enable governance based on materialized downstream effects rather than theoretical capabilities.

AI.tldr: CIRCLE 是一个六阶段、基于生命周期的方法框架，用于弥合以模型为中心的性能指标与 AI 在部署中实际产生的结果之间的"现实鸿沟"。它将 TEVV（测试、评估、验证、确认）中的验证（Validation）阶段操作化，把 AI 技术栈之外的利益相关者的关切转译为可测量的信号，并通过现场测试、红队测试与纵向研究等方法的协同流水线，产出既可跨站点比较、又对本地情境敏感的"系统性知识"，从而支撑基于实际下游效果的治理。
AI.motivation: 当前 AI 评估体系存在结构性断裂：一方面 MLOps 等框架聚焦系统稳定性与上线运维指标，另一方面基准测试（benchmarks）测量的是抽象化的模型能力，两者都无法回答"AI 在真实用户 variability 与现实约束下究竟如何表现"。而真正需要做部署决策的人——技术栈之外的利益相关者、决策者、治理方——缺乏系统性的证据来源来预判技术行为。同时既有的两种替代路径各有局限：参与式设计（participatory design）往往局限于局部、难以规模化；算法审计（algorithmic audits）多为事后回顾性，无法在部署前提供前瞻性指引。因此需要一个能把情境化的定性洞察与可扩展的定量指标相连的结构化、前瞻性的验证协议。
AI.method: 核心思路是操作化 TEVV 框架中的 Validation 阶段，将"外部利益相关者的关切"形式化翻译为可测量信号，并按六阶段生命周期组织成协调流水线。方法上整合三类互补手段：（1）现场测试（field testing），在真实使用情境与约束下收集行为证据；（2）红队测试（red teaming），主动探查失败模式与边界；（3）纵向研究（longitudinal studies），追踪随时间的漂移与长期效应。关键设计在于其"翻译机制"：将非技术方的问题表述映射到指标空间，同时保留情境敏感性，使不同站点之间的证据具有可比性（comparability across sites），又不过度脱离本地语境（sensitive to local context）。定位上区别于参与式设计的局部性与算法审计的回溯性，强调结构化与前瞻性（prospective protocol）。
AI.result: 论文提出的主张是：CIRCLE 能够产出一类"系统性知识"（systematic knowledge）——即跨站点可比、同时对本地情境敏感的证据。这种知识把用户变异性与现实约束纳入测量范围，从而把治理依据从"理论能力/抽象基准"转向"已实现的（materialized）下游效果"。具体实证规模、量化改进幅度或案例验证结果在所给文本中未披露（内容仅含摘要层级的框架性论述）。
AI.conclusion: CIRCLE 通过将验证阶段操作化并建立六阶段生命周期框架，为 AI 技术栈之外的决策者提供了系统性、前瞻性的证据基础，使 AI 治理可以建立在部署中实际发生的下游影响之上，而非理论能力之上。其隐含结论是：验证不应被视为发布前的一次性关卡，而应作为贯穿生命周期的、连接定性与定量证据的持续协议；填补这一"现实鸿沟"是实现以效果为导向的 AI 治理的必要前提。

title: Sample Size Calculations for Developing Clinical Prediction Models: Overview and pmsims R package
summary: Background: Clinical prediction models are increasingly used to inform healthcare decisions, but determining the minimum sample size for their development remains a critical and unresolved challenge. Inadequate sample sizes can lead to overfitting, poor generalisability, and biased predictions. Existing approaches, such as heuristic rules, closed-form formulas, and simulation-based methods, vary in flexibility and accuracy, particularly for complex data structures and machine learning models. Methods: We review current methodologies for sample size estimation in prediction modelling and introduce a conceptual framework that distinguishes between mean-based and assurance-based criteria. Building on this, we propose a novel simulation-based approach that integrates learning curves, Gaussian Process optimisation, and assurance principles to identify sample sizes that achieve target performance with high probability. This approach is implemented in pmsims, an open-source, model-agnostic R package. Results: Through case studies, we demonstrate that sample size estimates vary substantially across methods, performance metrics, and modelling strategies. Compared to existing tools, pmsims provides flexible, efficient, and interpretable solutions that accommodate diverse models and user-defined metrics while explicitly accounting for variability in model performance. Conclusions: Our framework and software advance sample size methodology for clinical prediction modelling by combining flexibility with computational efficiency. Future work should extend these methods to hierarchical and multimodal data, incorporate fairness and stability metrics, and address challenges such as missing data and complex dependency structures.

AI.tldr: 本文解决了临床预测模型开发中样本量确定的难题，提出了结合学习曲线、高斯过程优化和保证原则的模拟方法，并开发了开源R包pmsims，为不同模型和指标提供灵活、高效的样本量估计解决方案。
AI.motivation: 临床预测模型开发中确定最小样本量仍是一个关键且未解决的挑战。样本量不足会导致过拟合、泛化性差和预测偏差。现有方法在复杂数据结构和机器学习模型中的灵活性和准确性存在差异。
AI.method: 回顾当前预测建模样本量估计方法，提出一种结合学习曲线、高斯过程优化和保证原则的新型模拟方法，在pmsims R包中实现。
AI.result: 样本量估计在不同方法、性能指标和建模策略之间存在显著差异。与现有工具相比，pmsims提供了灵活、高效且可解释的解决方案，可容纳不同模型和用户定义的指标，同时明确考虑模型性能的变异性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架和软件通过将灵活性与计算效率相结合，推进了临床预测建模的样本量方法学。未来工作应扩展到层次化和多模态数据、纳入公平性和稳定性指标，并解决缺失数据和复杂依赖结构等挑战。

title: Neural Operators Can Discover Functional Clusters
summary:
Operator learning is reshaping scientific computing by amortizing inference across infinite families of problems. While neural operators (NOs) are increasingly well understood for regression, far less is known for classification and its unsupervised analogue: clustering. We prove that sample-based neural operators can learn any finite collection of classes in an infinite-dimensional reproducing kernel Hilbert space, even when the classes are neither convex nor connected, under mild kernel sampling assumptions. Our universal clustering theorem shows that any $K$ closed classes can be approximated to arbitrary precision by NO-parameterized classes in the upper Kuratowski topology on closed sets, a notion that can be interpreted as disallowing false-positive misclassifications.
  Building on this, we develop an NO-powered clustering pipeline for functional data and apply it to unlabeled families of ordinary differential equation (ODE) trajectories. Discretized trajectories are lifted by a fixed pre-trained encoder into a continuous feature map and mapped to soft assignments by a lightweight trainable head. Experiments on diverse synthetic ODE benchmarks show that the resulting practical SNO recovers latent dynamical structure in regimes where classical methods fail, providing evidence consistent with our universal clustering theory.

AI.tldr: 本文研究神经算子(NO)的聚类能力，提出 universal clustering theorem，证明NO可在RKHS中逼近任意有限类(即使非凸非连通)。基于理论提出SNO聚类pipeline，用于函数数据和ODE轨迹聚类，在合成基准测试中验证了方法有效性。
AI.motivation: 虽然神经算子(NOs)在回归任务上越来越被理解，但在分类及其无监督对应任务——聚类上的研究很少。函数数据的聚类在科学计算中很重要，但缺乏理论基础。
AI.method: 1) 理论证明：基于无限维再生核希尔伯特空间(RKHS)，证明样本基神经算子可以学习任意有限类集合，即使类是非凸非连通的 2) 拓扑框架：使用上Kuratowski拓扑(闭集上的拓扑)来形式化逼近 notion，确保不允许假阳性误分类 3) 实用pipeline：预训练编码器将离散轨迹提升为连续特征图，轻量级可训练头部映射到软分配
AI.result: 1) 理论：任何K个闭类都可以被NO参数化的类以任意精度在上Kuratowski拓扑中逼近 2) 实验：SNO方法能在经典方法失效的 regime 下恢复潜在的动力学结构
AI.conclusion: 提出的理论框架为神经算子在聚类任务中的应用奠定了数学基础，证明了在温和的核采样假设下，NO可以任意精度地逼近任意K个闭类。通过在合成ODE基准测试上的实验验证了理论，表明SNO方法能够在经典方法失效的情况下恢复潜在的动力学结构，为函数数据的无监督学习提供了新的pipeline。

title: ProductResearch: Training E-Commerce Deep Research Agents via Multi-Agent Synthetic Trajectory Distillation
summary: Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents show promise for e-commerce conversational shopping, yet existing implementations lack the interaction depth and contextual breadth required for complex product research. Meanwhile, the Deep Research paradigm, despite advancing information synthesis in web search, suffers from domain gaps when transferred to e-commerce. We propose ProductResearch, a multi-agent framework that synthesizes high-fidelity, long-horizon tool-use trajectories for training robust e-commerce shopping agents. The framework employs a User Agent to infer nuanced shopping intents from behavioral histories, and a Supervisor Agent that orchestrates iterative collaboration with a Research Agent to generate synthetic trajectories culminating in comprehensive, insightful product research reports. These trajectories are rigorously filtered and distilled through a reflective internalization process that consolidates multi-agent supervisory interactions into coherent single-role training examples, enabling effective fine-tuning of LLM agents for complex shopping inquiries. Extensive experiments show that a compact MoE model fine-tuned on our synthetic data achieves substantial improvements over its base model in response comprehensiveness, research depth, and user-perceived utility, approaching the performance of frontier proprietary deep research systems and establishing multi-agent synthetic trajectory training as an effective and scalable paradigm for enhancing LLM-based shopping assistance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ProductResearch：一个多智能体合成框架，用 User Agent（生成画像/复杂查询/动态评分细则）、Research Agent（Plan→Toolcall→Report 的 ReAct 长程轨迹）、Supervisor Agent（三阶段状态机逐步校验并反馈纠错）合成电商深度研究轨迹，再经长度过滤与“反思内化”蒸馏为单角色序列，用于微调 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507。微调后模型在自建的电商产品研究报告基准上 RACE 总分从 31.78 提升到 45.40，有效产品数从 3.58 提升到 12.45，逼近最强闭源系统 Gemini-DeepResearch（45.56）。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 购物助手（购物对话/推荐/多模态）主要优化任务完成率或商品召回，缺少面向复杂购买决策所需的交互深度、证据强度与情境广度，ReAct 风格在“产品调研”这类长程信息密集任务上潜力未被充分开发。同时“Deep Research”范式主要针对开放网络搜索训练（Tongyi-DeepResearch 明确指出其弱化通用工具使用），直接迁移到电商存在领域鸿沟：电商需要开放网知识检索与结构化商品目录查询的协同、基于可验证商品属性的论断接地、以及对专家评测、用户反馈、技术规格等异质证据的融合。论文的观察进一步证实：开源 Deep Research 模型在电商自定义工具集上表现甚至低于普通 ReAct 智能体，凸显工具层面的领域泛化难题。因此需要一种可规模化生成“高保真、长程、领域适配”训练数据的方法，把研究型行为内化进轻量模型。
AI.method: 框架分三阶段。（1）用户画像与查询构建：User Agent 基于真实用户长期行为序列（购买、评价、客服对话等）生成多维画像 P 与复杂查询 Q，并按 comprehensiveness / depth(insight) / instruction-following / readability 四个维度生成动态评价准则，含维度权重 W 与准则级权重 w。（2）状态感知监督迭代研究：Research Agent 在 ReAct 循环中按 Plan→Toolcall→Report 的认知模式运行，具备双环境工具集——Web 侧 web_search（Serper Google Search API）与 web_visit（Crawl4AI，抽取 rational/evidence/summary）；电商侧 product_search（Pyserini BM25，覆盖 11,393,822 件商品的语料）与 view_product_details（ID 查询 SKU、属性、价格历史、卖家、聚合评论）。Supervisor Agent 由三阶段状态机驱动：Check Plan（逻辑合理性与覆盖完整性）、Check Toolcall（参数正确性、检索相关性、防重复循环）、Check Report（按查询专属准则逐条打分，权重≥0.20 的准则未达标即拒绝）；不通过则输出文本反馈 F_{i,j} 触发当前步修订（式 1）。（3）轨迹精炼与蒸馏：按最少交互轮数阈值 τ=7 做长度过滤，剔除过于简单的轨迹；随后做 reflective internalization——把 [assistant, supervisor, assistant, …] 的交错多角色序列交给 Research Agent 回看，把“初始不足—反馈如何引导修正—修正后的推理/动作”内化为单条自洽的 assistant 消息，产出可直接用于标准 SFT 的单角色序列，同时保留纠错学习信号。训练基座为 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507，Megatron-LM、32×A100(80GB)、CP4/TP4/PP2/EP1、全局 batch 4、3 epoch、packing，训练了 32k/64k/80k/128k 四个上下文变体。评测采用 Deep Research Bench 的 RACE 指标并做电商适配（准则级得分→维度加权求和→维度加权求和→与参考报告归一化相对分），参考报告取框架自身最终产出；另加 Effective Product Count。数据来自 1,000 名匿名真实用户，按 8:1:1 划分训练/验证/测试。
AI.result: 主结果：ProductResearch-SFT-128k 总 RACE 45.40（Comp 45.44 / Depth 43.87 / Inst 46.09 / Read 47.22），基座 Qwen3-30B-A3B 的 ReAct 版本仅 31.78；E.Prod 由 3.58 升至 12.45（>3 倍），但仍明显低于 Gemini-DeepResearch 的 25.2。闭源/原生 Deep Research 对比：Gemini-DeepResearch 45.56 略优，Qwen-DeepResearch 42.76；开源 Tongyi-DeepResearch 仅 29.84，低于全部 ReAct 基线。ReAct 基线：Gemini-3-flash 32.41、GPT-4.1 36.46、Qwen3-max 36.67。上下文长度消融：32k→64k 提升最大（37.75→44.59），128k 达 45.40，说明长轨迹需要长上下文才能完整学习。中间报告质量分析：监督迭代第 1→2 轮提升最明显（≈0.43→0.48），第 6 轮接近 0.50，与最终参考报告基本持平，验证 Supervisor 反馈闭环的迭代精化作用。
AI.conclusion: ProductResearch 证明“多智能体合成轨迹 + 反思内化蒸馏”可作为可扩展范式，把 Deep Research 式的长程多源研究能力有效内化进轻量 MoE 模型：30B/3B 激活的 Qwen3-30B-A3B 微调后即达到与前沿闭源 deep research 系统相当的报告质量，并显著超越全部 ReAct 基线。作者同时构建了包含复杂查询、动态评价准则与智能体轨迹的数据集，兼具训练语料与基准双重用途。局限包括：细粒度检索工具（web_visit、view_product_details）实现与调用策略仍有优化空间；框架仅支持单轮研究查询，而真实购物场景中用户意图随多轮对话演化，后续将扩展 User Agent 模拟意图漂移。需注意评测采用自产报告作参考报告，可能在风格与准则契合度上对本方法存在天然偏好，且 E.Prod 指标显示其在商品覆盖广度上仍落后于 Gemini-DeepResearch；数据已匿名化并符合隐私规范，伦理风险主要为底层模型/商品库偏见的继承与误导性分析，通过 Supervisor 的事实接地校验加以缓解。

title: Active Value Querying to Minimize Additive Error in Subadditive Set Function Learning
summary: Subadditive set functions play a pivotal role in computational economics (especially in combinatorial auctions), combinatorial optimization or artificial intelligence applications such as interpretable machine learning. However, specifying a set function requires assigning values to an exponentially large number of subsets in general, a task that is often resource-intensive in practice, particularly when the values derive from external sources such as retraining of machine learning models. A~simple omission of certain values introduces ambiguity that becomes even more significant when the incomplete set function has to be further optimized over. Motivated by the well-known result about inapproximability of subadditive functions using deterministic value queries with respect to a multiplicative error, we study a problem of approximating an unknown subadditive (or a subclass of thereof) set function with respect to an additive error -- i. e., we aim to efficiently close the distance between minimal and maximal completions. Our contributions are threefold: (i) a thorough exploration of minimal and maximal completions of different classes of set functions with missing values and an analysis of their resulting distance; (ii) the development of methods to minimize this distance over classes of set functions with a known prior, achieved by disclosing values of additional subsets in both offline and online manner; and (iii) empirical demonstrations of the algorithms' performance in practical scenarios.

AI.tldr: 研究次加性集函数的不完全性问题，提出在加性误差下逼近未知次加性集函数的方法，并通过探索最小/最大完备化、离线与在线查询策略来最小化距离，最后通过实证验证算法性能。
AI.motivation: 次加性集函数在计算经济学（组合拍卖）、组合优化和可解释机器学习等AI应用中扮演重要角色。然而，指定集函数通常需要为指数级数量的子集赋值，当值来自外部来源（如机器学习模型重训练）时任务尤为艰巨。简单省略某些值会引入模糊性，在需要对不完整集函数进行优化时问题更加严重。
AI.method: 研究三类贡献：（i）深入探索不同类别的缺失值集函数的最小和最大完备化并分析其结果距离；（ii）开发在已知先验的集函数类别上最小化距离的方法，通过离线或在线方式披露额外子集的值；（iii）实际场景中算法性能的实证演示。
AI.result: 建立了处理不完全次加性集函数的理论框架，开发了最小化最大与最小完备化距离的算法，并展示了在实际应用中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为处理不完全集函数提供了系统性的方法，通过主动查询可以有效缩小最小和最大完备化之间的差距，为组合优化和机器学习应用中的不确定性建模提供了新思路。

title: The Auton Agentic AI Framework
summary: The field of Artificial Intelligence is undergoing a transition from Generative AI -- probabilistic generation of text and images -- to Agentic AI, in which autonomous systems execute actions within external environments on behalf of users. This transition exposes a fundamental architectural mismatch: Large Language Models (LLMs) produce stochastic, unstructured outputs, whereas the backend infrastructure they must control -- databases, APIs, cloud services -- requires deterministic, schema-conformant inputs. The present paper describes the Auton Agentic AI Framework, a principled architecture for standardizing the creation, execution, and governance of autonomous agent systems. The framework is organized around a strict separation between the Cognitive Blueprint, a declarative, language-agnostic specification of agent identity and capabilities, and the Runtime Engine, the platform-specific execution substrate that instantiates and runs the agent. This separation enables cross-language portability, formal auditability, and modular tool integration via the Model Context Protocol (MCP). The paper formalizes the agent execution model as an augmented Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP) with a latent reasoning space, introduces a hierarchical memory consolidation architecture inspired by biological episodic memory systems, defines a constraint manifold formalism for safety enforcement via policy projection rather than post-hoc filtering, presents a three-level self-evolution framework spanning in-context adaptation through reinforcement learning, and describes runtime optimizations -- including parallel graph execution, speculative inference, and dynamic context pruning -- that reduce end-to-end latency for multi-step agent workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Auton Agentic AI Framework，一个用于创建、执行和治理自主Agent系统的原则性架构。该框架通过将认知蓝图（Agent身份和能力的声明式规范）与运行时引擎（平台特定的执行子strate）严格分离，实现跨语言可移植性、形式化审计和模块化工具集成。
AI.motivation: 从生成式AI向Agentic AI的转变暴露了一个根本性的架构不匹配：LLM产生随机、非结构化输出，而它们需要控制的后端基础设施（数据库、API、云服务）需要确定性、符合模式的输入。
AI.method: 框架将Agent执行模型形式化为具有潜在推理空间的增强部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）；引入受生物情景记忆系统启发的分层记忆整合架构；定义约束流形形式化方法用于策略投影而非后验过滤的安全执行；提出涵盖上下文内适应到强化学习的三级自进化框架；描述包括并行图执行、推测推理和动态上下文剪枝在内的运行时优化。
AI.result: 该框架实现了跨语言可移植性、形式化审计能力、模块化工具集成（通过MCP），并降低了多步Agent工作流的端到端延迟。
AI.conclusion: Auton Agentic AI Framework通过严格的认知蓝图与运行时引擎分离，为自主Agent系统的标准化创建、执行和治理提供了一个原则性架构，解决了LLM输出与后端基础设施要求之间的架构不匹配问题。

title: Unlocking Cognitive Capabilities and Analyzing the Perception-Logic Trade-off
summary:
Recent advancements in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) pursue omni-perception capabilities, yet integrating robust sensory grounding with complex reasoning remains a challenge, particularly for underrepresented regions. In this report, we introduce the research preview of MERaLiON2-Omni (Alpha), a 10B-parameter multilingual omni-perception tailored for Southeast Asia (SEA). We present a progressive training pipeline that explicitly decouples and then integrates "System 1" (Perception) and "System 2" (Reasoning) capabilities. First, we establish a robust Perception Backbone by aligning region-specific audio-visual cues (e.g., Singlish code-switching, local cultural landmarks) with a multilingual LLM through orthogonal modality adaptation. Second, to inject cognitive capabilities without large-scale supervision, we propose a cost-effective Generate-Judge-Refine pipeline. By utilizing a Super-LLM to filter hallucinations and resolve conflicts via a consensus mechanism, we synthesize high-quality silver data that transfers textual Chain-of-Thought reasoning to multimodal scenarios.
  Comprehensive evaluation on our newly introduced SEA-Omni Benchmark Suite reveals an Efficiency-Stability Paradox: while reasoning acts as a non-linear amplifier for abstract tasks (boosting mathematical and instruction-following performance significantly), it introduces instability in low-level sensory processing. Specifically, we identify Temporal Drift in long-context audio, where extended reasoning desynchronizes the model from acoustic timestamps, and Visual Over-interpretation, where logic overrides pixel-level reality. This report details the architecture, the data-efficient training recipe, and a diagnostic analysis of the trade-offs between robust perception and structured reasoning.

AI.tldr: MERaLiON2-Omni是一个针对东南亚的10B参数多语言多模态模型，通过解耦感知与推理的渐进式训练pipeline，结合Generate-Judge-Refine合成数据实现高效推理能力注入。评测发现推理提升抽象任务但损害感知稳定性的Efficiency-Stability Paradox现象。
AI.motivation: 现有MMLM追求全向感知能力，但将稳健感官接地与复杂推理结合仍具挑战，尤其是在代表性不足的地区（如东南亚）。现有方法缺乏针对特定区域的音频-视觉线索对齐和文化特异性处理。
AI.method: 提出三阶段渐进式训练框架：(1)正交模态适配建立区域感知骨干，对齐东南亚特定音频-视觉线索与多语言LLM；(2)Generate-Judge-Refine pipeline利用Super-LLM通过共识机制过滤幻觉并合成高质量银标数据；(3)将文本链式思维推理迁移到多模态场景。
AI.result: 在SEA-Omni Benchmark上发现Efficiency-Stability Paradox：推理作为非线性放大器显著提升数学和指令跟随等抽象任务，但引入低层感知不稳定性。具体识别两种现象：(1)Temporal Drift——长音频上下文中扩展推理导致模型与声学时间戳去同步；(2)Visual Over-interpretation——逻辑凌驾于像素级现实。
AI.conclusion: MERaLiON2-Omni通过渐进式训练pipeline有效提升了东南亚地区多模态大语言模型的能力，但揭示了推理能力与感知稳定性之间的根本矛盾——Efficiency-Stability Paradox。未来工作需在保持推理增益的同时解决时序漂移和视觉过解读问题，可能需要探索更精细的模态对齐机制或动态权重调整策略。

title: Reasoning-Driven Multimodal LLM for Domain Generalization
summary: This paper addresses the domain generalization (DG) problem in deep learning. While most DG methods focus on enforcing visual feature invariance, we leverage the reasoning capability of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and explore the potential of constructing reasoning chains that derives image categories to achieve more robust predictions under domain shift. To this end, we systematically study the role of reasoning in DG using DomainBed-Reasoning, a newly constructed extension of DomainBed dataset, in which each sample is paired with class-relevant reasoning chains. Our analysis reveals two key challenges: (i) fine-tuning MLLMs with reasoning chains for classification is more challenging than direct label supervision, since the model must optimize complex reasoning sequences before label prediction; and (ii) mismatches in reasoning patterns between supervision signals and fine-tuned MLLMs lead to a trade-off between semantic richness (informative but harder to optimize) and optimization efficiency (easier to optimize but less informative). To address these issues, we propose RD-MLDG (Reasoning-Driven Multimodal LLM for Domain Generalization), a framework with two components: (i) MTCT (Multi-Task Cross-Training), which introduces an additional direct classification pathway to guide reasoning supervision; and (ii) SARR (Self-Aligned Reasoning Regularization), which preserves the semantic richness of reasoning chains while mitigating reasoning-pattern mismatches via iterative self-labeling. Experiments on standard DomainBed datasets (PACS, VLCS, OfficeHome, TerraInc) demonstrate that RD-MLDG achieves state-of-the-art performances, highlighting reasoning as a promising complementary signal for robust out-of-domain generalization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RD-MLDG框架，利用多模态大语言模型(MLLM)的推理能力解决域泛化问题，通过构建推理链来推导图像类别，实现更鲁棒的域外预测。
AI.motivation: 当前域泛化方法主要关注视觉特征不变性，忽略了推理能力的作用。本文旨在探索多模态大语言模型的推理能力，通过构建推理链来推导图像类别，从而在域偏移下获得更鲁棒的预测。
AI.method: 提出RD-MLDG框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) MTCT（多任务跨训练）：引入额外的直接分类路径来引导推理监督；(2) SARR（自对齐推理正则化）：通过迭代自标记保留推理链的语义丰富性，同时缓解推理模式不匹配问题。实验在DomainBed标准数据集（PACS、VLCS、OfficeHome、TerraInc）上进行。
AI.result: RD-MLDG在DomainBed标准数据集上实现了最先进的性能，验证了推理作为鲁棒域外泛化的互补信号具有显著潜力。
AI.conclusion: 推理是提升域泛化性能的有前景的互补信号，为解决域偏移问题提供了新思路。

title: Flowette: Flow Matching with Graphette Priors for Graph Generation
summary: We study generative modeling of graphs with recurring subgraph motifs. We propose Flowette, a continuous flow matching framework, that employs a graph neural network based transformer to learn a velocity field defined over graph representations with node and edge attributes. Our model preserves topology through optimal transport based coupling, and long-range structural dependencies through regularisation. To incorporate domain driven structural priors, we introduce graphettes, a new probabilistic family of graph structure models that generalize graphons via controlled structural edits for motifs like rings, stars and trees. We theoretically analyze the coupling, invariance, and structural properties of the proposed framework, and empirically evaluate it on synthetic and small-molecule graph generation tasks. Flowette demonstrates consistent improvements, highlighting the effectiveness of combining structural priors with flow-based training for modeling complex graph distributions.

AI.tldr: Flowette 是一个面向含重复子图 motif（环、星、树等）图生成任务的连续流匹配（flow matching）框架，其三大核心贡献为：(1) 使用融合 Gromov-Wasserstein（FGW）最优传输 + 匈牙利匹配实现噪声图与数据图之间的结构对齐耦合；(2) 引入端点一致性损失与化学感知正则项（软价键约束、原子类型边缘分布匹配）构成增强的训练目标；(3) 提出 graphette（𝒲=(W,ρ_n,f)）这一新的图结构概率先验族，通过对 graphon 采样图施加受控结构编辑（加环、加星、删环）注入领域结构偏置。模型在合成图基准（Tree/SBM/Ego-small）与分子基准（QM9/ZINC250K/Guacamol/MOSES）上取得部分指标 SOTA，并通过系统的消融实验验证三个组件各自独立有效。
AI.motivation: 图生成需要捕捉高阶 motif（环、hub、重复子图），但现有方法高度依赖领域专用架构：自回归模型需要学习或手工指定节点顺序、破坏置换不变性且难并行；一次性（one-shot）模型虽恢复置换等变但对高阶结构拟合不足；扩散/离散流匹配（DiGress、DisCo、DeFoG）虽为一站式主流范式，却依赖手工设计的速率矩阵或噪声调度，且局部节点/边更新难以保持全局拓扑与 motif；连续流匹配（图扩散、VFM/CatFlow 等）通常采用隐式或独立耦合，忽略置换与规模可变下的结构兼容性，导致在拓扑不匹配的源/目标图之间插值，速度监督方差高且不一致。此外，已有先验模型（graphon 稠密、sparsified graphon 无法生成 hub、graphex 的星函数功能受限）也缺少统一的、便于注入 motif 结构的源分布。作者据此提出三个必要成分：结构对齐的监督对、有限步积分下可靠的训练目标与领域可行性约束、以及编码主导 motif 的结构化源分布。
AI.method:
**1) 结构保持的耦合（Sec. 3.1）**：先用预训练且冻结的边感知 GIN 编码器抽取结构节点嵌入 Z，构造图内结构代价 C(Z)（嵌入对距离）与跨图特征代价 M(X⁰,X¹），以 α 权衡特征/结构求解 FGW 传输计划 T*；再以 FGW 距离构成 B×B 代价矩阵，用匈牙利算法求解批次级一对一分配（online / fixed-pool / periodic 三种协议）。证明 FGW 距离置换不变、同构图距离为 0、匈牙利解恢复置换一致的最优匹配（Lemma E.1–E.3, Thm E.3）。

**2) 速度场与架构（Sec. 3.2, App. C）**：噪声图从 graphette 先验采样并显式匹配目标图节点数（无 padding/截断），节点/边属性取自固定类别先验；采用 rectified 线性插值 A_t=(1-t)A₀+tA₁ 等，理想速度为常数 Δ=A₁-A₀。速度场由置换等变的 GNN Transformer 参数化：软邻接矩阵作为注意力 logits 的加性结构偏置，同时维护成对边隐藏状态 b_ij 并逐层更新，输出 (v_A, v_X, v_F)，并做对称化处理；Prop. C.1 给出归纳法证明的置换等变性。

**3) 训练目标（Sec. 3.3, App. D, E.3）**：L = L_vel + β_end·L_end + β_val·L_val + β_atom·L_atom。L_vel 为分项归一化的速度 MSE；L_end 用一步外推端点 Â₁=A_t+(1-t)v_A 惩罚端点偏差，并证明其恒等于 (1-t)²·L_vel(t)，即对同一速度残差的时间重加权（无新增传输目标）；L_val 基于期望键级与最大允许价键的软罚；L_atom 匹配原子类型边缘分布。Theorem E.4 证明两损失同时趋零可恢复理想常速场且 Euler 积分精确命中端点；Theorem E.5 给出 K 步 Euler 误差界 ‖s^(K)-s₁‖_F ≤ Cε（C=(e^L−1)/L）。

**4) Graphette 先验（Sec. 4, App. G/H）**：𝒲=(W,ρ_n,f)，先从稀疏化 graphon W_n=ρ_n W 采样 G′，再施加图编辑函数 f∈{I（恒等）, h（删环）, R（加环）, S（加星）}；证明 graphette 可退化回 graphon/sparsified graphon、可生成类似 graphex 的星与孤立边、并给出加星/加环对同态密度的影响（Thm 4.5, H.8, H.9）。表 1 给出各数据集族对应的 (W, ρ_n, f) 配置。
AI.result: 合成基准（Tree/SBM/Ego-small，β_val=β_atom=0）：在 Orbit 等高阶结构指标与 Validity/Uniqueness/Novelty/V.U.N 上表现最强，Degree 与 Clustering 上略逊但不影响整体保真度，Tree 与 SBM 上 V.U.N 达 100%。分子基准：QM9 Valid 99.81%、Unique 99.30%、NSPDK 0.0003；ZINC250K Valid 99.90%、Unique 100%、NSPDK 0.0006；Guacamol V.U.N 98.0%、KL 97.9%；MOSES Valid 99.9%、Novelty 98.1%、SNN 0.58、Scaff. 15.3，多项指标达到或接近 SOTA。消融：graphette→graphon 使 QM9 Valid 降 24.31、ZINC250K 降 19.90、Tree/SBM V.U.N 降 32.05/38.10；FGW→随机/Euclidean OT 使 QM9 Valid 降 9.78/5.31、ZINC250K 降 10.40/5.90；去掉 L_end 或 L_val 显著降低有效性（仅 L_vel 时 QM9 Valid 仅 69.0%），去掉 L_atom 主要降低唯一性/新颖性；编辑函数错配（环→星→删环）使 QM9 Valid 从 99.81% 降至 70.50% 再降至 53.70%。编码器消融显示 1-WL 特征已接近预训练 GIN，随机编码器性能下降但仍可用，说明结构信息比学习表示更关键；FGW 与 GW 在无非属性图上性能几乎一致。运行时：耦合开销占总训练时间很小（0.016–1.68 h），推理快于 DeFoG；fixed-pool/periodic 耦合可显著降低训练时间（Tree n=1000 从 26.3 h 降至 8.67 h）。投影前后对比表明学到的流本身已产出 97.95–98.25% 的有效分子，终端价键投影仅额外带来 1.1–1.75 个百分点提升。
AI.conclusion: Flowette 证明「结构对齐的耦合 + 端点感知的正则化 + 结构化源先验」三者组合可有效建模含重复 motif 的复杂图分布：FGW 最优传输提供置换一致、低方差的监督对；端点一致性项以 (1-t)² 时间重加权强化了有限步积分下的稳定性，并配以领域感知的价键/原子类型约束；graphette 则把结构性假设从网络架构中解耦，仅需粗粒度领域知识即可在单一框架内统一表达稠密/稀疏/环/星/树等图族。论文同时坦承局限：online FGW 的 O(B²n³) 预计算代价限制可扩展性；graphette 的编辑函数仍需人工指定且对错配敏感（可通过隐式 graphon 估计等自动化方向改进）；价键等端点约束依赖粗粒度领域信息，其他含硬组合约束的领域需类似设计；连续松弛在生成末端需离散投影，可能引入轻微伪影。作者期望三个组件各自成为后续图生成研究的可复用要素。

title: EMO-R3: Reflective Reinforcement Learning for Emotional Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown remarkable progress in visual reasoning and understanding tasks but still struggle to capture the complexity and subjectivity of human emotions. Existing approaches based on supervised fine-tuning often suffer from limited generalization and poor interpretability, while reinforcement learning methods such as Group Relative Policy Optimization fail to align with the intrinsic characteristics of emotional cognition. To address these challenges, we propose Reflective Reinforcement Learning for Emotional Reasoning (EMO-R3), a framework designed to enhance the emotional reasoning ability of MLLMs. Specifically, we introduce Structured Emotional Thinking to guide the model to perform step-by-step emotional reasoning in a structured and interpretable manner, and design a Reflective Emotional Reward that enables the model to re-evaluate its reasoning based on visual-text consistency and emotional coherence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that EMO-R3 significantly improves both the interpretability and emotional intelligence of MLLMs, achieving superior performance across multiple visual emotional understanding benchmarks.

AI.tldr: EMO-R3是一种用于增强多模态大语言模型情感推理能力的框架，通过结构化情感思考引导逐步推理，并设计反思性情感奖励机制实现推理重评估，显著提升了模型的情感理解能力与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有方法存在局限性：监督微调方法泛化能力有限且可解释性差；基于强化学习（如GRPO）的方法未能与情感认知的内在特性相匹配。MLLMs在捕捉人类情感的复杂性和主观性方面仍存在不足。
AI.method: 提出Reflective Reinforcement Learning for Emotional Reasoning (EMO-R3)框架，包含两个核心组件：1) Structured Emotional Thinking（结构化情感思考），引导模型进行逐步结构化的情感推理；2) Reflective Emotional Reward（反思性情感奖励），基于视觉-文本一致性和情感连贯性使模型重新评估其推理过程。
AI.result: 广泛实验表明，EMO-R3显著提升了MLLMs的可解释性和情感智能，在多个视觉情感理解基准上实现了优越性能。
AI.conclusion: EMO-R3通过结构化情感思考和反思性情感奖励机制，显著提升了多模态大语言模型的情感推理能力和可解释性，在多个视觉情感理解基准上取得了优异表现。

title: Hybrid Quantum Temporal Convolutional Networks
summary: Quantum machine learning models for sequential data face scalability challenges with complex multivariate signals. We introduce the Hybrid Quantum Temporal Convolutional Network (HQTCN), which combines classical temporal windowing with a quantum convolutional neural network core. By applying a shared quantum circuit across temporal windows, HQTCN captures long-range dependencies while achieving significant parameter reduction. Evaluated on synthetic NARMA sequences and high-dimensional EEG time-series, HQTCN performs competitively with classical baselines on univariate data and outperforms all baselines on multivariate tasks. The model demonstrates particular strength under data-limited conditions, maintaining high performance with substantially fewer parameters than conventional approaches. These results establish HQTCN as a parameter-efficient approach for multivariate time-series analysis.

AI.tldr: Introduces HQTCN (Hybrid Quantum Temporal Convolutional Network) that combines classical temporal windowing with quantum CNN to address scalability challenges in quantum machine learning for sequential multivariate data. The model achieves parameter-efficient time-series analysis while outperforming baselines on multivariate tasks.
AI.motivation: Quantum machine learning models for sequential data face scalability challenges with complex multivariate signals.
AI.method: Combines classical temporal windowing with a quantum convolutional neural network core, applying a shared quantum circuit across temporal windows to capture long-range dependencies while achieving significant parameter reduction.
AI.result: Performs competitively with classical baselines on univariate data and outperforms all baselines on multivariate tasks, maintaining high performance with substantially fewer parameters.
AI.conclusion: HQTCN is established as a parameter-efficient approach for multivariate time-series analysis, particularly strong under data-limited conditions with substantially fewer parameters than conventional approaches.

title: RUMAD: Reinforcement-Unifying Multi-Agent Debate
summary:
Multi-agent debate (MAD) systems leverage collective intelligence to enhance reasoning capabilities, yet existing approaches struggle to simultaneously optimize accuracy, consensus formation, and computational efficiency. Static topology methods lack adaptability to task complexity variations, while external LLM-based coordination risks introducing privileged knowledge that compromises debate neutrality. This work presents RUMAD (Reinforcement-Unifying Multi-Agent Debate), a novel framework that formulates dynamic communication topology control in MAD as a reinforcement learning (RL) problem.
  RUMAD employs a content-agnostic observation scheme that captures high-level debate dynamics avoiding access to raw agent reasoning content. RUMAD uses a multi-objective reward to model solution quality, cohesion and efficiency. A PPO-trained controller dynamically adjusts edge weights in the communication graph, while a dual-threshold mechanism enables fine-grained control over both agent activation and information visibility.
  Experimental evaluation across MMLU, GSM8K, and GPQA benchmarks demonstrates that RUMAD achieves substantial efficiency gains, reducing token costs by over 80\%, while still improving reasoning accuracy compared to single LLM model and multiple MAD baselines. Notably, RUMAD trained exclusively on MMLU exhibits robust zero-shot generalization to out-of-domain (OOD) tasks, indicating that the learned communication strategies capture task-independent principles of effective multi-agent coordination. These results establish RUMAD as a efficient and robust approach for deploying multi-agent reasoning application with practical resource constraints.

AI.tldr: RUMAD 将多智能体辩论（MAD）的动态通信拓扑控制建模为强化学习问题：使用一个非 LLM 的 PPO 控制器在每一轮辩论中动态调整有向通信图的边权重，通过"内容无关"观测（仅看相似度/答案一致性等高层结构特征）、多目标奖励（准确性、共识、效率、稀疏性）与双阈值机制（agent 激活 + 邻居可见性分级 + 预算正则），在 MMLU/GSM8K/GPQA 上以 6 agent、6 轮配置将 token 成本较全连接 MAD 降低 80% 以上，同时精度更高（如 MMLU 68% vs 49%），且仅在 MMLU dev 上训练即可零样本迁移到域外任务。
AI.motivation: 现有 MAD 方法存在三重不可兼得：①适应性不足——静态稀疏拓扑（S-MAD 环形/星形、GD 分组、S²-MAD 两阶段）无法随任务难度与多样性动态调整，复杂任务被切断关键信息路径、简单任务保留冗余连接；②中立性受损——外部 LLM 评判/汇总角色（如 GPT-4）会向辩论引入特权知识，压制智能体群体的多样性与协作涌现；③效率缺位——以往设计几乎不显式建模 token 成本，仅靠限制辩论轮数施加硬上界，无法在部署约束下精确管理通信预算。作者的核心问题设定是：能否以 RL 端到端地、逐轮地控制辩论通信拓扑，在不触碰推理内容的前提下同时优化准确率、共识与通信成本。
AI.method: 三阶段流水线（Fig.2）：Stage 1 各 agent 独立作答以保证假设多样性；Stage 2 由 PPO 控制器生成拓扑并交互（2.1 拓扑生成、2.2 交互）；Stage 3 多数投票聚合共识。关键设计：(1) 内容无关观测——MLP 编码 N×N 相似度矩阵，sim(i,j)=λ·cos(r_i,r_j)+(1−λ)·I(c_i=c_j)，控制器只看到 [0,1] 浮点标量，不接触原始文本或文本 embedding（embedding 仅由 MAD 环境侧计算）；(2) 动作空间——每条有向边输出高斯参数 (μ,σ)，w_ij ~ Sigmoid(N(μ,σ²))，连续可微、可探索；(3) 双阈值机制——激活阈值用 agent 自环权重 w_ii 作为"置信度"门控，外部平均影响小于 w_ii 则该 agent 静默复用上轮回答；可见性阈值按权重分三档注入 [Critical]/[Reference]/[Background] 标签构造邻居提示，另有 Invisible；(4) 预算 B 作为训练期软先验，在策略损失中加入 L_budget=max(0, 活跃边数−B)；(5) 两层多目标奖励：逐轮 R_t（Accuracy、Consensus、Progress 早轮衰减放大、Improvement、Efficiency、−Sparsity）与 episode 终局 R_ep，权重取自 Table 5；PPO 使用 GAE 与裁剪目标，推理时取高斯均值确定性输出边权。实验在 MMLU dev 训练，测试 MMLU/GSM8K/GPQA；agent 池为 LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct、ChatGLM-4-9B、Deepseek-Math-7B-Instruct 各 2 个，共 6 agent；全 4-bit (Q4_K_M) 量化、0-shot、单张 RTX 3090；相似度嵌入用 Nomic-Embed-v1；基线为全连接 MAD、S-MAD(★/○)、GD、S²-MAD。
AI.result: 主结果（Table 2，6 agent/6 轮）：MMLU 上 RUMAD B=12 达 68%、11.43k token（较 MAD 62.58k 节省 81.7%），B=18 68%、22.46k；MAD 仅 49%，S-MAD★ 61%、S²-MAD 46%。GSM8K：RUMAD B=12 86%、10.46k（节省 86.4%），B=18 89%、17.28k，超过 MAD 的 88%/76.90k。GPQA：RUMAD B=18 35%、33.39k 优于 MAD 30%/57.80k；B=12 32%、19.53k 节省 66.2%，但略低于 S-MAD○/GD 的 34%。GSM8K 上 GSM8K 效率比（token/精度百分点）RUMAD B=12 为 0.121k，第二名 GD 为 0.354k。零样本迁移：仅在 MMLU dev 训练即在 GPQA、GSM8K 直接有效，且奖励权重不做任何调整，说明学到的是任务无关的通信协调原则。消融（Table 3，B=12）：β 分布替代高斯→MMLU 68.3→65.1%、token 11.4→18.7k；去 R_ep→66.9%/15.6k；去 R_t→token 近翻倍（22.2k）；去 agent 激活→token 涨约 4.5 倍（51.9k）且精度下降，表明"agent 激活"而非仅边剪枝才是节省 token 的主因；去 L_budget→MMLU 70.0% 但 GPQA 降至 27.7%（OOD 泛化变差），说明预算正则兼具泛化正则作用。可扩展性（Table 4）：N∈{3,6,9} 且 B=2N 时精度单调上升（MMLU 66.6→70.3%，GSM8K 85.0→88.5%）；N=6→9 固定 B=18 时出现反直觉结果——精度升（MMLU 68.5→70.3%）而 token 降（22.5→17.6k），说明控制器在更大群体中选择更专门化子集。局限：集中式 PPO 控制器在数百 agent 规模下可能面临扩展性瓶颈，未来可探索去中心化/分层 MARL。
AI.conclusion: RUMAD 将 MAD 通信拓扑控制统一为一个内容无关、可泛化的 RL 问题，证明了"逐轮动态稀疏化 + agent 静默机制"能在不牺牲甚至提升集体推理精度的前提下带来数量级的 token 节省（>80%），并展现出跨任务零样本迁移与随规模自适应配置预算的能力。其贡献不只是精度数字，而是把 MAD 的"协调机制"本身作为可学习对象，揭示了学到的通信策略具有任务无关性。遗留问题：集中式控制器在大规模 swarm（数百 agent）下的扩展性、奖励权重的手工设定依赖、相似度矩阵观测对 embedding 质量与额外 embedding 计算开销的影响、以及"多数投票"作为最终聚合方式的局限（未探索置信度加权聚合）；此外附录中的实例轨迹显示部分 agent 的"辩论"文本存在模板化重复，说明语义层面的真实信息增量仍有限，主要收益来自剪枝与静默而非讨论深度。

title: SDMixer: Sparse Dual-Mixer for Time Series Forecasting
summary: Multivariate time series forecasting is widely applied in fields such as transportation, energy, and finance. However, the data commonly suffers from issues of multi-scale characteristics, weak correlations, and noise interference, which limit the predictive performance of existing models. This paper proposes a dual-stream sparse Mixer prediction framework that extracts global trends and local dynamic features from sequences in both the frequency and time domains, respectively. It employs a sparsity mechanism to filter out invalid information, thereby enhancing the accuracy of cross-variable dependency modeling. Experimental results demonstrate that this method achieves leading performance on multiple real-world scenario datasets, validating its effectiveness and generality. The code is available at https://github.com/SDMixer/SDMixer

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种双流稀疏Mixer预测框架，用于解决多变量时间序列预测中的多尺度特征、弱相关性和噪声干扰问题。该方法分别在频域和时域提取全局趋势和局部动态特征，并通过稀疏机制过滤无效信息，提升跨变量依赖建模的准确性。实验表明该方法在多个真实场景数据集上达到领先性能。
AI.motivation: 多变量时间序列预测广泛应用于交通、能源和金融等领域，但现有数据存在多尺度特征、弱相关性和噪声干扰等问题，限制了现有模型的预测性能。
AI.method: 提出双流稀疏Mixer预测框架：1) 在频域和时域分别提取全局趋势和局部动态特征；2) 采用稀疏机制过滤无效信息；3) 增强跨变量依赖建模能力。
AI.result: 在多个真实场景数据集上取得领先性能，验证了方法的有效性和泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 该双流稀疏Mixer框架通过频时域特征融合与稀疏过滤机制，有效解决了多变量时间序列预测中的多尺度、弱相关和噪声问题，具有良好的有效性和泛化性。代码已开源。

title: RF-Agent: Automated Reward Function Design via Language Agent Tree Search
comment: 39 pages, 9 tables, 11 figures, Project page see https://github.com/deng-ai-lab/RF-Agent
summary: Designing efficient reward functions for low-level control tasks is a challenging problem. Recent research aims to reduce reliance on expert experience by using Large Language Models (LLMs) with task information to generate dense reward functions. These methods typically rely on training results as feedback, iteratively generating new reward functions with greedy or evolutionary algorithms. However, they suffer from poor utilization of historical feedback and inefficient search, resulting in limited improvements in complex control tasks. To address this challenge, we propose RF-Agent, a framework that treats LLMs as language agents and frames reward function design as a sequential decision-making process, enhancing optimization through better contextual reasoning. RF-Agent integrates Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) to manage the reward design and optimization process, leveraging the multi-stage contextual reasoning ability of LLMs. This approach better utilizes historical information and improves search efficiency to identify promising reward functions. Outstanding experimental results in 17 diverse low-level control tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of our method. The source code is available at https://github.com/deng-ai-lab/RF-Agent.

AI.tldr: RF-Agent利用大语言模型(LLM)和蒙特卡洛树搜索(MCTS)来解决低层次控制任务中奖励函数设计的难题，将奖励函数设计建模为序列决策过程。
AI.motivation: 低层次控制任务的奖励函数设计困难，现有方法依赖专家经验，虽然有研究尝试用LLM生成密集奖励函数，但存在历史反馈利用不足和搜索效率低的问题，导致复杂控制任务改进有限。
AI.method: 提出RF-Agent框架，将LLM视为语言智能体，将奖励函数设计建模为序贯决策过程。集成蒙特卡洛树搜索(MCTS)来管理奖励设计和优化过程，利用LLM的多阶段上下文推理能力。
AI.result: 在17个不同的低层次控制任务中取得了优异的实验结果。
AI.conclusion: RF-Agent能更好地利用历史信息，提高搜索效率，找到有前景的奖励函数，验证了方法的有效性。

title: Normalisation and Initialisation Strategies for Graph Neural Networks in Blockchain Anomaly Detection
summary: Graph neural networks (GNNs) offer a principled approach to financial fraud detection by jointly learning from node features and transaction graph topology. However, their effectiveness on real-world anti-money laundering (AML) benchmarks depends critically on training practices such as specifically weight initialisation and normalisation that remain underexplored. We present a systematic ablation of initialisation and normalisation strategies across three GNN architectures (GCN, GAT, and GraphSAGE) on the Elliptic Bitcoin dataset. Our experiments reveal that initialisation and normalisation are architecture-dependent: GraphSAGE achieves the strongest performance with Xavier initialisation alone, GAT benefits most from combining GraphNorm with Xavier initialisation, while GCN shows limited sensitivity to these modifications. These findings offer practical, architecture-specific guidance for deploying GNNs in AML pipelines for datasets with severe class imbalance. We release a reproducible experimental framework with temporal data splits, seeded runs, and full ablation results.

AI.tldr: 本文在 Elliptic Bitcoin 数据集上系统消融了 GNN 的权重初始化与归一化策略（Xavier 初始化 vs. 默认初始化，GraphNorm vs. 无 GraphNorm），覆盖 GCN、GAT、GraphSAGE 三种架构。结论是效果具有架构依赖性：GraphSAGE 配合单独的 Xavier 初始化最佳（AUPRC 0.6678，AUC 0.8826），GAT 配合 GraphNorm + Xavier 提升最大（AUPRC 0.6568，较基线 +0.055），GCN 对这些改动不敏感、基线已最优（AUPRC 0.5993）。作者同时发布了含时间切分、固定随机种子与完整消融结果的可复现实验框架。
AI.motivation: 反洗钱（AML）中的加密货币交易天然构成图结构，孤立样本式的 i.i.d. 模型无法捕捉协同化的非法资金流模式，GNN 能联合利用节点特征与拓扑信息。然而既有研究多聚焦于架构设计与可扩展性，而权重初始化与归一化这类关键训练实践在欺诈检测领域仍缺乏系统研究；且 Elliptic 数据集存在严重类别不平衡（标注节点中仅 2% 属于非法类）、同质性/异质性混杂、度分布倾斜与时间漂移等因素，会显著影响 GNN 的训练动态与消息传递稳定性。此外，该领域普遍以 0.5 阈值下的全量 F1 作为报告指标（该值接近 1、方差 <1e-5，缺乏区分度），且随机划分易造成时间信息泄漏，亟需更严谨的评估协议。作者据此提出四个研究问题：交易图的哪些结构属性限制 GNN 效果、初始化如何影响优化稳定性与收敛、图结构感知归一化是否优于 BatchNorm/LayerNorm、以及不同架构下最优归一化方案的差异。
AI.method: 数据与图构建：使用 Elliptic Bitcoin 数据集（203,769 个交易节点、234,355 条有向支付边、每节点 166 维特征、49 个时间步；标注仅占 23%，其中非法 2%、合法 21%、未知 77%）。有向图被对称化为无向图（加反向边、去自环与重边），交易 ID 映射为连续整数，特征矩阵 X ∈ R^{N×166}；标签 0=非法、1=合法、2=未知，未知节点保留在图中仅用于上下文消息传递。切分与评估：严格时间切分（29/10/10 个时间步分别用于训练/验证/测试），避免未来信息泄漏；仅用有标签节点做监督训练。以 AUPRC 为主指标（辅以 AUC-ROC），采用重复子采样（随机抽取 50% 测试节点重复 100 次）报告均值与标准差，并在模型输出概率的 90/99/99.9 分位高置信阈值上计算 precision/recall/F1。模型：采用 PyTorch Geometric 实现 GCNConv、GATConv、SAGEConv；模块化结构为输入层(166 维) → 1–3 层 GNN（每层后接 ReLU、GraphNorm、dropout p∈[0.08,0.64]）→ 嵌入层(64–128) → 线性分类头（2 类输出）；全图（full-graph）训练，保留多跳结构依赖；使用加权二元交叉熵处理类别不平衡，Adam 优化，weight decay 固定 5e-4，全局随机种子 42，单卡 RTX 5880。超参：用 Optuna 100 次试验（TPE + ASHA）以验证集 AUPRC 为目标搜索学习率[2e-6,1e-3]、隐藏维度[128,256]、嵌入维度[64,128]、层数{1,2,3}、dropout、epoch 数[128,512]、GraphSAGE 聚合器{mean,max}，测试集严格留出仅用于最终评估。消融设计：对比 baseline（各层 reset_parameters() 默认初始化、无 GraphNorm）、Xavier（Xavier uniform + 无 GraphNorm）、GraphNorm + Xavier 三种配置。
AI.result: 表 2 显示无统一最优策略：GCN 在基线下 AUPRC 最高（0.5993，AUC 0.8728），加 Xavier 使 AUPRC 降至 0.5939，再叠加 GraphNorm 明显恶化至 0.5442（AUC 0.8736）；GAT 基线 AUC 0.8585/AUPRC 0.6022，单独 Xavier 使 AUC 降至 0.8486 而 AUPRC 升至 0.6190，GraphNorm + Xavier 取得最佳（AUC 0.8700，AUPRC 0.6568，较基线 +0.012 AUC、+0.055 AUPRC），说明图级归一化有助于稳定注意力聚合、缓解度倾斜下的主导效应；GraphSAGE 基线 AUC 0.8593/AUPRC 0.6551，Xavier 单独使用达到峰值（AUC 0.8826，AUPRC 0.6678，+0.023 AUC、+0.013 AUPRC），再叠加 GraphNorm 反而略降（AUC 0.8755，AUPRC 0.6651），说明图级归一化可能干扰其均值/池化式邻域聚合。收敛性上 GraphSAGE 收敛最快且验证分数持续最高，GAT 方差大、GCN 稳定最慢。与既有工作对比（表 3）：受评估协议差异限制，数值直接比较受限；Deprez et al. 报告的 GraphSAGE 为 AUC 0.8712/AUPRC 0.6392，本文最优 GraphSAGE（Xavier）达 AUPRC 0.6678、GAT（GraphNorm+Xavier）达 0.6568，均优于该基准，表明初始化与归一化带来的改进与架构创新是正交的。作者指出先验文献的 0.5 阈值全量 F1（Weber: LR 0.543、RF 0.796、GCN 0.628；Marasi & Ferretti: ChebNet 0.91、GraphSAGE 0.889、GATv2 0.881）接近饱和、缺乏区分度，故改用 AUPRC 与高置信阈值下的 P/R/F1 评估。
AI.conclusion: 初始化与归一化并非普遍有益，而是与架构的归纳偏置强相关：GraphSAGE 宜仅用 Xavier 初始化（GraphNorm 边际甚至负面作用），GAT 宜用 GraphNorm + Xavier 以稳定注意力聚合，GCN 则默认基线已足够；对严重不平衡的交易图，针对架构选择初始化策略比单独套用图级归一化更为可靠。作者据此为 AML 流水线中 GNN 部署提供架构特定的实践建议，并强调应优先报告 AUPRC 与高置信阈值指标、采用无泄漏时间切分以反映对未来交易的泛化能力。局限包括仅覆盖 GCN/GAT/GraphSAGE 而未含图 Transformer、高阶与时序 GNN；Elliptic 缺少异质边类型、层级账户结构与动态属性，结论迁移到真实 AML 系统存在不确定性；受硬件限制仅做 100 次 Optuna 试验与有限搜索空间；未评估推理延迟、显存与吞吐等部署指标。展望包括统一基准评估协议、引入 GLASS 等自适应采样与 SALIENT/SALIENT++ 等执行级优化以扩展可扩展性、以及在更新的 Elliptic2 数据集上进行子图级验证。

title: Pessimistic Auxiliary Policy for Offline Reinforcement Learning
summary: Offline reinforcement learning aims to learn an agent from pre-collected datasets, avoiding unsafe and inefficient real-time interaction. However, inevitable access to out-ofdistribution actions during the learning process introduces approximation errors, causing the error accumulation and considerable overestimation. In this paper, we construct a new pessimistic auxiliary policy for sampling reliable actions. Specifically, we develop a pessimistic auxiliary strategy by maximizing the lower confidence bound of the Q-function. The pessimistic auxiliary strategy exhibits a relatively high value and low uncertainty in the vicinity of the learned policy, avoiding the learned policy sampling high-value actions with potentially high errors during the learning process. Less approximation error introduced by sampled action from pessimistic auxiliary strategy leads to the alleviation of error accumulation. Extensive experiments on offline reinforcement learning benchmarks reveal that utilizing the pessimistic auxiliary strategy can effectively improve the efficacy of other offline RL approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于悲观辅助策略的离线强化学习方法，通过最大化Q函数的下置信界来采样可靠动作，从而减少分布外动作引入的近似误差，缓解误差累积问题。
AI.motivation: 离线强化学习避免了在真实环境中的不安全且低效的实时交互，但学习过程中不可避免地访问分布外动作会引入近似误差，导致误差累积和严重的过度估计问题。
AI.method: 构建一种新的悲观辅助策略来采样可靠动作。具体而言，通过最大化Q函数的下置信界开发悲观辅助策略。该策略在已学习策略附近具有较高值和较低不确定性，可避免在学习过程中采样到具有高误差的高价值动作。
AI.result: 在离线强化学习基准上的广泛实验表明，利用悲观辅助策略可有效提升其他离线强化学习方法的性能。
AI.conclusion: 悲观辅助策略通过降低动作采样引入的近似误差，有效缓解了误差累积问题，为改进离线强化学习提供了一种通用且有效的插件式方法。

title: When Does Multimodal Learning Help in Healthcare? A Benchmark on EHR and Chest X-Ray Fusion
summary: Machine learning holds promise for advancing clinical decision support, yet it remains unclear when multimodal learning truly helps in practice, particularly under modality missingness and fairness constraints. In this work, we conduct a systematic benchmark of multimodal fusion between Electronic Health Records (EHR) and chest X-rays (CXR) on standardized cohorts from MIMIC-IV and MIMIC-CXR, aiming to answer four fundamental questions: when multimodal fusion improves clinical prediction, how different fusion strategies compare, how robust existing methods are to missing modalities, and whether multimodal models achieve algorithmic fairness. Our study reveals several key insights. Multimodal fusion improves performance when modalities are complete, with gains concentrating in diseases that require complementary information from both EHR and CXR. While cross-modal learning mechanisms capture clinically meaningful dependencies beyond simple concatenation, the rich temporal structure of EHR introduces strong modality imbalance that architectural complexity alone cannot overcome. Under realistic missingness, multimodal benefits rapidly degrade unless models are explicitly designed to handle incomplete inputs. Moreover, multimodal fusion does not inherently improve fairness, with subgroup disparities mainly arising from unequal sensitivity across demographic groups. To support reproducible and extensible evaluation, we further release a flexible benchmarking toolkit that enables plug-and-play integration of new models and datasets. Together, this work provides actionable guidance on when multimodal learning helps, when it fails, and why, laying the foundation for developing clinically deployable multimodal systems that are both effective and reliable. The open-source toolkit can be found at https://github.com/jakeykj/CareBench.

AI.tldr: 本文对电子健康记录(EHR)和胸部X光(CXR)的多模态融合进行了系统性基准测试，旨在回答四个基本问题：多模态融合何时改善临床预测、不同融合策略的比较、模型对模态缺失的鲁棒性，以及多模态模型是否能实现算法公平性。研究基于MIMIC-IV和MIMIC-CXR数据集构建标准化队列，并发布开源基准测试工具包CareBench。
AI.motivation: 机器学习有潜力推进临床决策支持，但多模态学习在实践中何时真正有帮助尚不明确，特别是在模态缺失和公平性约束条件下。现有研究缺乏对EHR和CXR多模态融合的系统性基准测试。
AI.method: 在MIMIC-IV和MIMIC-CXR的标准化队列上对EHR和CXR多模态融合进行系统性基准测试，比较不同融合策略，评估模态缺失下的鲁棒性，并分析算法公平性。
AI.result: 关键发现：(1)模态完整时多模态融合改善性能，收益集中于需要EHR和CXR互补信息的疾病；(2)跨模态学习机制捕获超越简单拼接的临床有意义依赖；(3)EHR的丰富时间结构导致强模态不平衡，架构复杂性无法克服；(4)现实缺失条件下多模态收益迅速下降，除非模型显式设计处理不完整输入；(5)多模态融合不固有改善公平性，子群体差异主要源于不同人口统计学群体间的敏感性不平等。
AI.conclusion: 多模态学习在模态完整时有助于临床预测，但存在模态不平衡问题；对缺失模态需要专门设计；多模态不固有改善公平性。本文为开发有效且可靠的可临床部署多模态系统提供可操作指导，并提供开源工具包CareBench支持可重复和可扩展评估。

title: Portfolio Reinforcement Learning with Scenario-Context Rollout
summary:
Market regime shifts induce distribution shifts that can degrade the performance of portfolio rebalancing policies. We propose macro-conditioned scenario-context rollout (SCR) that generates plausible next-day multivariate return scenarios under stress events. However, doing so faces new challenges, as history will never tell what would have happened differently. As a result, incorporating scenario-based rewards from rollouts introduces a reward--transition mismatch in temporal-difference learning, destabilizing RL critic training.
  We analyze this inconsistency and show it leads to a mixed evaluation target. Guided by this analysis, we construct a counterfactual next state using the rollout-implied continuations and augment the critic agent's bootstrap target. Doing so stabilizes the learning and provides a viable bias-variance tradeoff.
  In out-of-sample evaluations across 31 distinct universes of U.S. equity and ETF portfolios, our method improves Sharpe ratio by up to 76% and reduces maximum drawdown by up to 53% compared with classic and RL-based portfolio rebalancing baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出宏条件化的「情景-上下文滚动」(Scenario-Context Rollout, SCR)，用宏观冲击情景生成下一日多资产联合收益分布以训练组合再平衡的 PPO 智能体。核心发现是：把情景奖励与历史「磁带」(tape) 的实际后继状态混用会形成「混合 Bellman 算子」，导致奖励-转移错配与不动点偏差。作者据此构造反事实后继状态，并将其与实际后继的 bootstrap 目标混合（Y_βcf），给出 Wasserstein 形式的偏差-方差权衡界与最优混合系数 β*。在 31 个美股/ETF 组合宇宙的样本外检验中，Sharpe 最高提升 76%，最大回撤最多降低 53%。
AI.motivation: 金融市场非平稳：预期收益、波动率与跨资产依赖随宏观经济结构演化而变化，regime shift 会造成分布偏移，使组合再平衡策略表现退化。传统风险管理依赖场景分析与压力测试，而基于日志数据（logged tape）的 RL 训练存在根本缺陷——历史只提供单一实际实现的转移，无法回答「若当时采取另一动作会怎样」。因此作者希望借用 agent-based 宏观建模的思想，引入受宏观冲击条件化的情景收益分布来评分策略，但这在 TD 学习中的正确性缺乏理论基础，正是本文要解决的核心问题。
AI.method:
**SCR 模块**：用低维 regime embedding U_t 表征市场（来自横截面收益与宏观冲击、以及政策文本信号）；以「异常」判定 shock day，把连续出现的 shock 日聚成 shock channel（距离阈值 λ²、running mean 质心），并维护 ShockLedger 记录各 channel 的宏观签名与代表性资产；用 trailing lookback 窗口聚合 channel 命中形成二值激活向量 χ_t。检索描述子 ψ_t 只含 t 时刻可得的市场/宏观/暴露度信息，排除组合历史（防泄漏）；在历史库 D={(r̃_{u+1}, ψ_u)} 中做 k 近邻检索，得到条件分布 P_scen(·|ψ_t)（近邻返回向量的经验测度）。同时用短程确定性宏观压力 rollout 追踪峰值 Mahalanobis 应力得到严重度 v_t，经 trailing 分位数归一化后得到 regime context g_t ∈ [g̲,1]，作为风险预算/暴露门控缩放情景组合收益。

**RL 训练**：PPO-Clip + GAE；状态 φ_t=(z_t,h_t)，动作经投影 Π_t 满足 box/杠杆/换手约束；奖励 r_t = 情景样本门控收益均值 − 尾部风险惩罚（Risk_η，温度 η）− 交易摩擦与结构正则 Reg。

**反事实后继与目标增广**：用情景条件均值 r̄^{scen}_{t+1} 经同一更新函数 Upd 得到 φ^{cf}_{t+1}，构造 Y_r（tape 后继 bootstrap）与 Y_c（反事实 bootstrap），按 Y_βcf=(1−β)Y_r+βY_c 增广 critic 目标。

**理论**：定义混合算子 T_hyb^π（情景奖励 + 实际后继）与情景一致算子 T_scen^π（情景奖励 + 情景后继）；Lemma 3.1 证明两者之差完全来自 continuation 项；Proposition 3.2 用 Kantorovich–Rubinstein 对偶性给出 ‖T_hyb V − T_scen V‖_∞ ≤ δ L_V L_h Δ_W；Corollary 3.3 给出不动点偏差 ‖V_hyb−V_scen‖_∞ ≤ δ/(1−δ)·L_V L_h Δ_W；Theorem 3.5 给出一步混合目标的 Wasserstein 二阶矩上界 E[(Y_βcf−Y*)²] ≤ 2δ²(L_VL_h)²[(1−β)²Δ₂ + β²σ²_scen]；Corollary 3.6 给出最优混合系数 β* = A/(A+B)。
AI.result: 在 FinRL 美股/ETF 数据（2009–2023，训练 2009–2017、验证 2018–2019、测试 2020–2023）上，31 个 universe 分 4 组评估。SCR–PPO–Full 相对 PPO(Historical Replay)：Sharpe 高波动 0.615→0.782、低波动 0.079→0.641、通用 0.435→0.900、市场代理 0.492→1.004；MaxDD 分别 0.416→0.238、0.337→0.164、0.409→0.167、0.370→0.179；换手率从 0.15–0.30 降至 0.005 左右。消融显示反事实续接混合是关键：NoCF→Full 的 Sharpe 0.647→0.805、Calmar 0.561→0.737、Resid-AUC 0.087→0.075；场景-实际收益差距 Gap_final 由 0.526 降至 ~10⁻⁴。β 敏感性显示 β=0.5 最优，两端（0 或 1）均退化，符合偏差-方差权衡理论。定性上在 COVID-19 抛售与 2021–2022 宏观冲击窗口中资本保护与回撤控制优于所有基线，且能在反弹期更快复利。ShockLedger 能稳定识别复现型渠道并将 2020 年 3 月识别为训练集外的新颖事件。
AI.conclusion: SCR 是首个将宏观情景反馈机制引入 RL 组合管理的框架，其理论贡献是明确刻画了「情景奖励 + 日志实际转移」导致的混合 Bellman 算子与固定点偏差，并给出 Wasserstein 形式的定量刻画与最优混合权重；反事实后继状态 + 增广 critic bootstrap 是既能对齐情景目标、又保持对日志磁带忠实、并提供可操作偏差-方差权衡的方案。实验证明该方法在多种宇宙与 regime 混合变化下显著提升样本外风险调整收益、压低尾部回撤、显著降低换手，且训练更稳定。局限在于结论依赖单一数据源与特定基线设定，β 取最优值依赖理论无法直接观测的量（Δ₂、σ²_scen），实践中以 β=0.5 近似；情景分布由历史近邻检索构造，对训练集外新型冲击只能依赖新颖性过滤与近邻重采样，可能限制外推能力。

title: BTTackler: A Diagnosis-based Framework for Efficient Deep Learning Hyperparameter Optimization
summary: Hyperparameter optimization (HPO) is known to be costly in deep learning, especially when leveraging automated approaches. Most of the existing automated HPO methods are accuracy-based, i.e., accuracy metrics are used to guide the trials of different hyperparameter configurations amongst a specific search space. However, many trials may encounter severe training problems, such as vanishing gradients and insufficient convergence, which can hardly be reflected by accuracy metrics in the early stages of the training and often result in poor performance. This leads to an inefficient optimization trajectory because the bad trials occupy considerable computation resources and reduce the probability of finding excellent hyperparameter configurations within a time limitation. In this paper, we propose \textbf{Bad Trial Tackler (BTTackler)}, a novel HPO framework that introduces training diagnosis to identify training problems automatically and hence tackles bad trials. BTTackler diagnoses each trial by calculating a set of carefully designed quantified indicators and triggers early termination if any training problems are detected. Evaluations are performed on representative HPO tasks consisting of three classical deep neural networks (DNN) and four widely used HPO methods. To better quantify the effectiveness of an automated HPO method, we propose two new measurements based on accuracy and time consumption. Results show the advantage of BTTackler on two-fold: (1) it reduces 40.33\% of time consumption to achieve the same accuracy comparable to baseline methods on average and (2) it conducts 44.5\% more top-10 trials than baseline methods on average within a given time budget.
